### [309] [LMP-GNN: Probabilistic Reconstruction of Missing Lane Counts for Signed Max-Pressure Traffic Signal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21734)
*Zhihao Wan,Xiangle Pan,Xinqiang Chen,Gen Li,Qiang Luo*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出LMP-GNN，一种轻量级的车道-运动图神经网络，用于在自适应交通信号控制中概率性重建缺失的车道计数，同时保持现有的Signed Max-Pressure控制器不变，实现重建与控制的解耦评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应交通信号控制依赖及时的车道级观测，但检测器故障、视觉遮挡和通信失败会导致部分交通状态不可用，扭曲信号决策。已有工作分别推进了数据插补、状态恢复和基于估计状态的控制，但在三者接口处存在空白：如何概率性地仅重建缺失车道计数、保留所有观测测量值、并追踪其对未改变的控制器的影响。

Method: 提出LMP-GNN，一种紧凑的车道-运动图神经网络，为每条车道预测均值和边际不确定性。通过三条透明的输入规则将输出转换为缺失车道的控制器输入，同时保持观测值、合法相位、压力计算和相位选择不变。在五个CityFlow网络上进行综合研究，包括需求变化、学习比较器、架构、效率和SUMO迁移等额外检验。

Result: LMP-GNN能准确重建缺失的车道状态，并且比确定性Road Mean基线更好地保持控制器决策。Fixed Lane Discount在相关缺失模式下将平均出行时间最多降低13.74%，但严重随机丢失会逆转该收益。与两种决策时间学习适应方法相比，模型参数减少89.4-96.6%，中位模型路径延迟降低81.1-95.0%。

Conclusion: LMP-GNN提供了轻量级且可审计的重建到控制接口，具有经过验证的交通效益和明确的运行边界，填补了数据重建与控制器设计之间的空白。

Abstract: Adaptive traffic-signal control relies on timely lane-level observations, yet detector faults, visual obstruction, and communication failures can make part of the traffic state unavailable and distort signal decisions. Prior work has separately advanced traffic-data imputation, state restoration, and estimated-state control. A gap remains at their interface. It is still unclear how to reconstruct only missing lane counts probabilistically using information available at the current decision, preserve all observed measurements, and trace the consequences through an unchanged Signed Max-Pressure controller. To address this gap, we propose LMP-GNN, a compact lane-movement graph neural network that predicts a mean and marginal uncertainty for each lane. Three transparent input rules convert these outputs into missing-lane controller inputs, while observed counts, legal phases, pressure calculation, and phase selection remain unchanged. This design isolates reconstruction effects from policy redesign and evaluates whether they survive lane recovery, pressure and phase fidelity, and closed-loop traffic. A comprehensive study on five CityFlow networks includes additional checks of demand variation, learned comparators, architecture, efficiency, and SUMO transfer. LMP-GNN reconstructs missing lane states accurately and generally preserves controller decisions better than a deterministic Road Mean baseline. Fixed Lane Discount reduces accrued average travel time by up to 13.74% under correlated missingness, while severe random loss reverses the benefit. Compared with two decision-time learned adaptations, the retained model uses 89.4-96.6% fewer parameters and achieves 81.1-95.0% lower median model-path latency. Overall, LMP-GNN provides a lightweight and auditable reconstruction-to-control interface with verified traffic benefits and explicit operating boundaries.

</details>


### [310] [LLMs are Few-Shot Decision-Makers: Generalized Context-Aware Microgrid Frequency Control through Prompt Decision Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21858)
*Xu Yang,Chenhui Lin,Haotian Liu,Kaihang Deng,Yunhe Li,Wenchuan Wu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种提示决策Transformer（Prompt-DT）架构用于微电网频率控制，通过少样本专家历史轨迹作为提示来引导自主感知与自适应决策，结合自监督对比学习、物理信息提示设计和轻量级微调方法，解决了传统RL方法在多样微电网配置下泛化能力不足和适应未知环境能力差的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微电网作为下一代电力系统的关键组成部分，具有低惯性、复杂动态和模型条件差的特点，需要先进的数据驱动频率控制策略。虽然强化学习显示出一定潜力，但现有RL方法在不同微电网配置下的泛化能力不足，且在无法获取明确系统参数时缺乏对未知环境的适应性。

Method: 1) 提出Prompt-DT架构，利用少样本专家历史轨迹作为提示引导决策；2) 设计基于自监督对比学习的上下文感知训练与执行机制，增强环境识别和提示利用效率；3) 提出物理信息提示设计技术，基于累积奖励和频率波动性筛选提示，确保在线执行时的高质量物理指导；4) 开发轻量级微调方法，以最小调整实现与全参数微调相当的性能。

Result: 所提出的Prompt-DT方法在数据有限的情况下能够实现未知环境下的良好泛化，轻量级微调方法以极小的参数调整达到了与全参数微调相当的性能水平。

Conclusion: Prompt-DT通过将专家经验转化为提示信息并结合物理知识与对比学习，有效解决了微电网频率控制中RL方法泛化性差的问题，为数据驱动控制策略在复杂电力系统中的应用提供了新思路。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of energy structures has positioned microgrids as pivotal components of next-generation power systems, offering enhanced resilience and renewable energy integration. However, the inherent low inertia, complex dynamics, and poor model conditions of microgrids necessitate advanced data-driven frequency control strategies. Although reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated certain potential and advantages, existing RL methods often struggle with generalization across diverse microgrid configurations and lack adaptability to unseen environments, particularly when explicit system parameters are unavailable. To address these challenges, in this paper, we introduce a novel prompt decision transformer (Prompt-DT) architecture for microgrid frequency control. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on hard-to-obtain environmental characteristic parameters, the proposed method leverages few-shot expert historical trajectories as prompts to guide autonomous perception and adaptive decision-making. In addition, we propose a context-aware training and execution mechanism utilizing self-supervised contrastive learning to enhance environment recognition and prompt utilization efficiency. In addition, a physics-informed prompt design technique that filters prompts based on cumulative reward and frequency volatility is proposed, ensuring high-quality physical guidance during online execution. Finally, to ensure generalization in unseen environments with limited data, we develop a lightweight finetuning approach that achieves performance comparable to full-parameter finetuning with minimal adjustments.

</details>


### [311] [Real-Time Transient Response Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21886)
*Anahida Kanade,Djan Tanova,Steve Conner,Taner Dosluoglu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可在现有微控制器中集成的辅助控制器方法，用于电机控制的实时人工智能部署。该方案在weeteq电机控制集成电路上实现并通过实验室测试，能在100微秒至1毫秒的模型推理周期内提供100%的实时数据覆盖，动态负载下系统响应误差最多降低68%。同时引入了一种基于主成分变换的新型关键绩效指标，用于量化瞬态响应的改善程度，并将动态事件以高压缩向量形式在毫秒级分辨率下记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电机控制系统中部署人工智能应用需要满足实时性要求，而现有方案往往无法在微控制器限制下实现完整的无监督部署。此外，传统基于IoT传感器时间序列数据的设备健康监测方案在时间分辨率和数据压缩方面存在局限，无法实现系统级的有效优化。

Method: 提出一种可集成到现有微控制器的辅助控制器方法，在weeteq电机控制集成电路上实现完整的无监督电机控制部署方案。采用主成分变换构建新型关键绩效指标，用于量化瞬态响应改善、稳定性评估及回归模型输出的迭代改进。系统以毫秒级分辨率检测动态事件，并将其记录为高度压缩的向量，代表系统响应相对于线性稳态条件的偏差。

Result: 该方案在控制回路采样率和模型推理周期（100微秒至1毫秒）内提供100%的实时数据覆盖，在动态负载下实现高达68%的系统响应误差降低。新引入的关键绩效指标能够量化瞬态响应改善程度，动态事件检测达到毫秒级分辨率。

Conclusion: 该辅助控制器方法展示了在微控制器内实现实时AI电机控制部署的可行性，其毫秒级分辨率和向量数据精度将实现传统IoT传感器时间序列方案无法达到的系统级优化水平，为设备健康监测提供了新层次的可能性。

Abstract: Use of artificial intelligence in motor control applications that can be deployed within the microcontrollers need to comply with real-time demands of motor control systems. A supplementary controller approach that can be integrated within existing microcontrollers is presented. The proposed approach is implemented on a weeteq motor control integrated circuit and tested in the lab. A complete unsupervised motor control deployment solution was developed, and the real-time system response correction demonstrated under dynamic loads measured with and without the supplementary controller. The solution provides 100% coverage of real-time data at control loop sample rate and model inference period between 100usec and 1msec. The importance of latency for reduction of dynamic regulation margin during transient response is demonstrated with up to 68% reduction of the system response error. A novel key performance indicator based on principal components transform is introduced that provides a quantitative figure of merit for improvement of the transient response, in terms of the dynamic regulation margin, stability considerations and iterative improvements of consecutive regression model outputs. The significant events related to dynamic changes in the equipment and external operating conditions are detected at milliseconds resolution and recorded as highly compressed vectors representing deviation of the system response from linear steady state conditions. The resolution in time and accuracy of this vector data will enable a new level of system level optimisation that has not been possible using the time series data from IoT sensors in current equipment health monitoring solutions.

</details>


### [312] [Impacts of Heterogeneous Grid-Forming Devices on Power System Dynamics Quantified by DW Shells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21984)
*Liangxiao Luo,Linbin Huang,Hangyu Chen,Ruohan Leng,Zhixian Hou,Kehao Zhuang,Huanhai Xin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种去中心化、可扩展的稳定性分析方法，用于分析同时包含构网型（GFM）和跟网型（GFL）变流器的电力系统动态稳定性。通过Davis-Wielandt（DW）壳刻画变流器与电网的动力学特性，并利用局部无源性和虚轴指标简洁描述GFM变流器特性，无需其详细参数或控制方案，从而实现大规模系统的简化稳定性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构GFM设备（储能、风电、HVDC等）对电力系统动态的影响难以分析和量化，尤其是GFM与GFL变流器之间的复杂交互作用，现有方法面临可扩展性和参数依赖性的挑战。

Method: 采用Davis-Wielandt（DW）壳来表征GFM/GFL变流器及电网的动力学特性；解析推导了集成异构GFM变流器如何影响电网DW壳及系统稳定性；定义了GFM变流器的局部无源性和虚轴指标，这些指标可通过测试方便获取，无需详细参数或控制方案。

Result: 所提方法实现了去中心化、可扩展的稳定性分析，避免了对GFM变流器详细参数的依赖，显著简化了大规模电力系统的稳定性分析与计算。

Conclusion: 通过DW壳和两个局部指标，该研究为含异构GFM与GFL变流器的电力系统提供了简洁且可扩展的稳定性分析框架，对实际工程应用具有重要价值。

Abstract: The concept of grid-forming (GFM) converters has gained great attention in the past years. However, it remains challenging to analyze and quantify the impacts of heterogeneous GFM devices (e.g., GFM energy storage systems, GFM wind turbines, GFM HVDC stations) on power system dynamics, especially when taking into account the complex interaction between GFM converters and grid-following (GFL) converters. To this end, this paper focuses on the decentralized and scalable stability analysis of power systems containing both GFM and GFL converters, where we use Davis-Wielandt (DW) shells to characterize the dynamics of the converters and the power grid. In particular, we analytically derive how integrating heterogeneous GFM converters affects the DW shell of the power grid and therefore the system stability. Our approach does not require the detailed parameters or control schemes of the GFM converters; instead, we define the local passivity and imaginary-axis indices of GFM converters to compactly describe their characteristics. These two indices can be conveniently obtained by testing a GFM converter and greatly simplify the stability analysis and computation when handling large-scale power systems.

</details>


### [313] [A 2D Axisymmetric Multi-Domain DC Arc Model for Simulink Implementation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22200)
*Vinod Kumar Maddineni,Rahul Reddy Devarapally,Nihar Panchal,NagaBabu Koganti,Addisalem Kokob W.,Praveen Damacharla*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种耦合多域框架用于模拟直流电弧，通过简化磁流体动力学(MHD)方程推导出二维轴对称模型，并在MATLAB/Simulink中实现。该模型捕获了壁稳弧柱内温度、流体速度和磁场的时空演化，在10A至1500A电流范围内模拟显示显著径向温度梯度，且能准确复现经典逆电流-电压特性，瞬态分析确认毫秒级电压稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直流电弧广泛应用于电路断路器、焊接技术和等离子体应用等领域，但其涉及热、流体动力学和电磁等多物理场耦合，复杂难以精确建模。现有模型往往局限于单一物理域或计算成本过高，缺乏一种兼具准确性和可访问性的系统级仿真工具。

Method: 作者推导了一个二维轴对称模型，通过简化MHD方程将热、流体和电磁现象耦合到一个统一的框架中，并在MATLAB/Simulink中实现该模型，用于模拟壁稳电弧柱内温度、流体速度和磁场的时空演化。

Result: 模型在10A到1500A电流范围内展示了显著径向温度梯度（中心轴峰值和外围快速衰减）；通过与既有物理范式对标验证了速度和磁场模拟的准确性；准确复现了经典模型的逆电流-电压特性；瞬态分析确认了毫秒级电压稳定。

Conclusion: 该可访问的计算模型为研究直流电弧动力学提供了稳健基础，并有助于先进断路器、焊接技术和等离子体应用的系统级仿真。

Abstract: This study introduces a coupled multi-domain framework to simulate direct current (DC) arcs, integrating thermal, fluid dynamic, and electromagnetic phenomena. We derive a two-dimensional (2D) axisymmetric model by simplifying the magneto-hydrodynamics (MHD) equations and implement it in MATLAB/Simulink. The model captures the spatiotemporal evolution of temperature, fluid velocity, and magnetic fields within a wall-stabilized arc column. Simulations across a 10 A to 1500 A current range show a pronounced radial temperature gradient, with central axis peaks and rapid peripheral decay. The approach's accuracy is validated by aligning the simulated velocity and magnetic fields with established physical paradigms. Additionally, the model accurately reproduces the inverse current-voltage characteristics observed in classical models and empirical studies, while transient analyses confirm rapid millisecond-scale voltage stabilization. This accessible computational model provides a robust foundation for investigating DC arc dynamics and facilitates system-level simulations for advanced circuit breakers, welding technologies, and plasma applications.

</details>


### [314] [Event-Driven Simulation of Power Electronics Rich Grid Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22226)
*Ajay Pratap Yadav,James Nutaro*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向电力电子系统的事件驱动电磁暂态（EMT）仿真架构，采用原生C内核与Python编排，将系统视为具有分段连续状态的开关/不连续系统，围绕事件、开关拓扑和拓扑区间组织仿真，而非仅依赖连续时间求解器来处理不连续点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力电子系统天然具有开关和不连续性，其数学结构是分段连续的。传统仿真方法主要围绕连续时间求解器，事后对不连续点进行修正或平滑处理，这种方式不符合系统的自然数学结构，导致仿真效率和准确性受限。

Method: 提出一种简单的事件驱动EMT架构：使用原生C内核执行核心计算（保证性能），以Python进行上层编排（保证灵活性和易用性）。仿真围绕事件、开关拓扑和拓扑区间来组织，将离散事件仿真的成熟思想应用于电力电子电路仿真。

Result: 成功实现了事件驱动的EMT仿真架构，能够按系统的自然结构处理开关与不连续性问题，并为将离散事件仿真领域的成熟方法应用于电力电子电路仿真指明了研究方向。

Conclusion: 电力电子仿真应顺应系统固有的切换和不连续性数学结构，采用事件驱动方式组织仿真流程。该工作为离散事件仿真思想在电力电子仿真中的广泛应用开辟了研究前景。

Abstract: Power-electronics systems should be treated according to their natural mathematical structure---inherent switching and discontinuities with piecewise continuous states. Therefore, the simulator should be organized around events, switching topologies, and topology intervals, rather than only around a continuous-time solver that later corrects or smooths discontinuities. This paper presents a simple, event-driven EMT architecture using native C kernels with Python orchestration. With this method, we distill the essential elements of discrete-event simulation applied to power electronics problems and thereby point toward a broad research thrust wherein mature ideas from discrete-event simulation are adapted for use in simulating power electronics circuits.

</details>


### [315] [Grid-Constrained State-Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization: A Discrete and Efficient Heuristic Solver for Precise Harmonic Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22391)
*Guangze Chen,Zhenbin Zhang,Yafei Yin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向电网约束的状态自适应粒子群优化（GCSA-PSO）策略，用于解决谐波编程脉宽调制（HPPWM）在有限定时器分辨率下的最优性偏差问题。该方法在离散解空间中直接搜索可执行的脉冲序列，并通过状态自适应评估策略提高计算效率，实验证明其在计算时间和控制精度上均优于经典方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HPPWM方法大多在连续空间中求解，忽略了实际数字控制器有限的定时器分辨率，导致部署时出现最优性偏差。这促使作者提出一种能匹配实际定时器约束的离散空间优化方法。

Method: 提出GCSA-PSO策略：1）将解空间与实际定时器约束匹配，在离散解空间中直接搜索可实现脉冲序列；2）开发状态自适应评估策略，根据粒子状态分配不同代价评估，避免不必要的计算。

Result: 实验数据表明，与经典方法相比，本文方法在实际数字控制器部署下减少了计算时间，同时实现了更高的控制精度。

Conclusion: GCSA-PSO通过离散解空间搜索和状态自适应评估，有效解决了HPPWM在实际数字控制器部署中的最优性偏差问题，在计算效率和控制精度上均取得改进。

Abstract: Harmonic programmed pulse width modulation (HPPWM), offering flexible harmonic regulation, is a promising solution for high-power energy conversion systems. However, most existing methods solve HPPWM in a continuous space while ignoring the finite timer resolution of practical digital controllers. This leads to a potential optimality deviation during deployment. Motivated by this, this paper proposes a Grid-Constrained State-Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization (GCSA-PSO) strategy. By matching the solution space with practical timer constraints, GCSA-PSO directly searches for implementable pulse sequences in the discrete solution space, thereby improving deployment consistency while reducing the search burden. Moreover, a state-adaptive evaluation strategy is developed to assign different cost evaluations according to particle states, avoiding unnecessary evaluations and improving computational efficiency. Experimental data confirm that, compared with the classical method, the proposed method reduces the computational time while achieving higher control accuracy under practical digital-controller deployment.

</details>


### [316] [A Simple and Extremely Efficient Predictive Control for Power Converters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22416)
*Guangze Chen,Zhenbin Zhang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需枚举的高效预测控制技术，通过可视化映射直接选择最优电压矢量，在保持与传统FCS-MPC相同控制性能的同时，计算负担最高可降低88%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统有限控制集模型预测控制(FCS-MPC)虽然简单有效，但需要大量枚举运算，导致计算负载高、硬件成本高。

Method: 通过重新排列代价函数并结合简单拟合定律，构建确定性的可视化映射图，直接选取最优矢量，完全避免枚举搜索过程。

Result: 在实验室搭建的功率变换器和商用低成本数字控制器上验证，实现了与传统MPC相同的控制性能，计算负担降低高达88%（两级变换器一步预测场景）。

Conclusion: 该方法在保持控制性能的前提下极大地降低了计算开销和硬件成本，为功率变换器预测控制提供了一种高效实用的新方案。

Abstract: Classical finite control set based model predictive control (FCS-MPC) reduces the optimal problems to an enumerated searching algorithm, which is very simple and effective to control power converters. However, it requires a large amount of enumeration operations, increasing its computational load and hardware costs. In this work, we propose a new and simple predictive control technique with extreme efficiency. The proposal directly selects the optimal vector via determined visual maps, abstained solely requiring a rearrangement of the cost function and a simple fitting law, without any enumeration. It has been validated under a lab-constructed power converter and a set of commercialized low-cost digital controllers. Experimental data confirm that the proposal achieves the same control performance as classical MPC, with significant computational burden reduction (up to 88\% for one-step prediction of two-level converters)

</details>


### [317] [Joint pricing and matching for dynamic high-capacity ride-sharing considering passengers' choice uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22440)
*Wang Chen,Xinglu Liu,Kaihang Zhang,Hongzheng Shi,Jintao Ke*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了动态高容量网约车共享服务中考虑不确定性的联合定价与匹配问题。将该问题建模为两阶段随机规划，并提出了基于松弛的梯度下降引导搜索算法，通过场景缩减大幅提升计算效率（加速数千倍，最优性差距不超过1.1%）。真实数据模拟表明，该方法相比基线可平均提升营收5.2%和服务率8.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在网约车共享服务中，乘客对价格敏感且其接受报价的行为具有不确定性，这给平台的定价与匹配决策带来了挑战。现有研究往往忽视乘客选择的不确定性，可能导致次优的定价和匹配策略，从而影响平台收益与服务效率。

Method: 将问题建模为两阶段随机规划：第一阶段优化乘客的前置价格决策，第二阶段作为补偿问题处理基于乘客不确定选择的车-客分配。提出一种基于松弛的梯度下降引导搜索算法，利用问题结构特性：先通过松弛生成第一阶段可行解，再借助梯度信息迭代改进；在梯度计算时采用场景缩减技术剔除不必要场景以降低计算负担。

Result: 数值实验表明，与直接求解随机规划相比，所提算法可加速数千倍计算速度，且最优性差距不超过1.1%。基于两个大城市的真实数据集和路网的大规模仿真验证了考虑乘客选择不确定性的益处：平均可提升营收5.2%和服务率8.2%。

Conclusion: 本文为网约车平台设计考虑乘客选择不确定性的定价策略提供了有效的算法框架，在保证高质量解的同时大幅降低计算成本，有助于提升共享出行的服务效率和平台收益。

Abstract: This work investigates the uncertainty-aware joint pricing and matching problem for dynamic high-capacity ride-sharing services, where passengers are assumed to be price-elastic and decide whether to accept a ride-sharing offer based on the upfront prices provided by the platform. We formulate the studied problem as a two-stage stochastic program, where the first stage optimizes upfront price decisions for passengers, and the second-stage recourse problem captures passenger-vehicle assignment based on passengers' uncertain choices. To enhance computational efficiency, we introduce a novel relaxation-based gradient descent-guided search algorithm that leverages the problem's structural properties. Initially, the algorithm generates a feasible solution for the first-stage problem via relaxation. It then iteratively improves the solution via a search process guided by the derived gradient information. In particular, scenario reduction is applied to eliminate unnecessary scenarios when calculating the gradient, thereby reducing the overall computational burden. Numerical experiments demonstrate that, compared to solving the stochastic program directly, the proposed algorithm can accelerate computation speed by thousands of times while achieving optimality gaps of no more than 1.1%. Finally, we validate the benefits of considering passengers' choice uncertainty through large-scale simulation using real-world datasets and road networks over two large cities. The results demonstrate that, on average, the proposed method can increase the revenue by 5.2% and the service rate by 8.2% compared to the baseline approaches. This study provides a valuable reference for transportation network companies to design pricing strategies for ride-sharing to enhance service efficiency and improve revenue.

</details>


### [318] [Certifiable Explicit Model Predictive Control for Spacecraft Rendezvous under Bounded Disturbances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22458)
*Diogo Silva,Daniel Silvestre*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种完整的航天器交会控制管线，结合显式模型预测控制（显式MPC）与非凸可达性分析，克服了传统优化控制方法在在线计算时间和闭环保证方面的局限。通过参数化求解器和高效数据结构，在51步预测时域下，控制律仅占用10.5 MB内存、评估时间低于300纳秒，可在CubeSat级别的嵌入式硬件上运行，并可通过混合zonotope可达性分析获得离线闭环稳定性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于优化的控制器（如MPC）在航天应用中存在两大限制：一是在线计算时间不确定且可能超过采样周期；二是闭环行为缺乏形式化保证。显式MPC虽可解决在线计算问题，但因其区域数量随预测时域呈指数增长，被认为仅适用于小时域场景，这严重限制了其在航天交会任务中的实际应用。

Method: 本文方法包括三部分：(1) 基于Clohessy-Wiltshire动力学构建航天器交会问题的显式MPC参数化解，利用QP的参数化求解方法生成分段仿射控制律；(2) 设计高效的数据结构对控制律进行编码，在计算时间和内存占用两方面同时优化；(3) 利用混合zonotope（hybrid zonotopes）进行非凸可达性分析，在离线阶段验证闭环系统的稳定性并给出形式化保证。

Result: 在51步预测时域下，所构建的交会控制律占用内存仅10.5 MB，单次评估时间低于300纳秒。该内存占用可适配ARM9级处理器（如CubeSat常用的AT91RM9200），验证了即使在长预测时域下，使用本文提出的参数化求解器和数据结构构建的分区显式MPC依然具有实际可行性。

Conclusion: 本文通过结合参数化QP求解、高效数据编码和非凸可达性验证，推翻了显式MPC仅适用于短预测时域的传统认知，证明了在航天器交会这类特定应用中，长时域显式MPC不仅可行，而且兼具计算实时性与形式化稳定性保证，为航天嵌入式系统的安全控制提供了实用管线。

Abstract: Two properties of optimization-based controllers such as model predictive control (MPC) limit their use in space flight. The online computing time varies and can exceed the sampling period, and the closed-loop behavior carries no formal guarantee. Explicit MPC, where a parametric solution of the optimization problem is computed, replaces the on-board optimization with a lookup table of piecewise-affine functions with a fixed execution time. However, it has been regarded as only applicable to small horizons, since the number of regions bounds the memory the table occupies and admits only an exponential bound in the horizon. This paper builds on recent developments in parametric solutions of quadratic programs and nonconvex reachability analysis to provide an entire pipeline for spacecraft rendezvous controllers under the Clohessy-Wiltshire dynamics. For this application, efficient data structures can be constructed to encode the control law, both from a computing time and a memory standpoint. In addition, the controller can be verified offline with a guaranteed closed-loop stability certificate by resorting to reachability analysis with hybrid zonotopes. At a 51-step horizon the rendezvous law occupies 10.5 MB and is evaluated in under 300 ns. The occupied memory would fit for instance the CubeSat flight computer ARM9-class AT91RM9200 meaning that the horizon limitation does not hold when the partition is built with the parametric solvers and data structures shown in this paper.

</details>


### [319] [A Novel Open Phase Detection Method with Synchronized Phasors for Distribution Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22466)
*Jinlei Xing,Longhua Mu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于两点连接阻抗的开相检测新方法，利用同步相量计算连接阻抗，通过正序阻抗异常增大且符号为负的特征来检测开相事件，适用于闭环馈线或含DER的配电网，不受回馈影响，仅需点对点通信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开相检测是电力公司面临的未解挑战，传统基于电流或电压不平衡的方法存在保护范围有限、或因回馈导致电压重建而失效等问题，特别是在复杂多分支馈线场景下，亟需更可靠的方法。

Method: 提出基于两个测量点连接阻抗的开相检测方法，利用同步相量计算连接的正序阻抗。当发生内部开相时，计算出的正序阻抗远大于其他工况下的阻抗，且符号为负，以此作为检测判据。该方法仅需点对点通信，无需额外硬件。

Result: 该方法适用于闭环馈线配置或负荷侧连接DER单元的场景，几乎不受回馈影响，可直接部署于现有重合器控制器或RTU中，具有可扩展、成本效益高且可靠性好的特点。

Conclusion: 所提出的连接阻抗法有效克服了传统电流/电压法在开相检测中的局限性，为配电网开相断线（防山火）提供了更可靠、经济的检测方案。

Abstract: An effective open phase detection is one of the unsolved challenges for utilities. Open phase detection is expected to detect the broken power line before it falls to the ground, to prevent the ignition of wildfires. The existing open phase detection methods are normally based on abnormal currents or voltages due to three phase unbalances after open phase events. For a complicated distribution feeder with multiple branches, current-based methods usually have a limited protection range, and voltage-based methods possibly failed due to the recreated voltage on the open phase due to back-feed. This paper presents a new open phase detection method based on the connection impedance of two measuring points, which is calculated with the synchronized phasors. Under an internal open phase condition, the calculated positive-sequence impedance is much larger than the impedance under other conditions, and its sign is negative. This new method is applicable for a distribution feeder with a closed-loop configuration, or DER units connected at the load side. It is almost not impacted by back-feed. This new method only requires point-to-point communication. This method can be easily implemented in the existing recloser controllers or RTUs. It is scalable, cost effective, and reliable.

</details>


### [320] [Optimal TRACON Descent Procedures under Wind Uncertainty and Fuel Savings Factors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22480)
*Yutian Pang,John-Paul Clarke*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出连续下降延迟减速进近（CDDA），将延迟减速应用于无平飞段的连续下降进近（CDA）剖面。通过基于仿真的随机优化，在满足稳定进近概率约束下最小化期望燃油消耗，针对A319、B737-800、B767-400和A340-300四种机型，在3.00°、3.50°和3.77°三种最终下滑角下进行优化比较。结果表明减速架构影响最弱（0.3-3.9%），下滑角是燃油节省的主导因素（11-21%），襟翼调度优化可额外增加2-17%的节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端区下降程序需在风况气候学范围内而非单一风况下执行。既有延迟减速进近（DDA）虽在飞行演示中显示显著节油效果，但其将晚减速与更陡的3.77°最终下降结合，模糊了各设计选择的单独贡献，需要通过解耦来明确各自作用。

Method: 提出CDDA方法：将延迟减速应用于无下滑道截获前平飞段的连续下降进近剖面。采用基于仿真的随机优化，优化襟翼展开触发速度和下滑道截获距离，以最小化风不确定性下的期望燃油，同时满足给定的稳定进近概率。通过最优控制降维将设计空间限制为数百个候选方案，并在加权风网格上使用六自由度快速时间仿真进行精确期望计算。在匹配的最终角度下对四种机型进行优化。

Result: 减速架构是最弱因素，在3.50°下仅节省0.3-3.9%，仅在B767-400的3.77°下变得显著。下滑角主导节油效果：在3.50°类别D设计最大值下，优化CDDA相对优化3° CDA可减少11-21%期望燃油，襟翼调度优化额外增加2-17%。DDA平飞段主要作为尾风鲁棒性缓冲，而3.77°最终段超过1000 ft/min稳定进近下沉率指标，限制其近期运行适用性。

Conclusion: 延迟减速架构本身的节油贡献有限，节油主要来源于更陡的下滑角。DDA平飞段的作用是提供尾风鲁棒性而非节油。3.77°陡下降角不符合现有稳定进近下沉率标准，近期实际运行可行性受限。未来应关注在符合运行约束下通过更陡下滑角与优化襟翼调度实现节油。

Abstract: A terminal-area descent procedure need to perform across the wind climatology rather than a single wind condition. Although flight demonstrations of the delayed deceleration approach (DDA) showed substantial fuel savings, DDA combined late deceleration with a steeper $3.77^\circ$ final descent, obscuring the contribution of each design choice. In this work, we propose the continuous-descent delayed deceleration approach (CDDA), which applies delayed deceleration to a continuous descent approach (CDA) profile without a level segment before glideslope intercept. A simulation-based stochastic optimization selects flap deployment trigger speeds and glideslope-capture distance to minimize expected fuel under wind uncertainty subject to a given stabilized-approach probability. An optimal control reduction limits the design space to a few hundred candidates, enabling exact expectation over a weighted wind grid using six-degree-of-freedom fast-time simulations. CDA and CDDA are optimized at matched final angles of $3.00^\circ$, $3.50^\circ$, and $3.77^\circ$ for the A319, B737-800, B767-400, and A340-300. Results show that deceleration architecture is the weakest factor, yielding 0.3--3.9\% savings at $3.50^\circ$ and becoming material only for the B767-400 at $3.77^\circ$. Glideslope angle dominates fuel saving. At the $3.50^\circ$ Category D design maximum, optimized CDDA reduces expected fuel by 11-21\% relative to optimized $3^\circ$ CDA, while flap-schedule optimization adds 2-17\%. The DDA level segment acts primarily as a tailwind-robustness buffer, and the $3.77^\circ$ final exceeds the 1,000 ft/min stabilized-approach sink-rate element, limiting its near-term operational applicability.

</details>


### [321] [Robust Model Reference Adaptive Control with Combined Adaptation under Finite Excitation Condition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22562)
*Manish Patel,Arnab Maity*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对多输入多输出非线性系统（含未知对角控制有效性矩阵和有界非参数不确定性），提出了一种基于修正Gram-Schmidt正交化过程构造记忆项的算法。在有限激励条件下，该记忆项使参数估计误差动态中的系数矩阵为单位阵，从而消除了时变自适应增益的需求，给出了显式的参数估计误差最终界，并使闭环跟踪误差和估计误差指数衰减到原点邻域，且衰减率仅取决于用户定义的增益和系统常数，与回归器激励水平无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应控制中，参数收敛通常需要持续激励条件，但该条件依赖未来数据，在线无法保证。现有的基于记忆的参数更新律（如同步学习、记忆回归器扩展、DREM）虽能在有限激励条件下实现参数收敛，但其收敛速率依赖于回归器的激励水平，这是一个关键局限。因此需要一种消除该依赖的新方法。

Method: 提出一种新算法，通过修正Gram-Schmidt正交化过程构造记忆项，应用于一类具有未知对角控制有效性矩阵和有界非参数不确定性的多输入多输出非线性系统。在有限激励条件下，构造的记忆项使参数估计误差动力学中的系数矩阵化为单位阵。基于此，进一步设计了组合自适应律用于控制器增益估计。

Result: 该单位系数矩阵消除了时变自适应增益的需求，提供了参数估计误差的显式最终界，并保持非参数不确定性界的结构。闭环跟踪和估计误差指数衰减到原点邻域，衰减率仅由用户设定增益和系统常数决定，与回归器激励水平无关。

Conclusion: 该方法成功消除了收敛速率对回归器激励水平的依赖，克服了现有方法（如同步学习、记忆回归器扩展、DREM）的关键局限，在有限激励条件下实现了更优的可验证参数收敛性能。

Abstract: In adaptive control, parametric uncertainties in linear-in-parameter form consist of unknown parameters and known regressor signals. Convergence of the unknown parameters to their ideal values requires the regressor to satisfy a persistent excitation (PE) condition, which depends on future data and is therefore infeasible to guarantee online. Memory-based parameter update laws address this by enabling ideal parameter convergence under the online-verifiable finite excitation (FE) condition. In this paper, a new algorithm is proposed to construct a memory term via the Modified Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization procedure for a class of multi-input multi-output nonlinear systems with an unknown diagonal control effectiveness matrix and bounded nonparametric uncertainties. Under the finite excitation condition, the constructed memory term yields an identity coefficient matrix in the parameter estimation error dynamics. The identity coefficient matrix eliminates the need for time-varying adaptation gains, enables an explicit ultimate bound on the parameter estimation error, and preserves the structure of the nonparametric uncertainty bound under the memory term. Building on this, a combined adaptation law is developed for controller gain estimation under FE. The closed-loop tracking and estimation errors are shown to decay exponentially to a neighborhood of the origin, characterized by an explicit ultimate bound, with a decay rate that depends solely on user-defined gains and system constants, independent of the level of regressor excitation. This removes the dependence of the convergence rate on the level of regressor excitation, a key limitation of existing approaches such as concurrent learning, memory regressor extension, and DREM.

</details>


### [322] [Integrating Prognostics, Maintenance, and Tail Assignment under Remaining Useful Life Uncertainty: A Stochastic Optimisation Approach for Airline Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22569)
*Benno Käslin,Marta Ribeiro,Dimitrios Zarouchas,Manuel Arias Chao*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一优化框架，联合集成飞机尾号分配(TA)、维修调度(MS)和预测性维护(PdM)，在剩余使用寿命(RUL)预测存在不确定性的情况下进行决策。该问题被建模为随机混合整数线性规划，并通过神经网络代理来近似RUL不确定性导致的期望中断成本，从而实现可扩展的求解。基于真实航空公司数据的实验表明，与确定性和顺序方法相比，该联合规划方法在适度增加规划成本的前提下，显著降低了运营风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空公司运营中维修与机队调度需要明确考虑RUL预测的不确定性，但当前TA和MS通常被分开或顺序优化，未能有效利用预测性健康信息，且两者之间存在强相互依赖关系，这限制了对预测信息的有效利用。

Method: 将问题建模为随机混合整数线性规划，联合优化TA、MS和PdM；开发可扩展求解方法，通过嵌入神经网络代理来近似RUL不确定性导致的期望中断成本。

Result: 使用真实航空公司数据构建的运营场景进行评估，结果显示显式纳入预测性不确定性的联合规划模型相比确定性和顺序方法，降低了运营风险（下游中断成本和航班取消），但规划成本有适度增加。

Conclusion: 研究强调了将预测性维护与运营规划紧密耦合的价值，并展示了代理辅助随机优化在可扩展的不确定性感知航空公司决策中的潜力。

Abstract: Ensuring reliability, safety, and economic efficiency in airline operations requires maintenance and fleet scheduling strategies that explicitly account for uncertainty in Remaining Useful Life (RUL) predictions. However, the integration of prognostic uncertainty into operational decision-making remains a major challenge. In practice, tail assignment (TA) and maintenance scheduling (MS) are typically optimized separately or sequentially, thereby limiting the effective use of predictive health information despite their strong interdependencies. This paper proposes a unified optimisation framework that jointly integrates TA, MS, and predictive maintenance (PdM) under RUL with confidence intervals. The problem is formulated as a stochastic mixed-integer linear program, and a scalable solution approach is developed by embedding a neural network surrogate to approximate expected disruption costs resulting from RUL uncertainty. The proposed framework is evaluated using operational scenarios derived from real-world airline data. Results show that explicitly incorporating prognostic uncertainty in a joint planning model reduces operational risk, i.e., downstream disruption costs and flight cancellations, compared to deterministic and sequential approaches, at the expense of moderate increases in planning cost. These findings highlight the value of tightly coupling predictive maintenance with operational planning and demonstrate the potential of surrogate-assisted stochastic optimisation for scalable, uncertainty-aware airline decision-making.

</details>


### [323] [Scaling-Based Reciprocal Control Barrier Functions for Nonholonomic Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22633)
*Tianyu Han,Bo Wang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对力控非完整移动机器人在位置级避障中面临的相对阶为二的安全约束，提出了一种基于缩放的倒数障碍函数（CBF）构造方法，通过将正的运动相关缩放因子置于原始物理安全函数对应的倒数障碍分子中，使屏障精确地定义在物理安全集内部并在边界处奇异，从而在保留原始安全集内域认证的同时恢复一阶控制权限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非完整移动机器人的位置级避障安全约束通常具有相对阶为二的性质，传统CBF方法无法直接应用于这种高阶相对阶约束，需要探索新的屏障函数构造方式来保证安全集的正面不变性。

Method: 提出一种缩放型倒数障碍构造方法：在原始物理安全函数对应的倒数障碍分子上放置一个正的与运动相关的缩放因子，使构造出的屏障函数恰好定义在物理安全集内部、在其边界处出现奇异，从而既保留了原始安全约束的认证内域，又恢复了一阶控制权限。

Result: 在力控非完整机器人模型下推导了该构造构成倒数CBF的充分条件，证明满足所诱导倒数CBF条件的控制器可使物理安全集的内部保持前向不变性；并通过标量严格反馈系统提供了更高相对阶级联的结构性解释；数值仿真验证了诱导安全集几何及其与基于优化的避障控制框架的集成效果。

Conclusion: 该缩放型倒数CBF构造为处理相对阶二的高阶安全约束提供了一种有效且结构清晰的方法，能够在不损失安全集内域的前提下恢复一阶控制权限，适用于力控非完整移动机器人的避障控制。

Abstract: This paper studies the construction of control barrier functions (CBFs) for force-controlled nonholonomic mobile robots subject to relative-degree-two safety constraints arising from position-level obstacle avoidance. A scaling-based reciprocal barrier construction is proposed, in which a positive motion-dependent scaling factor is placed in the numerator of a reciprocal barrier associated with the original physical safety function. The resulting barrier is defined exactly on the interior of the physical safe set and becomes singular on its boundary, thereby preserving the certified interior domain of the original safety constraint while recovering first-order control authority. For a force-controlled nonholonomic robot model, sufficient conditions are derived under which the proposed construction defines a reciprocal CBF, and the interior of the physical safe set is forward invariant under controllers satisfying the induced reciprocal-CBF condition. A scalar strict-feedback system is further used to provide a structural interpretation of the underlying higher-relative-degree cascade under explicit structural assumptions. Numerical simulations demonstrate the induced safe-set geometry and its integration with an optimization-based control framework for obstacle avoidance.

</details>


### [324] [Expanding the Transient Stability Region of Attraction of Networked Grid-Interactive Inverters: A Probabilistic Active Learning Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22661)
*Zhong Liu,Jialin Zheng,Junjie Qin,Xiaonan Lu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种概率主动学习框架，结合高斯过程代理与不确定性引导的前沿搜索，通过神经Lyapunov函数与电磁暂态仿真协同，显著扩大暂态稳定边界估计，减少传统方法的保守性，在多达四台并网逆变器的测试系统中实现最多20倍的稳定区域体积扩大，且所需仿真查询次数远少于穷举评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆变器资源的大规模并网带来复杂的动态特性，使暂态稳定分析日益重要。但传统解析方法给出的稳定边界估计过于保守，限制了电网调度和运行灵活性；而现有的神经Lyapunov方法虽试图扩大边界，却受限于分布外问题，难以突破受限域。

Method: 提出概率主动学习框架：首先由神经Lyapunov函数确定确定性内部稳定区域，然后构建高斯过程替代模型，并部署不确定性引导的前沿搜索，将电磁暂态仿真与主动边界探索智能耦合，系统性地向外驱动稳定边界估计。

Result: 在多机网格形成基准测试中，该方法显著降低了估计保守性。在多达四台互连逆变器的测试系统中，认证稳定区域体积相比经典基线扩大最多20倍，而每个系统仅需最多220次时域仿真查询，远少于穷举EMT评估所需的1600次（即使最简单的单逆变器基准也需1600次）。

Conclusion: 该概率主动学习框架成功突破了神经Lyapunov方法因分布外问题导致的边界扩展瓶颈，在显著扩大稳定区域估计的同时大幅降低了仿真计算开销，为大规模逆变器并网系统的暂态稳定分析提供了高效且低保守性的新路径。

Abstract: The continuous integration of inverter-based resources makes transient stability analysis increasingly important for power system modernization, in light of the intricate dynamics arising from large-scale inverter deployment. However, analytical transient stability analysis methods consistently yield overly conservative stability boundary estimates, which constrain grid dispatch and operational flexibility. Although recent neural Lyapunov methods attempt to enlarge these stability boundaries to obtain less conservative estimates, they remain trapped within restricted domains due to the out-of-distribution problem. To break this bottleneck, this paper proposes a probabilistic active learning framework. Starting from a deterministic inner stability region certified by neural Lyapunov functions, the framework constructs a Gaussian process surrogate and deploys an uncertainty-guided frontier search. By intelligently coupling electromagnetic transient simulations with active boundary exploration, the algorithm systematically drives the estimated stability boundary outward. Comprehensive evaluations across multi-machine grid-forming benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework substantially reduces estimation conservatism. Across test systems ranging up to four interconnected grid-forming inverters, the methodology achieves up to a $20$-fold volumetric enlargement of the certified stability region over classical baselines, while requiring at most 220 time-domain simulation queries per system, far fewer than the 1,600 queries that exhaustive EMT evaluation demands even for the simplest single-inverter benchmark.

</details>


### [325] [Real-Time Edge-based Detection of Correlated AI Data-Center Load Episodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22719)
*Chandan Chaudhary,Abanish Tiwari,Yansong Pei,Mohammed Ben-Idris,Joydeep Mitra*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于相关性的检测方法，用于从跨设施的电力测量数据中分类多数据中心设施的运行状态（独立或空间相关），并通过硬件在环测试平台验证了检测性能与观测窗口长度和负荷相关时间的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数据中心在批量同步训练中会产生亚秒级的功率波动，当多个设施的训练周期同步时，负荷变化会空间相关并放大对电网的干扰。电网运营商无法访问数据中心遥测数据，必须仅从电力测量中推断这种相关性，但所需的观测时间和在变电站可部署硬件上的可检测性尚未被表征。

Method: 开发了一种基于相关性的检测方法，从跨设施功率测量中分类多设施运行状态。通过解析推导建立检测置信度与观测窗口长度及负荷相关时间的关系，并在实时硬件在环测试平台上实现：使用经验证的半马尔可夫数据中心负荷模型生成负荷设定点，应用于实时数字仿真器上的电磁暂态电网仿真，边缘设备上运行基于成对功率相关性的紧凑分类器。

Result: 跨设施相关性能够在独立实现中区分独立和相关两种情况。保持的检测准确率随观测窗口增加而提高，与预测关系一致。原始波形网络无法泛化，支持成对相关性作为判别信号。检测器在商用边缘硬件上实时运行，闭环演示能在单个观测窗口内跟踪运行状态变化。

Conclusion: 成对功率相关性是区分数据中心负荷独立与空间相关运行状态的有效判别信号，该方法可在变电站部署的边缘硬件上实时运行，并能在单观测窗口内检测状态变化，为电网运营商提供了无需数据中心遥测数据即可推断多设施相关性的可行方案。

Abstract: Artificial-intelligence data centers running bulk-synchronous training can impose sub-second power swings. When several facilities synchronize their training cycles, these load variations become spatially correlated and amplify the aggregate disturbance on the grid. A grid operator without access to data-center telemetry must infer this correlation from electrical measurements alone. However, the required observation time and the feasibility of detection on substation-deployable hardware remain uncharacterized. This paper develops a correlation-based detection method to classify the multi-facility operating regime from cross-facility power measurements. Analytical derivations and experimental validation show that the resulting detection confidence increases with the observation-window length at a rate governed by the load correlation time. The method is demonstrated in a real-time hardware-in-the-loop testbed, where load setpoints generated from a validated semi-Markov data-center load model are applied to an electromagnetic-transient grid simulation on a Real-Time Digital Simulator. A compact classifier built on pairwise power correlations runs on an edge device in this loop and determines whether the data-center load variations are independent or spatially correlated. The cross-facility correlation separates the independent and correlated cases across independent realizations. The held-out detection accuracy improves with the observation window, consistent with the predicted relation. A raw-waveform network fails to generalize, supporting pairwise correlation as the discriminative signal. The detector executes in real time on commodity edge hardware. A closed-loop demonstration against the running simulator tracks a regime change within one observation window.

</details>


### [326] [Generative Design of Liquid-Cooling Channels for Thermal Management of 2.5D and 3D Integrated Advanced Packaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22787)
*Michael Acquah,Zheng Liu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种物理引导的生成式设计框架，用于2.7 kW多芯片封装（含两个高功率GPU和一个CPU）的液冷通道拓扑优化。利用条件扩散模型生成对称通道布局，结合连通性筛选和降阶热-水力学模型评估，从5000个布局中筛选出最优设计G1016，相比常规参考拓扑分别降低了最大GPU温度33.6%、温度分布52.5%和压降72.8%，并通过OpenFOAM三维共轭传热仿真验证了结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高功率多芯片封装在有限面积内产生越来越多热量，需要越来越高效的冷却方案，传统冷却通道设计难以满足日益增长的散热需求，需要探索非常规的通道拓扑结构。

Method: 采用条件扩散模型生成对称通道布局，以最大GPU温度、GPU温度分布和压降为性能目标；对生成设计进行连通性和死端分支筛选，使用校准的降阶热-水力学模型评估，最终用全阶CFD验证。

Result: 5000个生成布局中2220个具有连续流路，229个满足最终筛选标准；最优设计G1016预测最大GPU温度70.30°C，温度分布24.90°C，压降89.72 kPa；相比参考拓扑分别降低33.6%、52.5%和72.8%；OpenFOAM验证的温度和压降误差分别为8.6%和2.6%。

Conclusion: 物理引导的生成式设计能高效发现非常规冷却通道架构，同时将昂贵的全阶CFD限制在最终验证阶段，大幅降低设计搜索成本。

Abstract: High power multi-chip packages require increasingly effective cooling as more heat is generated within a limited package area. This work presents a physics-guided generative design framework for liquid cooling channel topology optimization in a 2.7 kW multi-chip package containing two high power GPUs and one CPU. A conditional diffusion model generates symmetric channel layouts using maximum GPU temperature, GPU temperature spread, and pressure drop as performance targets. Generated designs are subjected to connectivity and dead-end-branch screening and are then evaluated using a calibrated reduced-order thermal-hydraulic model. Of 5,000 generated layouts, 2,220 contained a continuous inlet-to-outlet flow path and 229 satisfied the final topology-screening criteria. Multi-objective analysis identified G1016 as the thermally leading feasible design, with a predicted maximum GPU temperature of 70.30 °C, GPU temperature spread of 24.90 °C, and pressure drop of 89.72 kPa. Compared to a conventional reference topology, G1016 reduced the maximum GPU temperature, the temperature spread, and the pressure drop by 33.6%, 52.5%, and 72.8%, respectively. Independent three-dimensional conjugate heat-transfer simulation in OpenFOAM predicted a maximum GPU temperature of 66.70 °C and a pressure drop of 92.1 kPa, corresponding to ROM differences of approximately 8.6% in temperature rise and 2.6% in pressure drop. The results demonstrate that physics-guided generative design can efficiently discover non-conventional cooling channel architectures while limiting expensive full-order CFD to final validation.

</details>


### [327] [Leveraging UAV Autonomy for Minimum 4D Flight Authorization Volumes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23166)
*Christian Vitale,Yiannis Grigoriou,Panayiotis Kolios,Georgios Ellinas*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向U-space框架的无人机飞行授权框架，利用无人机的运动模型和控制特性生成概率性时空包络，预测未来位置并确定最小4D运行体积，从而在保证安全的前提下提高空域利用效率和授权效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市环境中无人机交通日益增长，需要U-space框架来确保安全高效运行。传统基于规则的授权策略可能过度保留空域，降低空域利用率和系统容量，因此需要更智能的授权方法。

Method: 提出一个飞行授权框架：利用自主无人机的运动模型和控制特性，生成概率性时空包络来预测未来位置（在期望置信水平内），并据此确定构成有效授权请求的最小4D运行体积（包括空间和时间维度）。

Result: 通过仿真与传统的基于规则策略进行对比，结果表明所提方法在各种任务类型中都能产生更紧凑、更高效的空域预留。

Conclusion: 仅保留必要的空域可以提高空域容量并支持多架无人机同时运行，为U-space环境下的无人机授权提供了更高效的解决方案。

Abstract: The increasing UAV traffic in urban areas has prompted the creation of U-space, an EASA framework for safe and efficient unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) operations. Within this context, this work presents a flight authorization framework that leverages autonomous UAVs, using their motion models and control characteristics to improve authorization efficiency. In the proposed framework, probabilistic spatial-temporal envelopes are generated to predict future UAV locations within a desired confidence level, and this information is then used to determine the minimum 4D operational volumes that form a valid authorization request for the mission. By reserving only the necessary airspace, the approach enhances capacity and supports simultaneous UAV operations. Simulations comparing the proposed method with a conventional rule-based strategy demonstrate consistently more compact and efficient airspace reservations across a range of mission types.

</details>


### [328] [Dynamic Inversion: An Incrementally Evolving Methodology for Flight Control Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23229)
*Daniel Milz,Gertjan Looye*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文对非线性动态逆（NDI）及其衍生形式（特别是增量NDI/INDI）进行了系统性的综述，从概念、历史、架构和数学角度梳理了各种演进形式，并为未来飞行控制系统设计提供了方法论、设计和应用层面的参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NDI已成为飞行控制律设计的标准方法，但其衍生形式INDI虽然在降低模型敏感性和复杂度方面有优势，却缺乏设计自由度且存在控制分配、扰动抑制等设计陷阱。近年来出现了混合和数学重构方法，需要一篇系统性综述来整理这些演进形式。

Method: 采用结构化综述方法，从四个方面（概念、历史、架构、数学）对NDI的各种形式进行系统性分析与对比，涵盖传统NDI、增量NDI（INDI）以及新兴的混合和数学重构方法。

Result: 系统地梳理了NDI的各种演进形式及其优缺点，明确了INDI在降低建模误差敏感性和降低控制律复杂度方面的贡献，同时指出了其在设计自由度、控制分配、扰动抑制和跨学科耦合方面的不足，以及混合和重构方法如何应对这些挑战。

Conclusion: 为未来飞行控制律开发提供了综合性的设计考量和潜在研究方向，展示了NDI家族方法从传统到增量的演进脉络及其各自适用场景。

Abstract: Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (NDI) has become a standard methodology in flight control law design. It offers an intuitive approach to decouple commanded variable responses, handle system nonlinearities, and adapt to operating conditions. NDI also comes with a well-structured architecture that reduces design effort by addressing various functional aspects in separate components, and that allows straightforward integration of extended capabilities, such as envelope protection, control saturation handling, and compensating for faults or damage. A development that has resulted in considerable renewed attention is the use of (angular) acceleration sensors to partially replace inverse model equations. Known as incremental NDI, or INDI, this development offers reduced sensitivity to modeling errors and lower control law complexity. Incremental NDI, however, lacks useful design degrees of freedom in the previously present inverse model equations and underlying feedback signal synthesis, and comes with pitfalls in design aspects like control allocation, disturbance rejection, and inter-disciplinary couplings. This has given rise to recently developed hybrid and mathematically restructured approaches. The aim of this article is to give an up-to-date, structured overview of the various evolved forms of NDI from conceptual, historical, architectural, and mathematical perspectives. It hereby intends to provide useful considerations for future flight control law developments by reviewing its various forms and potentials from methodological, design, and application points of view.

</details>


### [329] [Admissible Unit Range of Plug-and-Play Distributed Energy Resource (DER) Systems Under Delay: A Scalable Design Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23328)
*Haruhisa Ichikwa,Shinji Yokogawa,Yuusuke Kawakita,Yoshito Tobe*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对即插即用分布式能源（DER）系统的设计问题，提出Plug-in DER Orchestrated Grid (PDOG)框架和归一化分析方法，刻画了系统稳定性边界与无反向功率约束下的可行区域，揭示了系统规模与延迟之间的非单调trade-off关系，并给出了可连接DER单元数量的显式设计指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即插即用DER系统中，连接单元数量随用户操作和系统状态动态变化，而非固定配置，因此需要保证系统在较广规模范围内都满足稳定性和运行约束。现有方法难以处理这种动态规模变化的系统设计问题，亟需一个统一的归一化分析框架。

Method: 提出PDOG架构，建立基于归一化延迟和聚合环路增益的分析框架；显式刻画稳定性边界，并结合无反向功率约束推导下界，定义系统运行的可行区域；将该可行性条件映射为DER单元数量的函数，从而得到可连接单元数量的容许范围与延迟的关系。

Result: 分析揭示了核心trade-off：理论稳定性极限随归一化延迟增加而增大，但实现引起的增益放大会降低实际承载容量，导致系统规模对延迟呈非单调依赖；当超过某个可行性边界时，不存在任何可容许的系统规模。

Conclusion: 文章为延迟和实现约束下的DER单元数量确定提供了显式设计准则，确立了系统可扩展性需要被显式约束和工程设计的全新范式。

Abstract: This paper addresses the fundamental design problem of plug-and-play distributed energy resource (DER) systems, which are emerging as a scalable solution for integrating distributed generation through user-driven connection of modular units. In such systems, the number of connected units is not fixed but dynamically varies due to user operation and system conditions, requiring stability and operational constraints to be guaranteed over a range of system sizes rather than for a single configuration. To address this challenge, we propose the Plug-in DER Orchestrated Grid (PDOG) and develop a normalized analytical framework in terms of normalized delay and aggregate loop gain. This formulation enables explicit characterization of the stability boundary together with a lower bound derived from the no-reverse-power constraint, defining a feasible region for system operation. By mapping this feasibility condition into the number of DER units, the admissible range of connectable units is obtained as a function of delay. The analysis reveals a fundamental trade-off: while the theoretical stability limit increases with normalized delay, implementation-induced gain amplification reduces the practical hosting capacity. As a result, the admissible system size exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on delay, and a feasibility boundary may emerge beyond which no admissible system size exists. These results provide explicit design guidelines for determining the number of DER units under delay and implementation constraints, establishing a new paradigm in which system scalability is explicitly constrained and engineered.

</details>


### [330] [Artificial intelligence-based predictive fuel blending control for flare gas mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23337)
*Josip Kir Hromatko,Šandor Ileš,Rube Huljev,Velibor Vučković*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合人工智能与模型预测控制的燃料混合算法。研究基于物理定律和现场数据对燃气发电厂进行建模，利用神经网络计算燃料的甲烷值并确定混合比例限制，再由模型预测控制器调整最终混合比例，以满足安全要求并最小化运营成本。仿真测试表明该算法能同时降低运营成本和放空量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 燃气发电厂需要将不同来源的天然气进行混合调配，以确保燃料的甲烷值满足发动机制造商的规格要求。传统的燃料混合方法可能无法在保证安全性的同时实现成本最优，因此需要一种智能化的混合控制算法来平衡安全约束与经济性目标。

Method: 1) 基于物理定律和现场测量数据建立燃气发电厂的数学模型；2) 使用神经网络计算燃料的甲烷值，并据此确定燃料混合比例的上下限；3) 采用模型预测控制器（MPC）动态调整最终混合比例，在满足发动机安全要求的前提下最小化运营成本。

Result: 算法在多种仿真场景下进行了测试，结果显示运营成本和放空量均有所下降。

Conclusion: 所提出的AI与MPC结合的燃料混合算法能够有效提升燃气发电厂的运行经济性，同时保障燃料安全要求，减少放空造成的资源浪费和环境问题。

Abstract: This paper describes a fuel blending algorithm based on artificial intelligence and model predictive control. A gas-fired power plant was modeled using physical laws and on-site measurements. A neural network is used to calculate the methane number of the fuel and determine the fuel blending ratio limits so that the methane number is within the limits specified by the engine manufacturer. A model predictive controller adjusts the final blending ratio to meet safety requirements and minimize operating costs. The algorithm was tested in simulations with different scenarios and a reduction in both the operating costs and amount of flaring was observed.

</details>


### [331] [Data-Driven Synthesis of Robust Positively Invariant Sets: From State Feedback to Output Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23412)
*Zhijie Ning*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种直接数据驱动框架，用于在未知线性时不变系统中综合鲁棒正不变（RPI）集。该方法在状态反馈和基于观测器的输出反馈两种场景下，直接从含噪离线数据中通过求解半定规划（SDP）来合成反馈增益、观测器增益以及相应的椭球RPI集，避免了中间模型辨识或显式模型不确定性集的构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RPI集综合方法通常依赖于已知的系统模型或需要先进行系统辨识，再构造模型不确定性集，这一过程会引入保守性并累积误差。本文旨在开发一种无需中间模型辨识的直接数据驱动方法，以简化流程并提升RPI集合成的准确性。

Method: 在状态反馈情形下，首先计算线性二次（LQ）型反馈增益，随后为闭环动态合成椭球RPI集。在基于观测器的输出反馈情形下，利用离线数据通过增广状态公式计算观测器增益及相应的系统状态RPI集。两种场景均通过求解SDP实现，且避免显式构造和传播中间模型不确定性集。

Result: 数值算例验证了所提出方法的有效性，表明该方法能够在两种控制场景下成功从含噪数据中直接合成RPI集。

Conclusion: 本文提出的直接数据驱动框架为未知LTI系统的RPI集综合提供了一种统一的解决方案，简化了设计流程，避免了模型不确定性集构造带来的保守性，并适用于状态反馈和输出反馈两种重要控制场景。

Abstract: This paper develops a direct data-driven framework for robust positively invariant (RPI) set synthesis for unknown linear time-invariant systems under state-feedback and observer-based output-feedback scenarios. The feedback and observer gains, along with the RPI sets, are directly synthesized from noisy offline data by solving semidefinite programs (SDPs), avoiding intermediate model identification or explicit model-uncertainty set construction. In the state-feedback case, a linear-quadratic (LQ)-type feedback gain is first computed, and an ellipsoidal RPI set is then synthesized for the resulting closed-loop dynamics. In the observer-based output-feedback case, offline data are used to compute the observer gain and the corresponding RPI set for the system state through an augmented-state formulation. This design provides a unified method for invariant-set computation in both scenarios, and the direct data-driven formulation avoids the explicit construction and propagation of an intermediate model-uncertainty set. Numerical examples illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [332] [Graph-Native Attention Acceleration for Attack Detection in Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23414)
*Zhenan Feng,Ehsan Nekouei*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出GraphGHHA，一种图原生注意力加速层，用于替代CPS攻击检测单元中的图注意力层。它结合图局部稀疏注意力分支（受邻接矩阵约束）和全局线性混合分支（保留系统级信息），通过可学习门控按节点融合两分支，在严格延迟约束下保持检测精度，在HVAC系统上实现最高8倍检测延迟降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于图的攻击检测器（尤其图注意力模型）虽然能通过学习通信图和物理交互图上的边自适应交互来定位攻击，但其计算成本随邻域规模快速增长，在大规模或密集连接图中的推理延迟可达数十至数百毫秒，严重延迟了关键警报的生成，阻碍了实时部署。

Method: GraphGHHA包含两个分支：(i) 由CPS邻接矩阵约束的图局部稀疏注意力分支；(ii) 保留系统全局信息的全局线性混合分支。通过可学习门控在节点级别融合两分支，兼顾局部攻击定位能力与全局信息覆盖，同时大幅降低计算开销。

Result: 在联网HVAC网络物理系统的代表性攻击场景下，GraphGHHA实现了最高8倍的检测延迟降低，同时保持高检测精度。

Conclusion: GraphGHHA能够实现大规模CPS监控的实用实时警报生成，验证了图注意力机制可在严格延迟约束下进行实时攻击检测部署的可行性。

Abstract: Cyber-physical systems (CPSs) consist of sensors, controllers, and actuators through communication and physical interactions, making them vulnerable to attacks on measurements, control logic, and equipment operation. Graph-based attack detectors, especially graph attention models, can localize such attacks by learning edge-adaptive interactions over communication and physical interaction graphs. However, their computational cost grows rapidly with neighborhood size, and their inference latency can reach tens to hundreds of milliseconds in large-scale or densely connected graphs, delaying time-critical alarm generation. To enable real-time deployment of graph attention mechanisms for attack detection, we propose GraphGHHA, a graph-native attention acceleration layer designed as a replacement for graph attention layers in attack detection units. GraphGHHA combines (i) a graph-local sparse attention branch that is constrained by the adjacency matrix of the CPS, and (ii) a global linear mixing branch to retain system-wide information. A learnable gate combines the two branches node-wise, preserving detection accuracy under strict latency constraints. We evaluate GraphGHHA on a networked heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) cyber-physical system under representative attack scenarios and demonstrate up to an eight-fold reduction in detection latency while maintaining high detection accuracy. These results indicate that GraphGHHA enables practical, real-time alarm generation for large-scale CPS monitoring.

</details>


### [333] [Temporal Property-driven Design Space Exploration with Reinforcement Learning for Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23440)
*Tagir Fabarisov,Maxime Cordy*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的时序属性驱动的CPS设计空间探索工作流。RL代理在设计时选择子系统方案组装候选系统模型，通过仿真执行并利用在线时序属性监控器观察运行轨迹，将功能属性违规指标与非功能项（预算、可恢复性、持续合规、操作使用）结合计算奖励，指导后续候选选择。在甲烷敏感矿井水泵CPS案例上，RL引导搜索仅用26个回合（130次仿真）就找到了实验中最高奖励的设计，性能优于贝叶斯优化和遗传算法基线，消融实验表明基于价值的反馈和先前仿真轨迹重用是效率提升的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可配置CPS的设计空间探索需要可执行评估，因为设计选择会影响时序、故障传播、恢复行为和时序属性满足。设计空间大时，重复随机执行的穷举探索不可行，需要更高效的智能搜索方法。

Method: 采用强化学习工作流：设计时RL代理选择子系统替代方案组装候选系统模型；通过仿真评估模型；仿真过程中在线时序属性监控器观察运行轨迹产生功能属性违规指标；将违规指标与预算、可恢复性、持续合规、操作使用等非功能项结合计算奖励；奖励反馈用于后续候选选择。

Result: 在甲烷敏感矿井水泵CPS上，RL引导搜索在26个回合（130次仿真）内找到实验中的最高奖励设计，比代理引导的贝叶斯优化和基于种群的遗传算法基线需要更少仿真。消融实验表明基于价值的反馈和先前仿真轨迹重用对此效率提升有贡献。

Conclusion: RL引导的时序属性驱动设计工作流能有效加速CPS设计空间探索，并提供了可执行的案例研究模型作为额外贡献。

Abstract: Design-space exploration of configurable Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) requires executable evaluation when design choices affect timing, fault propagation, recovery behavior, and temporal-property satisfaction. Repeated stochastic executions make exhaustive exploration impractical for large design spaces. This paper presents a temporal-property-driven CPS design workflow using Reinforcement Learning (RL). At design time, the RL agent selects subsystem alternatives to assemble a candidate system model. The model is then evaluated through simulation, during which online temporal-property monitors observe runtime traces and produce functional-property violation indicators. These indicators are combined with evaluated non-functional terms for budget, recoverability, sustained compliance, and operational use to calculate the reward used for subsequent candidate selection. The workflow is evaluated on a methane-sensitive mine-pump CPS. The corresponding executable case-study model is provided as additional contribution. RL-guided search identifies the highest-reward design observed in the experiments after 26 episodes (corresponds to 130 executable simulations). These designs were reached with fewer simulations than surrogate-guided Bayesian Optimization and population-based Genetic Algorithm baselines under the same executable model and reward formulation. Ablation study results indicate that value-based feedback and reuse of previous simulation traces contribute to this reduction.

</details>


### [334] [Fair Dynamic Operating Envelopes using Distributed Multi-Period Optimal Power Flow and Jain Index for Active Distribution Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23444)
*Pedro Salomão Quessongo,Daniel Gebbran,Clodomiro Unsihuay-Vila*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段、多周期的动态运行包络（DOE）分配框架，兼顾技术可行性与公平性。第一阶段用分布式OPF计算网络可行的出口包络，第二阶段通过累积比例公平性在动态聚合出口预算下重新分配容量，并限制因公平性增加的额外削减量，同时用电池储能提供情景相关的随机补偿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯技术性的DOE分配会系统性偏向电气位置有利的产消者；而将公平性直接嵌入单周期OPF目标函数会混淆网络可行性、公平与效率，掩盖公平的成本。现有方法缺乏既能保证网络可行、又能显式量化公平成本的多周期框架。

Method: 采用两阶段多周期框架：第一阶段运行技术性分布式OPF计算网络可行出口包络；第二阶段应用动态聚合出口预算，通过累积比例公平性重新分配容量，并以可接受的效率预算限制额外削减。公平DOE作为第一阶段决策，电池储能在需求与可再生能源不确定性下提供情景相关补偿。用标定后的区域ADMM在无损LinDistFlow模型上求解，并用AC潮流独立验证。

Result: 在IEEE 33节点馈线24小时时域上，技术基准的可再生能源削减量为2.1097 MWh，公平约束分配将削减量增至5.7216 MWh，但将最大累积削减比上限控制在11.20%，Jain公平指数接近1，AC电压偏差低于0.01 p.u.，且在0.90-1.05 p.u.限制下无电压或热违规。

Conclusion: 研究表明，储能（缓解削减影响）与多周期公平（增加削减）的结合，是现代DOE设计中有意义的方法，这要求采用多周期、协同设计的方法来制定动态运行包络。

Abstract: Dynamic operating envelopes (DOEs) are increasingly used to publish time-varying export limits that keep distribution networks within operational limits. Purely technical DOE allocation, however, can systematically privilege electrically favorable prosumers, while embedding fairness directly into a single-period optimal power flow (OPF) objective mixes network feasibility, equity and efficiency in a way that obscures the cost of fairness. This paper proposes a two-stage, multi-period framework that addresses both of these. Initially, a technical distributed OPF computes network-feasible export envelopes. The subsequent stage then applies a dynamic aggregate export budget and redistributes capacity through cumulative proportional fairness, limiting the additional curtailment by an admissible efficiency budget. The resulting fair DOEs are treated as first-stage decisions, while battery storage provides scenario-dependent recourse under demand and renewable uncertainty. The operational problem is solved by a calibrated regional alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) on a lossless LinDistFlow model and independently validated using AC power flow. On the IEEE 33-bus feeder over a 24-hour horizon, the technical benchmark yields 2.1097 MWh of renewable curtailment, whereas the fairness-constrained allocation increases curtailment to 5.7216 MWh but caps the maximum cumulative curtailment ratio at 11.20% and raises Jain fairness indices close to unity, with AC voltage deviations below 0.01 p.u. and no voltage or thermal violations under the adopted 0.90-1.05 p.u. limits. Results show that considering both storage (which alleviates curtailment impact) and multi-period fairness (which increases curtailment) is an interesting approach for modern DOE design, which in turn requires a multi-period, co-designed approach.

</details>
