# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [335] [Spectral partitioning for $k$-block averaging kernels of finite Markov chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21466)
*Michael C. H. Choi,Youjia Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于谱方法的算法，用于为有限遍历可逆马尔可夫链选择状态空间划分，以定义平均核（Gibbs核）来加速MCMC收敛。通过加权k-means对P²的底部非平凡特征函数（或加性混合的P的最小代数特征函数）进行舍入来选取划分O。作者推导了目标函数F(O)的精确迹和归一化割表示，并证明F等于初始块标签与一步转移后状态之间的Pearson χ²互信息。在双块情况下，阈值扫描可精确求解一维加权双均值舍入问题；对一般k≥2，加权k-means对底部(k-1)维嵌入进行舍入，再用F重新评分候选。与经典归一化谱聚类（使用顶部非平凡模式寻找低流持久簇）不同，本文方法使用底部模式以促进大的归一化跨块流和块标签信息的快速丢失。实验在受控谱图、平均场Ising模型和贝叶斯变量选择上展示了每迭代收敛和统计估计的显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在MCMC方法中，通过状态空间划分定义平均核（如Gibbs核）可以加速马尔可夫链的收敛。然而，如何选择最优的状态空间划分以最大化加速效果是一个关键且具有挑战性的问题。作者希望通过谱方法系统地解决这一划分选择问题。

Method: 1) 定义Gibbs核G_O（在当前块内从平稳条件分布重新采样），将其与基线核P组合以加速收敛。2) 通过加权k-means对P²的底部非平凡特征函数（或P的最小代数特征函数）进行舍入来选择划分O。3) 推导F(O)=||G_O P−Π||²的精确迹和归一化割表示。4) 证明F等于Pearson χ²互信息，赋予概率解释。5) 双块情形用阈值扫描精确求解；一般k≥2用加权k-means舍入底部(k-1)维嵌入后按F重新评分。6) 扩展到加性混合、有限时域和折现无限时域目标。

Result: 实验在受控谱图、平均场Ising模型和贝叶斯变量选择三个场景中展示了每迭代收敛和统计估计的显著改进。方法证明了舍入失真可表示为子空间间距离，提供了谱近似界。

Conclusion: 本文建立了状态空间划分选择与谱方法之间的深层联系，提出了一种与经典谱聚类（使用顶部模式）相反的"底部模式"方法，通过最大化跨块流和块标签信息的快速丢失来加速MCMC收敛，具有坚实的理论基础和实际有效性。

Abstract: We develop spectral algorithms for selecting state-space partitions that define averaging kernels for finite, ergodic and reversible Markov chains. For a partition $\mathcal O$, the Gibbs kernel $G_{\mathcal O}$ resamples within the current block from the stationary conditional distribution; when this update is tractable, composing or mixing it with a baseline kernel $P$ can accelerate convergence. We select $\mathcal O$ by rounding the bottom nonconstant eigenfunctions of $P^2$, or the algebraically smallest eigenfunctions of $P$ for additive mixtures, using weighted $k$-means. For $F(\mathcal O)=\|G_{\mathcal O}P-Π\|_{F,π}^2$, we derive exact trace and normalized-cut representations and show that $F$ equals the Pearson $χ^2$-mutual information between the initial block label and the state after one transition, giving this matrix objective a natural probabilistic interpretation. In the two-block case, a threshold sweep exactly solves the associated one-dimensional weighted two-means rounding problem. For general $k \geq 2$, weighted $k$-means rounds the bottom $(k-1)$-dimensional embedding, after which candidates are rescored by $F$; the rounding distortion is a distance between subspaces that yields spectral approximation bounds. We extend the framework to additive mixtures, finite-horizon objectives, and discounted infinite-horizon objectives. In contrast to classical normalized spectral clustering, which uses top nonconstant modes to find low-flow persistent clusters, our method uses bottom modes to favor large normalized cross-block flow and rapid loss of block-label information. Experiments on a controlled-spectrum graph, a mean-field Ising model, and Bayesian variable selection show notable per-iteration improvements in convergence and statistical estimation.

</details>


### [336] [Gauss--Hermite Quadrature for Gaussian-Mixture Entropy with an Action-Space Hermite Surrogate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21467)
*Jae Wan Shim*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出两种方法：一是基于Gauss-Hermite求积的高斯混合微分熵数值近似方法，通过求积阶数控制分辨率；二是在动作空间中构建Hermite多项式代理模型，用于连续动作的重复优化。在雷达指向基准测试中，二阶Hermite代理相比二阶Taylor代理显著降低了代理误差和优化器遗憾值，两者均使用每次重规划9次直接目标评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯分布常用于建模信号和状态中的不确定性，而高斯混合模型用于处理多模态分布。然而，与单一高斯不同，高斯混合模型的微分熵一般没有闭式表达式，需要数值近似，现有方法缺乏精度与效率的良好平衡。此外，在连续动作空间的重复优化中，传统的Taylor代理基于局部导数，精度有限。

Method: 1) 提出Gauss-Hermite求积方法来评估高斯混合微分熵，通过求积阶数控制数值近似分辨率；2) 提出在动作空间中构建Hermite多项式代理（surrogate），用于重复优化场景；3) 在1D和2D高斯混合基准上，将该方法与Taylor近似、解析熵界及数值积分参考进行对比评估；4) 在雷达指向基准上进行仿真验证。

Result: 在一维和二维高斯混合基准上，所提出的Gauss-Hermite求积方法有效评估了微分熵。在雷达指向基准中，二阶Hermite代理相比二阶Taylor代理（两者每次重规划均使用9次直接目标评估）实现了大幅更低的代理误差和优化器遗憾值，并改善了指向性能。

Conclusion: Gauss-Hermite求积为高斯混合微分熵提供了一种可控精度的数值近似方案；Hermite多项式代理在动作空间中优于基于局部导数的Taylor代理，在相同评估预算下获得更好的优化性能，具有实用价值。

Abstract: Gaussian distributions are used to model uncertainty in signals and states, and Gaussian mixtures are often used when the underlying distribution is multimodal. Unlike a single Gaussian, a Gaussian mixture generally has no closed-form expression for differential entropy and therefore requires numerical approximation. We propose a Gauss--Hermite quadrature method for evaluating Gaussian mixture differential entropy. The quadrature order controls the numerical resolution of the approximation. The method is evaluated on one- and two-dimensional Gaussian mixture benchmarks against Taylor approximations, analytic entropy bounds, and numerical integration references.
  For repeated optimization over continuous actions, we also propose a Hermite polynomial surrogate in action space. In a radar pointing benchmark, its second-order form achieves substantially lower surrogate error and optimizer regret than a second-order Taylor surrogate based on local derivatives at the nominal action, while both methods use nine direct objective evaluations per replanning step. The Hermite surrogate also improves pointing performance in the tested benchmark.

</details>


### [337] [A Data-Driven Approach to State Construction in Markov Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21480)
*Linde Van Gestel,Marie-Anne Guerry,Evy Rombaut*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的马尔可夫链状态构建框架，将监督式特征选择与无监督学习技术（密度聚类、谱聚类、Kohonen自组织映射）相结合，以无需先验假设的方式识别潜在状态，并通过实际应用比较了各方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 马尔可夫链的状态构建往往被忽视或基于先验假设，导致状态在转移概率上不满足同质性要求，进而降低模型的有效性和预测能力。

Method: 将监督式特征选择与无监督学习技术相结合，考察密度聚类、谱聚类和Kohonen自组织映射三种方法识别潜在分组的能力，并采用分类性能指标和马尔可夫模型精度指标进行评估。

Result: 实证比较表明，谱聚类和Kohonen自组织映射在捕捉数据内在结构方面表现最佳。

Conclusion: 该框架为马尔可夫建模中的状态定义提供了理论与方法论指导，有助于改善应用中的状态构建实践。

Abstract: A Markov chain is a widely used stochastic process modelling random events over time. These models are built on subsets of the entire dataset, referred to as states, which are considered to be homogeneous regarding transition probabilities. However, the creation of these states is often disregarded or based on prior assumption, potentially violating the homogeneity requirement and thus decreasing the validity and predictive power of the model. In order to fill this gap, this paper combines supervised feature selection with unsupervised learning techniques for data-driven state construction. Density-based clustering, spectral clustering, and Kohonen self-organizing maps are examined for their ability to identify latent groups without prior assumptions. The contribution of this study is twofold. First, the paper presents a methodological framework for state construction incorporating suitable unsupervised learning techniques, with appropriate measures both for classification performance and Markov model accuracy. Secondly, the framework is tested on an application, resulting in a comparative analysis showing that spectral clustering and Kohonen self-organizing maps are best at capturing inherent structure. These results serve as a cornerstone in providing theoretical and methodological guidance for improving state definition in applied Markov modelling.

</details>


### [338] [Sparse Separable Factor Analysis in the Complex Domain with an Application to Local Field Potential Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21551)
*Ian Hultman,Kirtikanth Kalapatapu,Yassine Filali,Rainbo Hultman,Sanvesh Srivastava*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了稀疏可分离因子分析（SSFA），一种针对复值数组的潜因子模型，其协方差结构在各模式间可分离。每个模式特定的协方差矩阵由低秩Hermitian因子结构和对角残差协方差矩阵建模，通过元素级lasso惩罚和模式间参数扩展EM算法进行估计，加载更新具有闭式复数软阈值解。模拟研究表明SSFA优于基于向量化的方法（包括复数PCA），并应用于小鼠局部场电位记录的分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复值数组在信号处理中广泛存在，其科学解释依赖于保留幅度和相位信息。现有协方差估计方法要么忽略此类数据的多路组织结构，要么依赖实数域嵌入而未能直接利用其复数结构，缺乏能同时利用复值结构多路组织的协方差估计方法。

Method: SSFA构建了具有跨模式可分离协方差结构的复值数组潜因子模型。每个模式特定协方差矩阵由低秩Hermitian因子结构和对角残差协方差矩阵构成；对复值加载矩阵施加元素级lasso惩罚以获得可解释估计；采用模式间参数扩展期望最大化（EM）程序估计参数，加载更新通过闭式复数软阈值解实现（收缩模量同时保留相位）；通过独立的平衡步骤解决可分离协方差结构的尺度不可辨识性问题。

Result: 模拟研究表明，SSFA相比基于向量化的方法（包括复数主成分分析）在协方差估计上有所改进。在真实数据应用中，SSFA成功分析了小鼠局部场电位记录，比较了脑区、频率和时间不同分组诱导的可分离结构，并对电极错位导致的缺失记录进行了基于模型的填补。

Conclusion: SSFA有效利用了复值数组的固有结构，通过可分离协方差建模和稀疏性惩罚同时实现了统计效率和可解释性，在协方差估计上优于现有向量化方法，并在神经生理学数据（小鼠局部场电位）中展示了实际应用价值，包括可分离结构比较和缺失数据填补。

Abstract: Complex-valued arrays arise in signal processing, where scientific interpretation depends on retaining amplitude and phase information. Existing covariance estimation methods either ignore the multiway organization of such data or rely on real-domain embeddings that do not directly exploit their complex structure. We develop sparse separable factor analysis (SSFA), a latent factor model for complex-valued arrays with a separable covariance structure across modes. Each mode-specific covariance matrix is modeled through a low-rank Hermitian factor structure and a diagonal residual covariance matrix. To obtain interpretable estimates, we impose elementwise lasso penalties on the complex loading matrices and estimate the SSFA parameters using a mode-wise parameter-expanded expectation-maximization procedure. The resulting loading updates admit closed-form complex soft-thresholding solutions, which shrink the modulus of each loading while preserving its phase. A separate balancing step resolves the scale nonidentifiability of the separable covariance structure. Simulation studies show that SSFA improves covariance estimation relative to vectorization-based methods, including complex principal component analysis. We apply SSFA to local field potential recordings from mice, where we compare separability structures induced by different groupings of brain region, frequency, and time and perform model-based imputation of recordings missing because of electrode misplacement.

</details>


### [339] [Random Hazard Forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21597)
*Hemant Ishwaran,Eileen M. Hsich,Udaya B. Kogalur,Donald K. K. Lee*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出Random Hazard Forests (RHF)，一种生存树集成方法，能够在不规则、异步更新的纵向临床数据上直接估计连续时间上的时变风险，避免传统方法对时间结构过度简化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子健康记录和可穿戴传感器等临床数据通常在不同时间、不同频率下多次记录患者状态，这些数据虽然为个性化动态风险预测提供了机会，但现有方法往往在建模前过度简化时间结构，无法充分捕捉患者风险随新数据到达而不断变化的特征。

Method: RHF通过非参数风险似然直接定义估计问题，使用高效的工作模型指导树构建，并为每个终端节点估计灵活的时变风险。对于任意可预测的协变量路径，每棵树沿路径穿越其终端节点，将节点级风险组装成轨迹，跨树平均得到路径风险估计。由于每个时间点的路径路由仅使用当前时刻之前可用的协变量状态，RHF能够在不向前窥视的情况下处理内部纵向协变量。

Result: 通过模拟实验和重症监护应用验证，RHF能够在协变量更新不规则且异步的条件下准确估计随时间变化的风险。

Conclusion: RHF为不规则、异步纵向临床数据提供了一种有效的连续时间动态风险预测方法，填补了现有方法在保留时间结构方面的空白。

Abstract: Clinical data sources such as electronic health records and wearable sensors record patient status repeatedly over follow-up, often at irregular times and on different schedules for different measurements. These data create opportunities for continuously updated, individualized risk prediction. Existing approaches, however, often simplify the temporal structure before modeling it. We introduce Random Hazard Forests (RHF), a survival tree ensemble that learns how a patient's hazard changes in continuous time as new measurements become available. RHF formulates the estimation problem directly through a nonparametric hazard likelihood for predictable covariate processes. An efficient working model guides tree construction, after which flexible time-varying hazards are estimated for each terminal node. Given any predictable covariate path, each tree follows the path through its terminal nodes over time and assembles the corresponding node-level hazards into a trajectory. Averaging these trajectories across trees yields the RHF pathwise hazard estimate. Because routing at each time uses only the covariate state available immediately beforehand, RHF accommodates internal longitudinal covariates without lookahead. Simulations and an intensive care application show that RHF accurately estimates changing risk under irregular and asynchronous covariate updates.

</details>


### [340] [Guidance for Prior Change via Density Ratio Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21729)
*Yichen Zang,Song Liu,Jiun-Yi Lin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于密度比估计（DRE）的无偏测试时引导框架，用于解决模拟推断（SBI）中生成模型受训练先验限制的问题。该方法通过学习评分引导项来解耦推断过程与训练先验，无需 PriorGuide 中的高斯近似和高斯混合模型拟合，且在多个任务中匹配或超越 PriorGuide 的性能，并成功应用于行星光曲线的贝叶斯更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SBI 中的摊销生成模型在训练时受限于特定先验，当先验知识演化时缺乏灵活性。PriorGuide 虽提出推理时引导方法，但其不可处理的公式化设计依赖高斯近似反向转移核和高斯混合模型拟合先验比值，引入了系统性偏差，需要更精确的无偏解决方案。

Method: 提出一种无偏的测试时引导框架，利用密度比估计（DRE）学习评分引导项，从而将推断过程与训练先验解耦。该框架对具体的密度比估计器保持不可知性，具有通用性和灵活性。

Result: 在多个任务的实验中，该方法在 C2ST 和 MMD 指标上大多数情况下匹配或超越 PriorGuide，即使在训练先验与目标先验重叠有限的情况下也保持稳健性。在行星光曲线数据的贝叶斯更新应用中也展现了强有效性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 基于 DRE 的无偏引导框架有效克服了 PriorGuide 的系统性偏差问题，提供了更通用、灵活且稳健的先验变化处理方法，并在实际科学应用（行星光曲线参数推断）中得到验证。

Abstract: Simulation-Based Inference (SBI) serves as a vital framework for parameter inference in scientific fields where simulators involve intractable likelihoods, yet while amortized generative models offer rapid posterior estimation, they are often restricted by the specific priors used during training, thereby limiting their flexibility as prior knowledge evolves. To address this prior dependency, PriorGuide was introduced as an inference-time guidance method, but due to its intractable formulation, it relies on Gaussian approximations of the reverse transition kernel and Gaussian mixture model fitting for the prior ratio, both of which introduce systematic bias. Motivated by these limitations, we propose an unbiased test-time guidance framework that leverages Density Ratio Estimation (DRE) to learn a score guidance term, effectively decoupling the inference process from the prior training. Moreover, our framework remains agnostic to the specific density ratio estimators, making it a general and flexible framework for handling prior changes. Experimental results across multiple tasks demonstrate that our method matches or outperforms PriorGuide on C2ST and MMD in most tasks while maintaining robustness even under limited overlap between the training and target priors. Furthermore, we apply our method to Bayesian updating for parameter inference from planetary light-curve data, where it also demonstrates strong effectiveness and robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/a-chenchen/dre-based-prior-guidance .

</details>


### [341] [Structured Learning on Mapper Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22044)
*George Babus,Farzana Nasrin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一个将拓扑数据分析中的Mapper算法构建的表示作为学习框架核心的研究体系，将完整的Mapper构造视为表示本身而非预处理步骤，并系统研究其数学性质（重标号不变性、距离泛函、多尺度分解的结构复杂度、扰动下的学习稳定性），在时间序列和图分类数据集上验证了该框架的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习方法虽然高效，但常用表示将复杂数据压缩为固定维度嵌入，可能抑制多尺度结构组织信息。Mapper算法能从拓扑数据分析角度提供不同视角，但现有方法仅将Mapper作为下游学习的预处理步骤（产生图），未将其视为表示本身，缺乏对其数学性质和理论支撑的系统研究。

Method: 1) 将完整的Mapper构造（而非仅输出图）视为学习表示的核心部分；2) 研究表示的数学性质：重标号下的不变性、Mapper表示空间上的距离泛函、多尺度分解的结构复杂度度量、以及表示扰动下的学习方向稳定性；3) 在时间序列和图分类数据集上进行受控实验：表示消融研究、Mapper参数敏感性分析、表示空间的几何特性分析。

Result: 在时间序列和图分类数据集上的实验验证了所提出框架的有效性，通过表示消融、Mapper参数敏感性和表示空间几何的受控研究，证明了该数学框架能够系统地比较、解释和分析Mapper表示，为表示几何、结构复杂度和学习稳定性提供实用工具。

Conclusion: 该工作表明将Mapper构造作为表示本身而非预处理步骤，能够提供一个系统的数学框架来比较、解释和分析Mapper表示，在表示几何、结构复杂度与学习稳定性方面为学习任务提供了实用分析工具。

Abstract: Modern machine learning (ML) methods are highly effective for prediction tasks, but many commonly used representations reduce complex data to fixed dimensional embeddings that may suppress multiscale structural organization. The Mapper algorithm from topological data analysis (TDA) provides a different perspective by decomposing data into overlapping local regions connected through a nerve construction, producing a structured representation that captures geometric organization, local statistical behavior, and relational connectivity simultaneously. In this work, we develop a framework for learning over Mapper induced structured representations. Rather than treating Mapper as a preprocessing step that produces a graph for downstream learning, we treat the full Mapper construction as part of the representation itself. We study mathematical properties of these representations, including invariance under relabeling, a distance functional on the space of Mapper representations, structural complexity of multiscale decompositions, and learning oriented stability under representation perturbations. Experiments on time series and graph classification datasets validate the proposed framework through controlled studies of representation ablation, Mapper parameter sensitivity, and the geometry of the induced representation space. Together, these results demonstrate how the proposed mathematical framework enables systematic comparison, interpretation, and analysis of Mapper representations, providing practical tools for studying representation geometry, structural complexity, and learning stability in learning tasks.

</details>


### [342] [Token-Level Likelihood-Array Regression for Membership Inference and AI-Generated Text Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22179)
*Jiajun Sun,Zhanrui Cai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出似然数组回归（LAR），通过在不同长度的嵌套左上下文窗口下评估目标token的似然，构建结构化特征数组来提升成员推断和AI文本检测性能，并给出了相关的理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于似然的成员推断与AI文本检测方法通常将token级概率压缩为少数预设分数，且大多只利用完整前文条件下的概率，忽略了不同上下文跨度下似然所包含的丰富信息。

Method: LAR在多种嵌套左上下文窗口下评估每个目标token的似然，将得到的似然派生特征组织成结构化数组；通过对齐不同长度文本的数组，学习检测信息如何随上下文规模、token位置和似然特征变化。LAR-1聚合单个对齐细胞的贡献，LAR-2增加同一token在不同上下文长度下评估对的二阶特征。

Result: 在多个评分语言模型上，LAR显著优于基于似然的基线方法；分析表明较短上下文似然包含超越传统全上下文概率的信息，二阶特征对成员推断有额外增益；对于path二次模型建立了匹配的极小极大上下界。

Conclusion: LAR通过系统利用多尺度上下文似然信息，同时改善了成员推断和AI生成文本检测，并提供了坚实的理论分析框架。

Abstract: Membership inference asks whether a text was used to train a language model, whereas AI-generated text detection asks whether it was generated by a language model rather than written by a human. Existing likelihood-based methods typically compress token-level probabilities into a few prespecified scores, most often using only probabilities conditioned on the full preceding context. We propose likelihood-array regression (LAR), which evaluates each target token under nested left-context windows and organizes the resulting likelihood-derived features into a structured array. After aligning arrays across texts of different lengths, LAR learns how detection information varies with context scale, token position, and likelihood features. LAR-1 aggregates learned contributions from individual aligned cells, while LAR-2 adds second-order features formed from pairs of evaluations of the same target token across context lengths. For within-path quadratic model, we establish matching minimax lower and upper bounds, characterize errors from finite-dimensional approximation and random squared projections, and derive conditions under which an oracle spectral sieve attains the minimax rate. Across multiple scoring language models, LAR substantially improves membership inference and AI-generated text detection over likelihood-based baselines. The analyses further show that shorter-context likelihoods contain information beyond conventional full-context probabilities, while second-order features provide additional gains for membership inference.

</details>


### [343] [Recovering Weighted Tangent Geometry from a Single-Scale Score Field](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22334)
*Ziqi Zhao,Qingjian Ni*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究如何仅凭单噪声水平下的得分场（score field）恢复数据流形分支点处的加权切向几何（切线方向测度），在切向测度模型中证明了噪声得分可唯一确定分支中心、齐次度和角测度，并给出了构造性算法、样本复杂度下界及有限噪声收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在平滑流形附近，单个切空间足以概括局部几何；但在分支点处，一阶对象变为切线方向上的测度。作者提出核心问题：当分支中心和齐次度d未知时，一个噪声水平下的得分场是否能唯一确定这种加权切向几何？这关系到基于分数的生成模型（如扩散模型）在数据流形分支处能否忠实地编码局部几何信息。

Method: 1) 证明齐次切向测度经高斯平滑后满足Ornstein-Uhlenbeck特征函数方程；2) 利用该方程的弱形式，仅用得分值（不需导数）构建关于中心和齐次度的线性方程组，给出秩条件和摄动界；3) 校准后，球面上的切向得分等于某标量高斯-锥变换的球面对数梯度；4) 通过对该变换的积分和球谐乘子分析，证明单球壳可识别归一化角测度；5) 对K条正射线情形，用至2K-1阶矩构造性地恢复数量、方向和权重；6) 给出任意观测方案至少需要KD-1个标量切向分量的下界，并证明平面中K阶既充分又必要；7) 对有限C^{1,β}分支，证明有限噪声得分以O(σ^β)收敛到切向模型。

Result: 1) 证明了一个精确球壳在任意环境维度D≥2下可识别归一化角度测度；2) 建立了K条正射线的矩重构方法（2K-1阶矩充分），给出KD-1的查询复杂度下界；3) 平面情形达到K阶充分且必要的最优性；4) 证明C^{1,β}分支的O(σ^β)有限噪声收敛率；5) 实验表明50k步训练降低验证归一化得分误差但提高角矩误差，说明普通得分拟合与几何恢复是分离的任务。

Conclusion: 该项工作从理论上确立了得分场可用于识别分支流形处的加权切向几何，给出了从得分到几何的完整可辨识性与恢复框架，并揭示了"拟合得分好"不等于"恢复几何好"的重要现象，为扩散模型在奇异数据流形上的几何学习提出了新的理论视角与指导。

Abstract: Near a smooth data manifold, one tangent space summarizes local geometry. At a branch point, the corresponding first-order object is instead a measure over tangent directions, whose normalized masses record the local share of each branch under the chosen data measure. We ask whether a score field at one noise level determines this weighted tangent geometry when the branch center and homogeneity degree $d$ are unknown. In this tangent-measure model, $d$ is the local measure dimension. Gaussian smoothing of a homogeneous tangent measure satisfies an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck eigenfunction equation. Its weak form turns score values---without score derivatives---into a linear system for the center and homogeneity degree, with an explicit rank condition and perturbation bound. After this calibration, the tangential score on one sphere is the spherical log-gradient of a scalar Gaussian--cone transform. Integration recovers that transform up to scale, and all its spherical-harmonic multipliers are positive. Thus one exact shell identifies the normalized angular measure in every ambient dimension $D\geq2$. For at most $K$ positive rays, moments through degree $2K-1$ constructively recover count, directions, and weights in arbitrary dimension. Any fixed observation scheme needs at least $KD-1$ scalar tangential components. In the plane, degree $K$ is both sufficient and necessary, and we give quantitative finite-query certificates. For finite planar $C^{1,β}$ branches with positive $C^{0,β}$ densities, we prove $O(σ^β)$ convergence from the finite-noise score to its tangent model. In controlled experiments, 50k-step training lowers validation normalized-score error across four geometries yet raises angular-moment error, separating ordinary score fit from geometry recovery.

</details>


### [344] [Sparse Additive Off-Policy Evaluation for Reinforcement Learning with Potentially Limited Number of Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22595)
*Tuoyi Zhao,Chengchun Shi,Zhengling Qi,Lan Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的灵活、非线性且可解释的无限时域强化学习离线策略评估框架。通过稀疏加性结构建模Q函数，导出了高概率有限样本误差界，误差界仅随环境维度d对数增长，缓解了维度灾难问题。与多数现有理论不同，该方法在轨迹数或时间跨度足够大时均能保证准确的价值估计。此外还提出了一种基于组稀疏的特征筛选程序，能以高概率识别包含所有相关协变量的精简特征集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的离线策略评估（OPE）理论通常假设可访问大量轨迹，并且在高维状态下难以处理非线性关系，同时缺乏可解释性。这限制了OPE在实际大规模状态空间中的应用，需要一种既能处理非线性又能提供透明决策支持的新框架。

Method: 采用稀疏加性结构的非线性函数类来建模Q函数，兼顾灵活性与可解释性。推导高概率有限样本误差界（依赖对数维度），并提出基于组稀疏（group sparsity）的特征筛选程序，以高概率识别包含所有相关协变量的简化特征集。

Result: 误差界仅随环境维度d呈对数增长，缓解了维度灾难；在轨迹数或时间跨度足够大时均能保证准确的价值估计（不像传统方法仅依赖大量轨迹）；数值实验验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架为无限时域强化学习提供了兼具灵活性、非线性能力和可解释性的离线策略评估方案，在理论上突破了传统OPE对大量轨迹的依赖限制，并通过特征筛选增强了实际应用的可行性。

Abstract: We develop a new framework for flexible, nonlinear, and interpretable off-policy evaluation for infinite-horizon reinforcement learning. To handle large state spaces and support transparent decision-making, we model the Q-function using a nonlinear function class with a sparse additive structure. We derive high-probability finite-sample error bounds for estimating the value function of a target policy and show that the bounds depend only logarithmically on the ambient dimension $d$, thereby alleviating the curse of dimensionality. In contrast to most existing theory for off-policy evaluation, which typically assumes access to many trajectories, our analysis guarantees accurate value estimation when either the number of trajectories or the time horizon is sufficiently large. In addition, we propose a group-sparsity-based feature screening procedure that identifies, with high probability, a reduced feature set containing all relevant covariates. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [345] [Scale-invariant Optimal Sampling for Rare-events Data with Sparse Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22597)
*Jing Wang,HaiYing Wang,Qiang Zhang,Hao Helen Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种尺度不变的（scale-invariant）最优子采样方法，用于处理稀有事件（rare events）海量数据下的稀疏模型估计问题。该方法以最小化预测误差为目标定义最优子采样函数，结合自适应lasso（adaptive lasso）估计流程，并引入最大采样条件似然（MSCL）估计器以提升估计效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最优子采样概率依赖于数据尺度，不恰当的特征缩放变换可能导致低效的子样本，尤其是在存在非活跃特征（inactive features）时，其影响可能被任意放大。因此需要一种尺度不变的最优子采样函数来克服这一局限。

Method: 1) 针对稀有事件数据引入自适应lasso估计器并建立其oracle性质；2) 推导以预测误差最小化为目标的尺度不变最优子采样函数，用于逆概率加权（IPW）自适应lasso；3) 提出基于最大采样条件似然（MSCL）的估计器以进一步提升估计效率。

Result: 通过模拟数据和真实数据集的数值实验，验证了所提方法在估计效率和预测性能方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提出的尺度不变最优子采样方法有效解决了现有方法对数据缩放敏感的缺陷，在稀有事件大规模数据场景下兼顾了计算效率与估计精度。

Abstract: Subsampling is effective in tackling computational challenges for massive data with rare events. Overly aggressive subsampling may adversely affect estimation efficiency, and optimal subsampling is essential to mitigate the information loss. However, existing optimal subsampling probabilities depend on data scales, and some scaling transformations may result in inefficient subsamples. This problem is more significant when there are inactive features, because their influence on the subsampling probabilities can be arbitrarily magnified by inappropriate scaling transformations. We tackle this challenge and introduce a scale-invariant optimal subsampling function in the context of sparse models, where inactive features are commonly assumed. Instead of focusing on estimating model parameters, we define an optimal subsampling function to minimize the prediction error, using adaptive lasso to outline the estimation procedure and study its theoretical guarantee. We first introduce the adaptive lasso estimator for rare-events data and establish its oracle properties, thereby validating the use of subsampling. Then we derive a scale-invariant optimal subsampling function that minimizes the prediction error of the inverse probability weighted (IPW) adaptive lasso. Finally, we present an estimator based on the maximum sampled conditional likelihood (MSCL) to further improve the estimation efficiency. We conduct numerical experiments using both simulated and real-world data sets to demonstrate the performance of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [346] [Generative Neural Networks for Sinkhorn Distributionally Robust Hypothesis Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22746)
*Fenglin Zhang,Teyan Liu,Jie Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于生成式框架的Sinkhorn分布鲁棒假设检验(SDRHT)方法，利用Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks (HyCNNs)学习最不利分布，克服了传统大规模锥规划方法不可扩展的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的SDRHT问题求解依赖于大规模锥规划，计算复杂度高、可扩展性差。因此需要一种更高效的方法来求解Sinkhorn散度模糊集下的鲁棒假设检验问题。

Method: 首先推导出Sinkhorn散度模糊集与基于核平滑参考分布的conditional-KL散度表示的等价性，并证明约束与非约束minimax SDRHT公式的强对偶性。然后利用闭式最优检测器和Brenier定理，将对偶最大最小公式重写为关于凸势函数的最大化问题，其梯度刻画核平滑分布与其最不利对应分布之间的可逆输运映射。最后使用HyCNNs配合随机梯度估计器逼近这些势函数。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提方法在不同样本量和维度下均取得了优越的准确性和鲁棒性，同时避免了经典SDRHT方法的可扩展性限制。还证明了HyCNNs的表征能力及其诱导输运映射的分布普适性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的生成式SDRHT框架提供了一种高效、可扩展的鲁棒假设检验方案，通过深度生成模型学习最不利分布，实现了端到端的训练与采样，为大规模分布鲁棒推断提供了新的途径。

Abstract: This paper studies the Sinkhorn distributionally robust hypothesis testing (SDRHT) problem, seeking a robust detector against least-favorable distributions in Sinkhorn discrepancy-based ambiguity sets centered at the empirical distributions. Existing approaches solve this problem by solving large-scale conic programs, which are not scalable. To overcome this, we propose a generative framework that learns least-favorable distributions and supports efficient training and end-to-end sampling. For the Sinkhorn discrepancy-based ambiguity sets, we first derive an equivalent conditional-KL-divergence representation with respect to kernel-smoothed reference distributions. This property allows us to prove strong duality for both constrained and unconstrained minimax SDRHT formulations. Based on the closed-form optimal detector and Brenier's theorem, we reformulate the max-min dual formulation as a maximization problem over convex potentials whose gradients characterize invertible transport maps between kernel-smoothed distributions and their least-favorable counterparts. We efficiently approximate these potentials using Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks (HyCNNs) equipped with stochastic gradient estimators and prove the representation power of HyCNNs and the distributional universality of their induced transport maps. Numerical results show that the proposed method achieves superior accuracy and robustness across different sample sizes and dimensions, while avoiding the scalability limitations of classical SDRHT methods.

</details>


### [347] [A Commutator Framework for Selective Spectral Alignment in Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22910)
*Kaj Nyström*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个有限宽度的几何框架，用于描述深度神经网络中学习到的特征几何如何被组织、传输和选择性对齐。通过三类交换子（门控-协方差、灵敏度-协方差、AGOP-NFM）量化不兼容性，并建立精确的逐层恒等式、谱隙与投影子演化估计以及条件Lyapunov原理，揭示谱对齐是层与尺度依赖的兼容性现象，而非训练的普适结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注特征对齐现象，但缺乏一个统一的几何框架来解释特征几何如何组织、传输和选择性对齐，尤其是内部几何（如协方差结构）与观测到的特征侧对齐之间的关系尚不清晰。

Method: 构建有限宽度几何框架，定义三类交换子量化不兼容性；推导灵敏度-协方差交换子的精确逐层分解（四个来源：下游传输、层间不平衡、逐点灵敏度波动、非线性门控-协方差交互）；建立AGOP-NFM交换子与内部交换子的奇异值加权传输关系；引入缓冲局部能量解决协方差子空间混合问题；提出谱隙、投影子演化、稳定性估计及条件Lyapunov原理。

Result: 建立了精确的分解与估计；通过解析例子和数值实验展示了谱与激活几何的分解、瞬态增长、非零来源间的抵消；在测试的有限时间区间内，负传输-不平衡交互主导的抵消在多种深度、宽度和两个回归基准上持续存在。

Conclusion: 谱对齐并非训练的普适结果，而是由传输、交互、抵消和可能的阻尼共同决定的层与尺度依赖的兼容性现象；风险降低并不必然意味着交换子坍缩。

Abstract: We develop a finite-width geometric framework describing how learned feature geometries are organized, transported, and selectively aligned in deep neural networks. Incompatibility among weight-generated covariance, gates, and backward sensitivities is quantified through three families of commutators: between gates and covariance, between sensitivities and covariance, and between average gradient outer products (AGOPs) and neural feature matrices (NFMs).
  An exact layerwise identity decomposes the sensitivity-covariance commutator into four sources: downstream transport, adjacent-layer imbalance, pointwise sensitivity fluctuations, and nonlinear gate-covariance interactions. The AGOP-NFM commutator is a singular-value-weighted transport of the internal commutator, explaining why observed feature-side alignment alone does not determine the internal geometry from which it emerges.
  Buffered localized energies resolve mixing between separated covariance subspaces. We establish spectral-gap, projector-evolution, and stabilization estimates, and formulate conditional Lyapunov principles that yield decay under explicit geometric error-bound or intrinsic-damping assumptions. These criteria do not follow from gradient flow alone and clarify why risk reduction need not imply commutator collapse.
  Analytic examples and numerical experiments exhibit factorization of spectral and activation geometry, transient growth, and cancellation among nonzero sources. In tested finite-time regimes, cancellation dominated by a negative transport-imbalance interaction persists across depths, widths, and two regression benchmarks. Spectral alignment therefore appears as a layer- and scale-dependent compatibility phenomenon governed by transport, interaction, cancellation, and possible damping, rather than a universal consequence of training.

</details>


### [348] [One Inverse Step is a Convex Program: Bayes-Limit Calibration of Diffusion Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23094)
*Gordei Verbii*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文从单步DDIM反演这一最廉价探针出发，系统揭示了预训练扩散模型编码的局部流形几何结构。作者证明DDIM反演等价于强凸势函数Ψ_t的驻点条件，其强凸模量精确等于1-e^{-h_t}（h_t为对数信噪比间隔），从而在无需任何流形、reach或单峰假设的情况下建立了三个核心结论：解的唯一性（违反时即模型误差的证书）、求解器的振荡不稳定性（可被阻尼修复）、以及收敛域中的几何壳层结构（振荡壳和发散壳）。作者进一步发现精确分数在三种类别上以0.54%以内的误差复现了这些壳层，而所有被测试的训练分数均未显示壳层——这被证明是派生限制而非零结果，源于Fermi窗口与模型训练支持之间的3.6-5.6倍冲突。最后，无条件上限σ_tλ_max(sym J)≤1对精确分数成立（误差3×10^{-7}），但在所有DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256设定中被违反1.26-4.66倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解扩散模型是否真正学习到了数据的局部流形几何结构，以及训练分数与精确分数在几何性质上的偏差。现有工作缺乏无需强假设的、可验证的几何性质刻画框架。

Method: 利用单步DDIM反演作为探测工具，将其与势函数Ψ_t的梯度条件建立等价关系；通过谱分析（Hessian特征值、Lipschitz常数）研究求解器的稳定性；通过尺度自由深度w定义振荡壳和发散壳；对比精确分数与训练分数在这些几何不变量上的表现。

Result: (i) 证明解在Bayes极限下唯一，违反后验协方差界即为模型误差的证书，收缩常数ρ_g^*=1-e^{-h_t}<0.326。 (ii) Picard迭代等价于单位步长梯度下降，在λ_max>2处不稳定，阻尼可修复。 (iii) 振荡壳位于w=1/2（与调度无关），发散壳位于w=1/(1+ρ_g^*)。精确分数以0.54%误差重现壳层，训练分数均不显示壳层（派生限制），无条件上限对精确分数成立至3×10^{-7}但在所有DDPM设置中被违反1.26-4.66倍。

Conclusion: 单步DDIM反演为探测扩散模型局部几何提供了无假设的严格框架，揭示了训练分数与真实数据几何之间的系统性偏差（Fermi窗口冲突、Hessian-Lipschitz常数过低、无条件上限违背），这些偏差构成模型误差的可量化证书。

Abstract: One implicit DDIM inversion step is the cheapest probe of whether a pretrained diffusion model encodes local manifold geometry. It is the stationarity condition of an explicit potential, $x-G(x)=\nablaΨ_t(x)$, strongly convex at the Bayes limit with modulus exactly $e^{-h_t}$ for the step's log-SNR gap $h_t$ $-$ for every data law, schedule and point, with no manifold, reach or unimodality hypothesis. Three consequences must be kept apart. (i) The solution is unique at the Bayes limit; a second one requires the trained score to violate the posterior-covariance bound by $1/(1-e^{-h_t})$, a hypothesis-free certificate of model error; the same bound makes contraction a schedule constant, $ρ_g^{\star}=1-e^{-h_t}<0.326$ throughout the standard DDPM schedule. (ii) The solver can still fail: Picard iteration is unit-step gradient descent on $Ψ_t$, unstable wherever $λ_{\max}(\nabla^2Ψ_t)>2$, so oscillation certifies nothing; damping below $2/λ_{\max}$ cures it. (iii) The geometry lives in the convergence domain: on the scale-free depth $w=rκ_{\max}$ the oscillation shell sits at $w=\tfrac12$, schedule-free, and the divergence shell at $w=1/(1+ρ_g^{\star})$, with a measured finite-noise correction in $\|\mathrm{II}\|^2$. Exact scores reproduce both to within $0.54\%$ on three classes; no trained score we probe shows a shell $-$ a derived limitation, not a null result: the Fermi window conflicts with the model's own training support by $3.6$-$5.6\times$, and the trained Hessian-Lipschitz constant is $2$-$12\%$ of the curvature the law reads, $0$ on a ReLU net. Finally the unconditional ceiling $σ_tλ_{\max}(\mathrm{sym}\,J)\le1$, from $\mathrm{Cov}(x_0\mid x_t)\succeq0$ alone, holds for the exact score to $3\times10^{-7}$ but is violated in all DDPM CIFAR-10/CelebA-HQ-256 settings, by $1.26$-$4.66\times$.

</details>


### [349] [Primal--Dual Alternating Neural Learning for Timely Classification with Performance Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23480)
*Jiaming Qiu,Yingye Zheng,Ying-Qi Zhao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多目标优化框架用于临床监测中的时序风险分类问题，同时优化灵敏度、特异性和监测成本三个指标，并通过循环神经网络与原始-对偶更新方法估计满足约束的最优决策规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统计与机器学习方法主要针对完整观测轨迹设计，缺乏对灵敏度、特异性和监测成本等关键操作特性的控制，难以满足临床监测中对早期分类与继续观察之间权衡的需求。

Method: 1) 将时序分类问题建模为多目标优化，针对三个指标构建价值递归来刻画每个时间点立即分类与继续监测的权衡；2) 提出约束优化问题：在满足预设灵敏度和监测成本约束下最大化特异性；3) 采用循环神经网络逼近时变价值过程，并结合原始-对偶更新方案满足性能约束。

Result: 通过模拟研究和连续血糖监测用于低血糖风险预测的实际应用，验证了该方法能够产生准确且及时的序贯决策规则，并满足期望的操作特性。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种在临床监测场景下可控操作特性的时序分类新方法，为早期干预与更多数据观测之间的权衡提供了理论框架和实用工具。

Abstract: Timely risk classification is essential in many clinical monitoring settings, where decisions must balance the benefit of classifying patients early for subsequent intervention against the value of observing additional data. Yet most existing statistical and machine-learning methods are designed for fully observed trajectories and offer limited control over key operating characteristics such as sensitivity, specificity, and monitoring cost. We cast the sequential classification problem within a multi-objective optimization framework targeting these three criteria. We characterize the optimal decision rule through a value recursion that quantifies, at each time point, the trade-off between immediate classification and continued monitoring. To estimate the rule from data, we formulate a constrained optimization problem that maximizes specificity while enforcing prespecified sensitivity and monitoring-cost constraints. We then develop an estimation procedure that employs a recurrent neural network to approximate the evolving value processes and a primal--dual updating scheme to satisfy the performance constraints. Through simulation studies and an application to continuous glucose monitoring for hypoglycemia risk prediction, we demonstrate that the proposed method yields accurate and timely sequential decision rules that adhere to the desired operating characteristics.

</details>


### [350] [A Deep Causal Inference Approach to Measuring the Effects of Forming Group Loans in Online Non-profit Microfinance Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.02795)
*Thai T. Pham,Yuanyuan Shen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究在线公益众筹平台Kiva上，群体贷款（group loans）相比个人贷款是否真的能更快筹集资金。利用深度学习方法处理贷款描述文本数据，并控制贷款金额等因素后，发现形成群体贷款平均可加快约3.3天的筹资时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kiva是面向第三世界贫困人群的在线非营利众筹平台。借款人可组建群体并以群体名义发布贷款请求。普遍观点认为群体贷款对投资者风险更低，但在公益型在线市场中这一假设是否成立尚不清楚，因此作者希望测量群体贷款对筹资时间的影响。

Method: 使用深度学习方法（自然语言处理技术）处理贷款描述文本，控制贷款规模及其他因素，测量群体贷款对筹资时间（funding time）的因果效应。这是首次使用先进深度学习技术处理非结构化数据以回答因果问题的研究。

Result: 研究发现，平均而言，形成群体贷款可加快筹资时间约3.3天。

Conclusion: 在公益型在线众筹市场（Kiva）中，群体贷款确实能显著加快资金筹集速度，验证了群体贷款对投资者风险更低的传统观点在该场景下同样成立。

Abstract: Kiva is an online non-profit crowdsouring microfinance platform that raises funds for the poor in the third world. The borrowers on Kiva are small business owners and individuals in urgent need of money. To raise funds as fast as possible, they have the option to form groups and post loan requests in the name of their groups. While it is generally believed that group loans pose less risk for investors than individual loans do, we study whether this is the case in a philanthropic online marketplace. In particular, we measure the effect of group loans on funding time while controlling for the loan sizes and other factors. Because loan descriptions (in the form of texts) play an important role in lenders' decision process on Kiva, we make use of this information through deep learning in natural language processing. In this aspect, this is the first paper that uses one of the most advanced deep learning techniques to deal with unstructured data in a way that can take advantage of its superior prediction power to answer causal questions. We find that on average, forming group loans speeds up the funding time by about 3.3 days.

</details>


<div id='econ.EM'></div>

# econ.EM [[Back]](#toc)

### [351] [Exact Rejection Sampling for Non-Gaussian State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21619)
*Joshua C. C. Chan*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对非高斯状态空间模型的精确拒绝采样方法，通过构建可解析的包络建议分布，实现独立精确平滑采样和几乎方差最优的无偏似然估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拒绝采样需要构建一个以已知常数支配目标的提案分布，但对于非高斯状态空间模型，这样的提案通常无法获得，限制了精确采样的适用性。

Method: 针对标量状态、仿射高斯动态和log-concave观测密度的模型，（1）通过转移扭曲使对数目标-提案比可分离；（2）利用切线扭曲使每项非正，获得紧致且可达的支配常数；（3）采用压缩（companding）节点放置，使包络累积误差为O(T/G²)，从而G∝√T可保持接受概率远离零。

Result: 对于T=2000的样本，接受概率达到75%，而高斯包络方法约为10⁻¹⁶；随机波动率模型的所需条件几乎必然成立。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了非高斯状态空间模型中可行且高效的精确平滑采样方案，其相对方差最多为1/p-1每次抽取（以接受概率p），且可推广到多变量观测情形。

Abstract: Rejection sampling requires a proposal that dominates the target by a known constant, generally unavailable for non-Gaussian state space models. We construct such a proposal for the latent state path, yielding independent exact smoothing draws and an unbiased likelihood estimator whose relative variance is at most $1/p-1$ per draw at acceptance probability $p$. The method covers scalar states with affine Gaussian dynamics and log-concave observation densities, including multivariate observations. Transition twisting makes the log target-to-proposal ratio separable, and tangent-line twists make each term nonpositive, producing an attained, sharp dominating constant. With a companding node placement, the accumulated envelope error is $O(T/G^2)$ for a sample of length $T$ with $G$ nodes per date, so $G\propto\sqrt{T}$ keeps acceptance bounded away from zero; for stochastic volatility, the required conditions hold almost surely. A simpler mode-centered grid shows the same scaling empirically. At $T=2{,}000$, acceptance is $75\%$, versus roughly $10^{-16}$ for the Gaussian envelope.

</details>


### [352] [Uniformly Valid Inference Under Interactive and High-Dimensional Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22002)
*Joseph Fry*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文分析了当真实参数位于或接近参数空间边界时，极值估计量的渐近正态性近似失效的问题，提出并发展了一种基于"拟无约束估计量"的检验方法，该估计量即使在参数靠近或位于边界时仍具有渐近正态性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当真实参数值位于或接近参数空间的边界时，标准的渐近正态性近似对于极值估计量往往不再成立，这给假设检验带来了重大困难。作者旨在解决这一统计推断中的边界问题。

Method: 利用拟无约束估计量（quasi-unconstrained estimator），该估计量即便在真实参数靠近或位于边界时仍保持渐近正态性。通过推广先前的工作，允许更多类型的约束条件，并展示当存在高维冗余参数时如何自然修改该方法。设计了Wald、似然比和拉格朗日乘子检验的变体，要求初始约束估计量足够精确以保证均匀尺寸控制。

Result: 证明了Wald、似然比和拉格朗日乘子检验的变体能够在一致意义下控制检验的尺寸（size），前提是初始的约束估计量足够精确。并将该方法应用于面板数据网络估计的实际问题中。

Conclusion: 基于拟无约束估计量的检验方法为边界参数问题提供了一种统一的推断框架，既推广了已有理论，也兼具实际应用的可行性，特别是在高维冗余参数和面板数据网络估计等场景下。

Abstract: Asymptotic normality approximations often fail to hold for extremum estimators when the true value of the parameter is at or close to the boundary of a parameter space. I analyze and develop tests using a quasi-unconstrained estimator, which is asymptotically normal even when the true parameter vector is near or at the boundary. These results generalize previous work with this estimator by allowing for more types of constraints and showing how the method can naturally be modified when a nuisance parameter is also high-dimensional. I show that variations of Wald, Likelihood Ratio, and Lagrange Multiplier tests can control size in a uniform sense, provided the initial constrained estimator is sufficiently accurate. Lastly, I apply the method to an application involving network estimation with panel data.

</details>


### [353] [Uniform Inference on Quantile Effects under Network Interference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22286)
*Zequn Jin,Gaoqian Xu,Zixin Yang,Zhengyu Zhang*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究网络实验中分位数处理效应和溢出效应。提出结构分位数效应来刻画处理状态和邻居处理暴露对结果分布不同部分的影响，并基于条件高斯逼近构建均匀置信带（UCB），避免了对度分布稳定性的要求，适用于实际网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统平均溢出效应只能揭示处理邻居对单位结果的平均影响，掩盖了这些效应在结果分布上的异质性。需要一种方法刻画处理对结果分布不同分位数的影响。

Method: 定义结构分位数效应比较不同暴露状态下的结果分位数。基于Leung (2020)建立估计的分位数效应过程的弱收敛性，主要创新是提出基于条件于实现网络的Gaussian逼近的均匀置信带，避免度分布稳定化和网络依赖协方差结构的条件要求。

Result: 通过广泛的模拟研究和在尼泊尔随机储蓄账户实验（Prina 2015）中的实证应用评估了所提方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的均匀置信带方法在网络实验中能够有效刻画分位数处理与溢出效应，无需依赖网络度分布稳定化条件，为实证研究提供了更稳健的推断工具。

Abstract: This paper studies quantile treatment and spillover effects in network experiments. Average spillover effects reveal how treating a unit's neighbors affects its outcome on average, but mask the heterogeneity of these effects across the outcome distribution. We define structural quantile effects that compare outcome quantiles between exposure states, characterizing how own treatment and exposure to treated neighbors affect different parts of the outcome distribution. Building on \citet{leung2020treatment}, we first establish the weak convergence of the estimated quantile-effect process under conditions requiring the stabilization of the degree distribution and the network-dependent covariance structure. Our main contribution is to propose uniform confidence bands (UCBs) based on Gaussian approximations conditional on the realized network, avoiding these stabilization requirements. The proposed method is evaluated through extensive simulation studies and an empirical application to a randomized savings-account experiment in Nepal \citep{prina2015banking}.

</details>


### [354] [Fixed-$T$ Dynamic Spatial Panel Model with Common Shocks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22499)
*Jushan Bai,Jesse Chieh Chen*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究了在大N固定T框架下的动态空间面板模型，该模型包含观测回归量、交互效应以及同期和滞后空间依赖。通过将模型同时视为N维联立方程系统和T维方程组，结合空间增强随机载荷（SERL）设定，避免了单位特定附带参数问题（Nickell偏差），并提出了一种计算可行的块坐标算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态空间面板模型在固定T和大N情况下，交互效应引入了N个单位特定的载荷向量。若在T固定时单独估计每个载荷向量，会产生附带参数问题（导致Nickell偏差）。需要一种方法既能处理空间同时性，又能避免单位特定的附带参数。

Method: 作者采用双重视角来处理模型：(1) N方程视角，通过空间雅可比矩阵刻画空间同时性；(2) T方程视角，结合空间增强随机载荷（SERL）设定，构造不包含单位特定附带参数的拟似然函数。在此基础上提出一种计算上可行的块坐标算法进行估计。

Result: 模拟实验表明该方法具有较小的估计误差和接近名义覆盖率的性质。应用于美国县级女性劳动力参与率数据时，发现存在显著的动态和空间依赖性，且教育在解释女性劳动力参与率上升中发挥重要作用。

Conclusion: 通过T方程视角与SERL设定相结合，成功解决了固定T动态空间面板模型中交互效应带来的附带参数问题，同时通过N方程视角保持了空间同时性的正确处理，为实际应用提供了有效的估计方法。

Abstract: We study a dynamic spatial panel model with observed regressors, interactive effects, and contemporaneous and lagged dependence in a large-$N$, fixed-$T$ framework. The spatial model constitutes an $N$-dimensional simultaneous-equations system. In this $N$-equation view, the interactive effects introduce $N$ unit-specific loading vectors. Estimating them individually when $T$ is fixed creates the type of incidental-parameters problem underlying Nickell bias. We use the $N$-equation view to account for spatial simultaneity through the spatial Jacobian. Crucially, however, we view the same model as a $T$-equation system with $N$ observations. Together with a spatially enriched random-loadings (SERL) specification, this $T$-equation view yields a quasi-likelihood without unit-specific incidental parameters. We propose a computationally tractable block-coordinate algorithm. Simulations show small estimation errors and generally near-nominal coverage probabilities. Applying the method to U.S. county female labor-force participation, we find substantial dynamic and spatial dependence and an important role for education in explaining the rise in female labor-force participation.

</details>


### [355] [Closed-form estimation and uniform inference in additively separable triangular models with a nonseparable first stage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22605)
*Keita Sunada*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究了具有连续内生变量和工具变量的可加可分离三角模型的非参数识别与估计问题，允许第一阶段方程不可分离。在工具变量与不可观测项独立的假设下，证明了结果函数可表示为条件累积分布函数的闭式泛函，由此得到的插件估计量无需正则化，以n^{-m/(2m+1)}的速率收敛且达到最优。并利用经验bootstrap构造了覆盖紧集上所有点的均匀置信带。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在计量经济学中，三角模型广泛用于处理内生性问题。现有的可加可分离三角模型的非参数识别和估计方法通常需要第一阶段也具有可分离结构，或者需要复杂的正则化处理。本文旨在放宽这些限制，允许第一阶段方程不可分离，并提供无需正则化的简洁识别策略。

Method: 在工具变量与不可观测项独立的假设下，推导出结果函数作为条件累积分布函数的闭式泛函表达式。基于此构造插件估计量，无需任何正则化平滑参数。利用经验bootstrap方法构建覆盖紧凑集上所有点的均匀置信带。

Result: 插件估计量无需正则化且收敛速率为n^{-m/(2m+1)}，其中m为模型施加的光滑阶数。同时证明了该速率是最优的（不存在更快的估计量）。经验bootstrap成功构造了均匀置信带，可同时覆盖紧集上所有点。

Conclusion: 该研究为具有不可分离第一阶段的可加可分离三角模型提供了新的非参数识别与估计框架，其闭式表达式和最优收敛速率使得该方法在理论上具有吸引力，bootstrap置信带也为实际推断提供了便利工具。

Abstract: This paper studies the nonparametric identification and estimation of additively separable triangular models with continuous endogenous and instrumental variables, allowing for a nonseparable first-stage equation. Under the independence of instrumental variables and unobservables, we show that the outcome function possesses a closed-form expression as a functional of conditional cumulative distribution functions. The resulting plug-in estimators require no regularization and converge at the rate $n^{-m/(2m+1)}$, where $m$ is the order of smoothness the model imposes. Also, no estimator of the outcome function converges faster. We use the empirical bootstrap to construct a uniform confidence band that covers the outcome function at every point of a compact set simultaneously.

</details>


### [356] [Double/Debiased Machine Learning for Functional-Form-Robust Spatial Autoregression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22706)
*Jieun Lee*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种双/去偏机器学习（DML）推断方法，用于空间自回归（SAR）模型中的低维参数估计。该方法在空间权重矩阵W未知且需从潜在内生特征中灵活学习的情况下，构建运算符正交的SAR-IV/GMM得分，并结合缓冲空间交叉拟合，实现对交互结构估计的稳健推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SAR推断通常假设空间权重矩阵W已知，但在实际中W往往是未知的，且经验结论对W的设定高度敏感。此外，W的生成特征可能具有内生性，且学习到的W进入空间滞后与空间变换工具变量，若将其视为已知会造成一阶生成W效应，导致推断失真。

Method: 1) 在保持的可行支撑内，将交互强度建模为地理和社会经济特征的未知函数；2) 通过基于局部相关第一阶段残差的非线性控制函数处理特征内生性；3) 构建运算符正交的SAR-IV/GMM得分以消除首阶生成W敏感性；4) 采用缓冲空间交叉拟合，将评估得分足迹与干扰训练观测分离；5) 在近端依赖和空间混合创新场的条件下建立渐近理论。

Result: 蒙特卡洛模拟表明，在交互函数设定错误、权重生成特征内生以及观测空间相关的情况下，该方法相比非正交替代方法具有更好的有限样本推断表现。美国糖尿病数据集的应用显示，估计结果随W选择而变化，且即使对相同学习到的W，不同推断方法也产生不同结果，凸显了W学习时推断的重要性。

Conclusion: 该研究为SAR模型中未知且从内生特征学习的空间权重矩阵提供了稳健的推断框架，消除了生成W的一阶效应，并证明了估计量的渐近线性与根n正态性。研究强调了当W是学习得到时进行适当推断的必要性，而非简单将其视为已知。

Abstract: Spatial autoregressive inference is typically conditional on the spatial weights matrix, W, even though the underlying interaction structure is often unknown and empirical conclusions can be sensitive to its specification. This paper develops double/debiased machine learning inference for low-dimensional SAR parameters when the spatial interaction operator is learned flexibly from potentially endogenous characteristics. Within a maintained admissible support, interaction strength is generated by an unknown function of geographic and socioeconomic characteristics, making inference robust to functional form specification of the weights within that support. Endogeneity in the characteristics generating W is addressed through a nonlinear control function based on locally relevant first-stage residual information. Because the learned operator enters both the spatial lag and spatially transformed instruments, treating the estimated W as known generally leaves a first-order generated-W effect. I construct an operator-orthogonal SAR-IV/GMM score that removes this leading sensitivity and combine it with buffered spatial cross-fitting that separates evaluation-score footprints from nuisance-training observations. Under near epoch dependence on a spatially mixing innovation field and target-relevant nuisance rate and regularity conditions, the estimator is asymptotically linear and root-n normal. Monte Carlo simulations show improved finite-sample inference relative to nonorthogonal alternatives when the interaction function is misspecified, weight generating characteristics are endogenous, and observations are spatially dependent. In a U.S. application, diabetes estimates vary with the choice of W, showing the sensitivity of SAR inference to the interaction structure. Even for the same learned W, results differ across inferential methods, highlighting the importance of inference when W is learned.

</details>


### [357] [How Replicable Are Statistically Significant Findings?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23257)
*Patrick Vu,Stefan Faridani*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究了在实证科学中，刚达到常规显著性阈值（如p=0.05）的研究结果在相同样本量的复制研究中保持显著的可能性。通过估计预期复制概率，发现p值为0.05的结果在不同领域的复制概率仅约0.10-0.25，表明低可复制性源于原始研究功效不足而非发表偏倚。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显著性阈值在实证科学中常被用作判断研究结果是否为效应证据的标准，但人们对"刚好达到显著性阈值"的发现能够在复制研究中保持显著的概率知之甚少。这关系到科学结论的可靠性，需要量化这种"恰好显著"结果的可复制性。

Method: 研究者估计了给定p值条件下的预期复制概率（expected replication probability），使用实验经济学、心理学和社会科学领域已发表研究的数据进行估计。通过与实际复制结果对比验证该指标的有效性（优于预测市场），并开发了一种非参数估计器，应用于使用更大样本量的经济学文献。

Result: p值为0.05的发现其预期复制概率在不同领域间约为0.10到0.25。低可复制性主要归因于原始研究统计功效不足，而非发表偏倚。针对使用更大样本量的经济学文献，复制概率虽有所提高但仍然偏低。

Conclusion: 单一研究中的统计显著性仅能提供关于效应的提示性证据，更强有力的结论需要依赖累积证据而非单个研究的结果。

Abstract: In the empirical sciences, significance thresholds often determine whether findings are treated as evidence of an effect. This paper studies how likely findings that just meet conventional significance thresholds are to remain significant in replications of the same sample size. To answer this question, we estimate the expected replication probability conditional on a given p-value among published studies for experimental economics, psychology, and social science. We validate this measure by showing it accurately predicts actual replication outcomes, outperforming prediction markets. A finding with a p-value of 0.05 has an expected replication probability ranging from 0.10 to 0.25 across fields. Low replicability reflects low power in original studies rather than publication bias. We then develop a nonparametric estimator and apply it to economics literatures that use larger samples, finding higher but still low replication probabilities. These results indicate that statistical significance in a single study provides only suggestive evidence of an effect. Stronger conclusions require cumulative evidence.

</details>


### [358] [Systematic Bias in Green Patent Classification: Silent Green and False Green](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23420)
*Hamid Bekamiri,Jan Auernhammer,Milad Abbasiharofteh,Jesper Lindgaard Christensen*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本研究首次在专利语料库规模上审计了基于CPC Y02标签的绿色专利指标的结构效度。通过引入"误差即信号"框架，利用微调领域模型与两个独立大语言模型的共识判定，筛出517,772个分歧。发现180,384个行政性I类错误（假绿色）和29,465个II类错误（沉默绿色），校正后绿色专利人口减少25.5%。偏差主要源于分类能力而非申请人策略，且结构性低估重工业。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Y02绿色专利指标被广泛用于研究、政策和投资，但其结构效度从未在语料库规模上被审计。研究者质疑Y02是否存在系统性偏差，以及这种偏差是否可能加剧ESG创新脱节现象。

Method: 引入"误差作为信号"框架，将行政标签与独立模型之间的分歧视为测量误差的诊断证据。使用微调领域模型筛选9,075,421件USPTO授权专利（1962-2024），两个独立的开源大语言模型通过共识判定每个标记发明是否具有直接气候减缓或适应功能。

Result: 发现180,384个假绿色错误（集中在数字数据处理、无线网络、数字通信和半导体），29,465个沉默绿色错误（集中在分离过程、催化、排气控制、热泵、电力系统和电池）。校正后绿色专利人口从592,387降至441,468件（减少25.5%），ICT能源效率（Y02D）下降67.6%。遗漏与技术非常规性呈倒U型关系。事件测试显示2013年CPC启动后无离散跳跃，仅有小幅绿色框架上升。

Conclusion: Y02分类偏差主要反映分类能力而非申请人战略，且结构性低估重工业。这一发现对依赖Y02指标的绿色创新研究、气候政策和清洁技术投资具有重要警示意义，需重新评估现有绿色专利指标的可信度。

Abstract: Green-patent indicators built on Cooperative Patent Classification Y02 tags are widely used in research, policy, and investment, yet their construct validity has not been audited at corpus scale. We assess whether Y02 is systematically biased and whether that bias may reinforce the ESG innovation disconnect. We introduce an Error-as-Signal framework that treats disagreement between an administrative label and an independent model as diagnostic evidence of measurement error. Screening 9,075,421 USPTO granted patents (1962-2024) with a fine-tuned domain model against Y02 yields 517,772 disagreements. Two independent open-weight large language models then judge by consensus whether each flagged invention has a direct climate-mitigation or adaptation function. We identify 180,384 administrative Type I errors (False Green), concentrated in digital data processing, wireless networks, digital communications, and semiconductors, and 29,465 Type II errors (Silent Green), concentrated in separation processes, catalysis, exhaust control, heat pumps, power systems, and batteries. Correcting consensus-attributed errors reduces the measured green-patent population by 25.5% (592,387 to 441,468 patents; sensitivity bounds 390,540-508,126), with ICT energy efficiency (Y02D) falling 67.6%. Omission follows an inverted-U relationship with technological atypicality, making complex and unconventional inventions especially likely to go unlabelled. Event tests show no discrete jump in misclassification when green classification became salient and only a small rise in green framing after the 2013 CPC launch. The bias primarily reflects classification capacity rather than applicant strategy and structurally under-recognizes heavy industry.

</details>


### [359] [Testing selection on observables in parametric models with refreshment samples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23508)
*Grigory Franguridi,Arie Kapteyn*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于面板数据中refreshment sample的MAR假设统计检验方法，通过比较在MAR下有效的IPW加权估计与在较弱加性不可忽略性假设下有效的替代加权估计所得到分布之间的距离来检验MAR假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面板数据中常因流失（attrition）或未响应（nonresponse）导致样本选择问题，研究者通常假设缺失随机（MAR）或基于可观测变量选择，但该假设往往不合理。现有研究中，当有refreshment sample（刷新样本）可用时，MAR假设变得可检验，但缺乏系统性的统计检验方法。

Method: 开发一种基于两个估计分布之间距离的MAR统计检验：一个分布通过标准逆概率加权（IPW）获得（在MAR下有效），另一个通过替代加权获得（在Hirano et al. (2001)提出的加性不可忽略性较弱假设下有效）。该检验隐含地比较了流失期间IPW加权样本的分布与刷新样本的分布，若MAR成立则两者应一致。当输入分布为参数化时，证明了检验统计量在原假设下收敛于广义卡方分布，该极限分布可通过Franguridi et al. (2026)的递归公式估计。

Result: 通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证了检验的性能；并将该检验应用于Understanding America Study (UAS)数据集的子样本实证案例中。

Conclusion: 该检验为面板数据中MAR假设提供了正式的统计检验工具，使得研究者能够在有refreshment sample的情况下检验MAR假设的合理性，从而为后续使用IPW等基于MAR的方法提供依据。

Abstract: In panels with sample selection (that may occur due to attrition, nonresponse, etc.), the assumption of selection on observables (missing at random, MAR) is commonly imposed despite often being implausible. However, this assumption becomes testable when a refreshment sample is available. We develop a statistical test of MAR based on a distance between two estimated distributions: one obtained using the standard inverse probability weighting (IPW) that is valid under MAR and the other obtained using an alternative weighting that is valid under a weaker assumption of additive nonignorability of Hirano et al. (2001). This test implicitly compares the distribution of the IPW-weighted sample in the attrition period with the distribution of the refreshment sample, which coincide if the MAR assumption holds. We establish that, when the input distributions are parametric, our test statistic converges to the generalized chi-squared distribution under the null of MAR. This limit distribution can be estimated using the recursive formulas derived by Franguridi et al. (2026). We illustrate the performance of our test in Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we apply our test to an empirical example using a subsample of the Understanding America Study (UAS) dataset.

</details>

### [360] [Does Rank Still Matter? Position Bias When AI Agents Shop on Our Behalf](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22697)
*Davood Wadi,Yu Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过5,000次AI代理会话，随机化100个酒店列表的顺序，对比四种大语言模型与人类实地数据的搜索行为。发现AI代理比人类搜索更深且从不拒绝购买；位置虽仍影响检查但呈弱且非单调的模式（页面中部而非底部检查概率最低）；位置是否到达选择阶段因模型而异，但所有模型最终收敛于同一未支配列表，表明属性比位置更重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统搜索排名对消费者注意力至关重要，因为人类注意力稀缺且顺序化。但随着消费者将搜索委托给能一次性消化整个结果页面的AI代理，位置效应的传统认知可能不再适用。作者试图探究AI代理搜索中，排名位置是否仍然影响选择行为，以及这种影响与人类有何不同。

Method: 在5,000个AI代理会话中随机化100个酒店列表的顺序，将四种大语言模型的表现与人类实地数据进行比较，分析位置对检查（inspection）和选择（choice）两个阶段的影响。

Result: AI代理比人类搜索更深且从不拒绝购买。位置仍能预测哪些列表被检查，但效应弱且非单调——页面中部的检查概率最低而非底部。位置是否到达选择阶段因模型而异，这种异质性既不与提供商也不与能力相关。但所有模型均收敛到同一未支配列表。

Conclusion: 在代理搜索中，结果页面显示的属性比页面内的位置更重要。传统搜索排名对人类注意力的位置效应，在AI代理情境下大幅弱化，提示搜索排名策略需要针对代理搜索重新设计。

Abstract: Search rankings are valuable because human attention is scarce and sequential. Higher-placed alternatives are easier to find, so they are examined and bought more often. Consumers are now delegating search to AI agents that can ingest an entire results page at once. Randomizing the order of one hundred hotel listings across 5,000 AI agent sessions, we compare four large language models against human field data. AI agents search more deeply than humans and never decline to buy. Position still predicts which listings are inspected, but weakly and non-monotonically: the middle of a results page has the lowest probability of inspection, not the bottom. Position reaches the choice stage for some models and not others, a heterogeneity that tracks neither provider nor capability. All models nonetheless converge on the same undominated listing. For agentic search, the attributes displayed on a results page matter more than placement within it.

</details>


### [361] [Your AI, On a Dial: Controlling Investment Bias in LLMs with a Single Neuron](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22852)
*Sahong Park,Suhwan Park,Hoyoung Lee,Gakyung Kwon,Wonbin Ahn,Jaewon Choi,Alejandro Lopez-Lira,Yoon Kim,Chanyeol Choi,Hyeongwoo Kong,Yongjae Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"投资偏好拨盘"（investment-bias dial），通过对单个神经元的推理时干预，持续调整LLM整体的投资决策先验（买卖倾向），无需修改提示词或模型参数，即可在五个开源模型中实现单调的投资立场校准，并在响应级、智能体检索、长上下文及组合构建等多个层面产生稳定且可迁移的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的研究工作表明，LLM在投资决策中表现出系统性且模型特定的投资偏好，这可能导致不可控的决策偏差。因此，研究者希望探索能否将模型的整体投资立场精确地校准到指定的方向和强度，从而实现对模型投资行为的可控调节。

Method: 引入一个"投资偏好拨盘"——一种针对单个神经元的推理时干预（inference-time intervention），能够连续调整模型级的决策先验（整体买卖倾向），而不针对特定公司或投资属性。使用匹配的正负证据，对五个开放权重LLM进行评估。

Result: 实验结果显示：拨盘能产生投资立场的单调变化，且无需修改提示词或模型参数；在响应层面，拨盘同时改变投资决策和生成推理的证据侧重点；在智能体检索环境中，拨盘改变模型搜索的信息、选中的证据以及最终分析中体现的证据；在长上下文评估中，拨盘能持续保持立场控制，而系统提示指令随上下文增长而衰减；拨盘的变化还传导至证券排序和下游投资组合构建（回溯测试）。

Conclusion: 研究表明，LLM的整体投资立场可以在推理时被校准到指定目标，提供了一种比系统提示更稳健、更持续的投资偏好控制机制，为金融AI系统中模型行为的可控性提供了新的工具和方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in investment decision-making, yet prior work shows that they exhibit systematic, model-specific investment preferences. We study whether a model's overall investment stance can be calibrated to a specified direction and strength. We introduce an investment-bias dial, an inference-time intervention on a single neuron that continuously adjusts a model-level decision prior---its overall tendency toward buying or selling---without targeting specific firms or investment attributes. Using matched positive and negative evidence, we evaluate five open-weight LLMs and find that the dial produces monotonic changes in investment stance without modifying prompts or model parameters. At the response level, the dial shifts both investment decisions and the evidential emphasis of generated rationales under identical inputs. In an agentic retrieval setting, the dial also changes what information the model searches for, which evidence it selects, and which evidence is reflected in its final analysis. In a long-context evaluation, the dial maintains stable stance control as context length increases, whereas a matched system-prompt instruction progressively attenuates. We further show that changes in the dial propagate to security rankings and downstream portfolio composition in an exploratory backtest. Overall, our results show that an LLM's aggregate investment stance can be calibrated toward a specified target at inference time.

</details>


### [362] [KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21362)
*Srihari Unnikrishnan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KVBoost是一个块级KV缓存复用系统，通过双哈希键控方案（区分位置身份与内容身份）实现任意位置的内容复用，并采用选择性重计算和CacheBlend重计算策略修复注意力边界误差，配合非对称KV量化、自适应块分割和重要性加权淘汰策略，在Qwen2.5-3B模型上实现4.49倍的首令牌延迟降低，且准确率无损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer大语言模型因每请求需重新计算KV张量而面临高预填充延迟。现有前缀缓存系统要求提示词共享连续的前缀，当共享内容出现在任意位置时复用效率受限，亟需一种与内容位置无关的KV缓存复用方案。

Method: KVBoost采用三项核心技术：(1) 双哈希键控方案，用前缀哈希表示位置身份、内容哈希表示内容身份，支持精确和近似缓存匹配；(2) 两种边界错误修复策略——选择性重计算（重新编码边界区域）和CacheBlend重计算（探针遍历后识别并重算高偏差token）；(3) 系统级优化，包括int8/int4非对称KV量化、自适应块边界分割和固定内存预算下的重要性加权淘汰。

Result: 在Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B模型上对1,000个bug定位样本进行评测，KVBoost将首令牌延迟从639.1ms降至142.4ms（4.49倍加速），相比前缀缓存提升16%，准确率保持99.2% vs 99.1%无显著损失。

Conclusion: KVBoost提供了与RoPE模型兼容、无需架构修改的实用有界内存推理加速层，能够实现任意位置的内容复用，在保持精度的同时显著降低预填充延迟，为HuggingFace兼容解码器模型提供了可落地的加速方案。

Abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) incur high prefill latency because key-value (KV) tensors must be recomputed for each request. Existing prefix-caching systems reduce this cost but require prompts to share a leading contiguous prefix, limiting effectiveness when shared content appears at arbitrary positions. We present KVBoost, a chunk-level KV cache reuse system for HuggingFace-compatible decoder models that enables reuse regardless of content position. KVBoost introduces a dual-hash keying scheme that separates positional identity (prefix hash) from content identity (content hash), supporting both exact and approximate cache matches. To address attention boundary errors from independently cached chunks, KVBoost employs two repair strategies: SelectiveRecompute, which re-encodes boundary regions, and CacheBlendRecompute, which identifies and recomputes high-deviation tokens after a probe pass. The system further incorporates asymmetric KV quantization (int8/int4), adaptive chunk boundary splitting, and importance-weighted eviction under a fixed memory budget. Evaluated on Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B over 1,000 bug-localization samples, KVBoost achieves a 4.49x reduction in time-to-first-token (142.4 ms vs.\ 639.1 ms) and outperforms prefix caching by 16%, with no loss in accuracy (99.2% vs.\ 99.1%). KVBoost provides a practical, memory-bounded inference acceleration layer compatible with RoPE-based models without architectural modification.

</details>


### [363] [AIREP: A Protocol for Per-Decision Evidence in AI Runtime Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21363)
*Ali Toygar Abak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AIREP协议，用于记录AI运行时（runtime）的治理决策（如发布、阻止、延迟、编辑或升级输出）。每条记录以签名对象形式存在，可离线验证，并通过SHA-256哈希链绑定记录位置以检测篡改和缺口，格式保持供应商/模型/域名中立，附带参考实现和双语言一致性测试套件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI运行时越来越多地做出治理决策（如内容审核、合规检查），这些决策需要可审计、可验证的记录。现有方案缺乏统一、中立、可离线验证的格式，导致决策无法被独立检查或追溯。

Method: 1) 定义封闭动词集（release/block/defer/redact/escalate）作为治理决策类型；2) 记录通过哈希引用输入、输出和证据而非存储值；3) 构建SHA-256哈希链绑定每条记录的位置，使篡改和间隙可通过重算检测；4) 使用单一可选命名空间隔离供应商/模型/领域特定内容，并通过机械中立性测试确保共享格式不受污染。

Result: 提供了参考实现和双语言一致性测试（conformance kit），并指出了实现中的问题，包括跨实现规范形式对齐、新鲜度见证（freshness witnesses）以及多运行时链等挑战。

Conclusion: 该格式作为开放标准提供给任何需要记录治理决策的AI运行时采用，通过离线可验证、哈希链防篡改、格式中立等特性，建立了AI治理决策的可审计性基础。

Abstract: A protocol is presented for recording the governance decisions of automated AI runtimes. When a runtime releases, blocks, defers, redacts, or escalates an individual output, AIREP records that decision as a single signed object that any party can check offline, independent of the runtime that produced it. A record carries the decision as one of a closed set of verbs under a stated policy basis, references its input, output, and evidence by hash rather than by value, and declares both what its evidence covers and what it does not. Records form a SHA-256 hash chain that binds each record to its position, so that tampering and gaps are detectable by recomputation. Vendor-, model-, and domain-specific content is confined to a single optional namespace, and a mechanical neutrality test keeps the shared format free of it. A reference implementation and a two-language conformance kit are described. Some implementation issues are considered, and problems such as alignment of the canonical form across implementations, freshness witnesses, and multi-runtime chains are exposed. The format is offered for adoption by any AI runtime that records governance decisions.

</details>


### [364] [Reviewing Model Collapse and Countermeasures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21366)
*Xihao Xie,Beichen Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对生成式AI中"模型坍缩"(Model Collapse)现象进行了全面综述，涵盖不同应用场景下的研究进展以及缓解该问题的对策，并指出了未来研究挑战与机遇。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展促使研究者使用AI合成数据来训练下一代模型，虽缓解了数据供给压力，但在模型与数据自我循环的过程中会导致模型坍缩，引发信任危机。然而目前缺乏对模型坍缩现象的系统性综述，需要填补这一空白。

Method: 本文采用综述方法，系统梳理和整合近年来关于模型坍缩现象的研究文献，从不同应用场景和缓解对策两个维度进行归纳与总结。

Result: 提供了模型坍缩在不同应用场景下的研究进展概述，并整理了用于缓解模型坍缩的多种对策。

Conclusion: 指出模型坍缩研究仍面临诸多挑战，并展望了未来的研究方向与机会。

Abstract: Driven by massive amounts of web-scale data, generative AI (GenAI) has achieved remarkable progress, enabling various applications in diverse sectors. The advances of GenAI have actuated practitioners to use AI-synthesized data for training next-generation AI models. Undeniably, using synthetic data has alleviated the increasing stringent demand for data supply. Unfortunately, it also introduces a new critical issue: in a self-consuming cycle between model and data, the model ultimately collapse, raising more trustworthiness concerns to GenAI. In recent years, increasingly more studies have investigated the phenomenon of model collapse (MC) and explored potential solutions to mitigate it. However, the review of the phenomenon of MC still remains blank. To fill this gap, this paper provides an up-to-date overview of these studies for consolidating and reviewing the progress of MC in different application scenarios and countermeasures for mitigating MC. We also highlight challenges and future research opportunities.

</details>


### [365] [AI Learning and Conceptual Transfer in the Game of Hidden Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21372)
*Christo Mathew,Wentian Wang,Jacob Feldman,Lazaros K. Gallos,Paul B. Kantor,Vladimir Menkov,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文档总结了Game of Hidden Rules (GOHR)上的研究工作，涵盖强化学习智能体从试错反馈中推断隐藏规则的能力、表示设计（Feature-Centric和Object-Centric）、规则难度分析、迁移学习、泛化能力，以及伪机器人辅助的人类学习分析。核心工作是Transformer-based A2C框架及其在多种实验中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索强化学习智能体在隐藏规则环境（GOHR）中通过试错反馈推断规则的能力，并研究不同表示设计（特征中心与对象中心）对学习效果的影响，同时分析人类学习数据以理解人机学习差异。

Method: 采用基于Transformer的A2C（Advantage Actor-Critic）强化学习框架，设计了Feature-Centric和Object-Centric两种输入表示方式，并在GOHR环境中进行训练与评估。同时结合规则难度分析、迁移学习和泛化实验，以及对人类学习数据的分类分析。

Result: 报告呈现了Transformer-based A2C框架在不同表示下的实验发现，包括规则难度对学习效果的影响、迁移学习与泛化能力的表现，以及基于伪机器人辅助人类学习数据的分类结果。

Conclusion: 该研究为理解强化学习智能体在隐藏规则推断任务中的能力提供了系统性分析，并揭示了表示设计对学习效率和泛化能力的关键影响，同时为人类学习辅助系统的设计提供了参考。

Abstract: This report summarizes the work conducted on the Game of Hidden Rules (GOHR), focusing on reinforcement learning agents trained to infer hidden rules from trial-and-error feedback, representation design, rule difficulty analysis, transfer learning, generalization, and pseudo-bot-assisted human learning analysis. The report focuses on the Transformer-based A2C framework, Feature-Centric and Object-Centric representations, experimental findings, and classification of human learning data.

</details>


### [366] [LitReview Arena: Evaluating Literature Review Agents with Battle-Style Peer Review Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21374)
*Ruotong Zhao,Zhiyu Chen,Xurui Liu,Haidong Xue,Dong Liang,Jigao Fu,Wu YanBiao,Yuanyi Zhen,Fengli Xu,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LitReview Arena，一个针对文献综述质量的对抗式评估平台，收集约3k份专家评判数据，发现现有最强系统在总体效用上仅对人类草稿取得23.0%的胜率，且LLM-as-a-judge方法与人类专家相关性低（rho=0.467），并基于偏好数据训练了专家校准评估器LitJudge，将一致性提升至rho=0.78。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文献综述对科学进步至关重要，但自动生成的综述评估困难，因为许多研究实用性方面依赖专家判断而非参考重叠指标。现有评估方法无法充分反映综述质量，需要更严谨的评估协议。

Method: 提出LitReview Arena，一种战斗式评估平台，采用结构化协议：由具有AI论文写作经验的领域专家比较匿名草稿，匹配至其专业领域内的主题，并按五个综述特定标准提供维度级评估结果。同时基于收集的偏好数据训练LitJudge评估器。

Result: 收集约3k专家评判（每个含五个维度结果）；最强系统仅以23.0%胜率赢得对人类草稿的决定性比赛；Sonar Deep Research等智能体LLM比基础语言模型性能提升超60%；LLM-as-a-judge方法与人类专家相关性仅rho=0.467；LitJudge将相关性提升至rho=0.78，与专家间一致性相当。

Conclusion: 现有自动生成综述系统仍明显弱于人类专家，智能体化LLM具有显著优势，且当前LLM评估方法与专家判断存在严重偏差。LitReview Arena及其偏好数据可用于训练更对齐的评估器，缩小机器评估与人类专家判断之间的差距。

Abstract: Literature reviews are essential to scientific progress, but rigorously evaluating automatically generated reviews remains difficult because many aspects of research utility depend on expert judgment rather than reference-overlap metrics. We introduce LitReview Arena, a battle-style evaluation platform with a structured protocol tailored to literature review quality: domain experts with AI paper-writing experience compare anonymized drafts, are matched to topics within their expertise, and provide dimension-wise outcomes over five literature-review-specific criteria. From this protocol, we collect approximately 3k expert judgments, each containing five dimension-wise outcomes, and show that even the strongest current systems win only 23.0% of decisive matches against human drafts on overall utility, while agentic LLMs such as Sonar Deep Research substantially outperform base language models by over 60%. We further find that existing LLM-as-a-judge methods are substantially misaligned with human experts (Spearman's rho=0.467), especially on synthesis-heavy criteria such as paper structure and research suggestions. Using the collected preference data, we provide an expert-calibrated evaluator, LitJudge, which improves alignment to Spearman's rho=0.78, comparable to inter-expert consistency; code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/VanellopeAsher/LitReview-Arena.

</details>


### [367] [SchemaRouter: Field-Aware Tool Routing for Efficient Heterogeneous Agentic RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21375)
*Yong-eun Cho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SchemaRouter是一个轻量级路由层，通过模式图（schema graph）表示工具、端点、参数、响应字段等元数据，在异质智能体RAG系统中实现可解释的工具规划和字段选择，在保持竞争性准确率的同时显著降低token消耗和延迟，并提供可验证的来源/许可信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异质智能体RAG系统需要编排多种工具（外部API、数据库、向量存储、图存储），但暴露所有工具描述或仅靠向量相似度选择工具会导致两种昂贵失败：过获取（增加payload、token和延迟）和欠获取（遗漏回答查询所需的字段）。

Method: SchemaRouter构建一个模式图，涵盖工具、端点、参数、响应字段、领域概念、单位、来源和许可策略。查询时：小型LLM提取意图、概念和来源约束；字段选择通过意图组投影和概念-字段匹配（带别名层）在图上确定性执行，最终生成可执行的工具计划。

Result: 在材料科学110个查询基准上：答案准确率0.71（与fetch-everything相当，略高于prompt-all的0.66）；上下文token仅227 vs fetch-everything的2066；端到端延迟比prompt-all低2.7倍；工具精确率0.93，参数有效性1.0；62%的答案包含来源/许可信息（基线约为0%）。还发现最小化字段数量会降低准确率至0.56，而保持召回率的投影可恢复最佳准确率。

Conclusion: SchemaRouter在竞争力准确率下实现效率提升、与模式规模无关的扩展性以及可验证的来源/许可接地回答，同时揭示了"最小化字段数"策略的陷阱——召回保持投影优于激进的字段精简。

Abstract: Heterogeneous agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly orchestrate external APIs, internal databases, vector stores, and graph stores. Exposing all tool descriptions to an LLM agent, or selecting tools only by vector similarity, causes two costly failures: over-fetching, which increases payload size, token use, and latency, and under-fetching, which omits fields needed to answer the query.
  We present SchemaRouter, a lightweight routing layer that represents tools, endpoints, parameters, response fields, domain concepts, units, provenance, and license policies as a schema graph. Given a query, SchemaRouter emits an executable tool plan specifying which tools to call and which fields to retrieve. A small LLM extracts intent, concepts, and source constraints, while field selection is deterministic over the graph through intent-group projection and concept-field matching with an alias layer.
  On a materials-science benchmark of 110 queries, SchemaRouter achieves answer accuracy of 0.71, matching fetch-everything within overlapping confidence intervals and exceeding prompt-all's 0.66, though their intervals overlap. It uses 227 retrieved-context tokens versus 2,066 for fetch-everything and achieves 2.7x lower end-to-end latency than prompt-all. It also obtains the best tool-exact rate of 0.93 and parameter validity of 1.0. SchemaRouter grounds provenance and license information in 62 percent of answers, compared with approximately 0 percent for all baselines.
  We also find that minimizing selected-field count is counterproductive: it reduces answer accuracy to 0.56 with negligible token savings, while recall-preserving projection restores top accuracy. SchemaRouter improves efficiency, schema-size-independent scaling, and verifiable provenance/license-grounded answering at competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [368] [RIACT: A Responsible AI System for Personalized Study Habit Tracking and Early Burnout Signal Detection in University Students](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21379)
*Ria Sidhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RIACT，一个结合结构化学习会话记录与混合AI架构的Web应用，通过确定性规则检测倦怠信号，并用受限大语言模型生成个性化建议，旨在为学生提供学习行为的可解释性洞察和早期倦怠预警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学生倦怠在高等教育中高度普遍（12%-70%以上），但通常只能事后追溯识别。学生缺乏对自身学习行为的结构化可见性，现有生产力工具仅记录活动而不进行解释，无法提供早期预警。

Method: RIACT系统采用五阶段架构（记录、洞察、分析、辅导、追踪）。学生按地点和时间记录学习会话，系统计算净专注时间（扣除休息），通过透明的确定性规则基于周与周行为对比检测倦怠信号，并使用受限输出模式的大语言模型进行情境化解释和个性化建议。设计融入负责任AI原则：告警基于可审计规则而非模型判断，输出定位为观察而非诊断，数据收集限于自我记录的行为字段。

Result: 本文描述系统设计原理，将其定位在已有文献中，并提出一个评估框架用于对照已有倦怠测量工具验证其行为信号的有效性。

Conclusion: RIACT通过可解释、可审计的混合AI方法为学生提供早期倦怠监测，强调负责任AI原则，并规划了系统的实证验证方向。

Abstract: Student burnout is highly prevalent in higher education, with reported rates ranging from 12% to over 70% and consistently exceeding those of the working population - yet it is typically identified only retrospectively, after academic decline has already occurred. A contributing factor is that students have little structured visibility into their own study behaviour, and existing productivity tools record activity without interpreting it. This paper presents RIACT (Record, Insight, Analyze, Coach, Track), a web-based application that combines structured study session logging with a hybrid AI architecture to surface personalized insights and early burnout signals. Students log sessions by location and time; the system computes net focus time by accounting for breaks, detects burnout signals through transparent, deterministic rules operating on week-over-week behavioural comparisons, and uses a large language model - constrained to a fixed output schema - to contextualize patterns and generate personalized recommendations. The design embeds responsible AI principles throughout: warnings are governed by auditable rules rather than model judgement, all output is framed as an observation rather than a diagnosis and data collection is limited to self-logged behavioural fields. We describe the system's design rationale, situate it within the literature on student burnout and explainable AI in education and propose an evaluation framework for validating its behavioural signals against established burnout instruments.

</details>


### [369] [There Is No Neutral Harness: Modern LLM Leaderboards Are Manufactured by Config-Fragile Items](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21382)
*V. S. Raghu Parupudi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文引入"脆弱性网格"（fragility grid）：对4个基准的3,679个条目、12个开源指令微调LLM，在26种同样合理的评测配置下进行匹配比较，将评测配置视为自变量并解析到单个条目层面。结果显示模型得分是一个区间而非点（如gemma4-31b仅因评测配置差异从31%到89%），相邻模型的性能差距中95.7%来自配置敏感条目，4/12模型可在某配置下排第一，且条目区分度与脆弱性相关（r=0.28），基准压缩反而保留了脆弱条目。评分方式（而非选项顺序）是关键轴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明LLM评测存在配置敏感性，但仅将其报告为聚合分数方差，未检验方差落在哪些条目上、是否这些条目恰好是区分模型的条目。作者希望将评测配置（选项顺序、提示措辞、得分方式）从后台噪声转变为可检视的独立变量，精确到每个条目。

Method: 构建"脆弱性网格"：固定4个基准（ARC、HellaSwag、MMLU、TruthfulQA）共3,679个条目，12个开源模型（4个家族），在26种评测配置下用贪心解码生成每个模型-条目-配置的正确性比特。所有对照均匹配，只有评测配置变化。发布逐条目记录与分析脚本，可在CPU上快速重新生成结果。

Result: （1）gemma4-31b得分区间为31%-89%，仅取决于评测配置；（2）相邻模型稳定作答的条目上两者平局，配置脆弱条目承载了平均95.7%的模型差距；（3）12个模型中有4个可在某些配置下排名第一，评测配置决定冠军；（4）条目区分度与脆弱性相关系数0.28（95% CI 0.25-0.30），基准压缩方法最大化区分度反而保留了脆弱条目；（5）评分方式是最重要的轴，而非通常协议固定的选项顺序。

Conclusion: LLM测评报告应把分数视为区间而非点，排行榜在报告排序前应运行脆弱性网格检查。当评分方式不变时聚合基准无法捕获的配置风险，被压缩掉的应是非脆弱条目而非脆弱条目。

Abstract: Multiple-choice benchmarks fix the questions and the correct answers, but not the harness: the order of the options, the wording of the prompt, and whether a language model's answer is read from generated text or from per-option likelihoods. Work on this harness sensitivity reports it as aggregate score variance, leaving unexamined which items the variance falls on and whether they are the items that separate one model from the next. We treat the evaluation harness of large language models (LLMs) as an independent variable and resolve its effect to single items. We introduce the \textit{fragility grid}: 12 open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs from 4 families answer the same 3{,}679 items from 4 benchmarks (ARC, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA) under 26 equally defensible harness configurations, recording one correctness bit for every model, item, and configuration. The comparison is matched, since the items, the weights, and the greedy decoding stay fixed while only the harness varies. Under the grid a model's score is a band rather than a point: gemma4-31b scores between 31 and 89 percent depending only on the harness. Three results follow. On the items that two adjacent models both answer stably the pair is tied, and config-fragile items carry 95.7 percent of a pair's gap on average. Four of the 12 models reach rank one under some configuration, so the harness selects the winner. Item discrimination, the property that benchmark-compression methods maximize, correlates with fragility at 0.28 (95 percent CI 0.25 to 0.30), so compression keeps the fragile items rather than removing them. The scoring choice, not the option order that protocols usually fix, is the load-bearing axis. We release the per-item records and the analysis script, from which every number regenerates on a CPU in seconds, and we position the fragility grid as a check a leaderboard can run before it reports an order.

</details>


### [370] [Spyre-Accelerated Retrieval-Augmented Generation on IBM LinuxONE: A Cloud-Native Architecture for Secure, High-Throughput Enterprise AI Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21393)
*Sandeep Bokkasam,Pankaj D*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种完全运行在IBM LinuxONE平台上的六子系统RAG架构，利用Spyre PCIe加速卡进行生成式推理、Telum II芯片进行轻量级分类任务、Red Hat OpenShift进行容器编排。所有流水线环节（查询接收、向量检索、提示词组装、LLM推理、合规过滤、响应交付）都在单一LinuxONE系统内完成，确保敏感数据不离开硬件边界。早期分析显示端到端RAG延迟低于2秒，相比平台外推理最多可减少20倍延迟，同时保持强加密和审计能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
