We present Jiuge-Tuiqiao, an interactive human-AI collaborative system for classical Chinese poetry composition. The system is designed around a triadic model: user-driven control, ancient-guided evidence, and AI-assisted generation. Users can lock characters or lines, receive real-time prosody feedback, and obtain interpretable refinement suggestions grounded in high-frequency collocations, PPL-ranked classical lines, and structured knowledge extracted from classical encyclopedias. This design turns AI from an autonomous generator into a background assistant that supports the user's own process of poetic refinement. Preliminary experiments and user feedback suggest that Jiuge-Tuiqiao improves controllability, interpretability, and user engagement in classical poetry composition.

</details>


### [502] [AI emotional support is better only when chosen, but shifts preferences even when it is not](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23196)
*Yaoxi Shi,Cathy Mengying Fang,Guy LabanPattie Maes,Amit Goldenberg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过三项实验（N=1,951）和一项为期28天的纵向研究（N=981），探讨人们寻求情感支持时在人类与AI之间的选择。研究发现：AI的支持仅在人们主动选择它时才被评价为更优；但无论选择是否一致，与AI互动都会增加再次选择AI的意愿。28天纵向数据显示，日常对话会使偏好逐渐从人类转向AI，但仅在对话涉及个人话题时发生。这表明情感支持的选择具有路径依赖性，会逐渐远离人类连接。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究大多直接指派支持来源或尊重人们的选择，但现实中人们常常得到与自己意愿不一致的支持。作者希望探究"选择与实际情况不一致"（incongruence）时，人类与AI情感支持的评价差异及偏好演变。

Method: 三项实验让参与者先选择情感支持来源（人类或AI），再随机分配到一致或不一致的互动伙伴；另与OpenAI合作进行28天纵向研究，追踪日常对话如何改变偏好，并区分个人与非个人话题的影响。

Result: AI支持仅在主动选择者中获得更高评价；但无论是否一致，互动都会提升再次选择AI的意愿。纵向研究中，对话会推动偏好从人类转向AI，且仅在对话内容个人化时才发生。

Conclusion: 情感支持选择存在路径依赖效应：一旦与AI互动（即使初选人类），偏好也会逐步转向AI，暗示人类情感连接的吸引力可能因AI互动的体验而被系统性削弱。

Abstract: People increasingly face a novel decision when seeking emotional support: human or AI. In existing studies, AI's empathic messages are rated as well as or better than humans'. But these studies either assigned the support source or honored people's choice. In real life, support is often incongruent with choice, as people want one source and receive the other. Across three experiments (N = 1,951), participants chose whether to share an emotional experience with a human or an AI, then were randomly assigned to a congruent or incongruent partner. AI support was rated as superior only among those who had chosen it. Yet regardless of congruence, interacting with AI increased willingness to choose it again. In a 28-day study with OpenAI (N = 981), daily conversations shifted preferences toward AI and away from humans, but only when conversations turned personal. Emotional support choices are thus path-dependent, progressively redirecting away from human connection.

</details>


### [503] [Cognitive Profiling of LRMs' Reasoning Traces Using Bloom's Taxonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23205)
*Maria-Eleni Zoumpoulidi,Georgios Paraskevopoulos,Alexandros Potamianos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于布鲁姆分类法的框架，用于自动标注大型推理模型（LRMs）推理过程中各步骤的思维类型，并在多个模型和数据集上进行大规模分析，发现思维类型与推理正确性相关，从而为改进推理质量提供可操作的见解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）的推理轨迹日益公开可获取，为在单步粒度上研究模型行为提供了机会，但当前对推理过程中所采用的思维类型（thinking types）的理解仍然不足，而这对于洞察推理模式和促进实际应用至关重要。

Method: 提出一个基于布鲁姆分类学（Bloom's Taxonomy）的自动标注框架，将思维分为六个认知层级（如记忆、应用、评价），并在多个模型和数据集上进行大规模分析。

Result: 揭示了不同模型和任务之间思维方式上的相似性与差异性，并证明从推理轨迹中提取的思维类型信息与推理正确性相关。

Conclusion: 该框架建立了分析LRMs思维模式的细粒度工具，并为提升推理质量提供了可操作的见解，为后续研究奠定了重要基础。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized reasoning in LLMs, and the increasing public availability of reasoning traces creates valuable opportunities to study model behavior not only at the surface level but also at the granularity of individual reasoning steps. However, understanding the types of thinking employed during reasoning - which offers critical insights into models' reasoning patterns and enables actionable applications - remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce a framework for automatic annotation of reasoning steps through the lens of Bloom's Taxonomy, which classifies thinking into six cognitive levels, such as Remembering, Applying and Evaluating. Using this framework, we perform a large-scale analysis across models and datasets, revealing both similarities and differences in thinking patterns across models and tasks. Moreover, we demonstrate that thinking-type information derived from reasoning traces correlates with correctness, paving the way for improved reasoning. Our findings establish a fine-grained framework for analyzing thinking patterns in LRMs and provide actionable insights for enhancing reasoning quality.

</details>


### [504] [What is mathematics now, and what should it be?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23218)
*Jeremy Avigad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点性文章，主张神经定理证明器的进展虽然令人瞩目，但掩盖了AI能为数学做什么以及数学家如何与AI互动这一更广阔的愿景，并提出了一个更具扩展性和乐观主义的视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者认为当前对神经定理证明器的关注过于狭窄，需要重新审视AI在数学领域的更广泛潜力，以及数学家应该如何更积极地参与和利用AI。

Method: 以散文/议论文的形式，通过论证和观点陈述来提出一个超越传统定理证明的、更广阔的AI与数学结合的愿景。

Result: 提出了一个更乐观和扩展的视角，涵盖AI在数学中的更广泛应用以及与数学家互动的更丰富方式。

Conclusion: 主张数学界应以更开放和乐观的态度拥抱AI，超越单纯的定理证明范畴。

Abstract: Advances in neural theorem provers have been impressive, but the successes obscure a broader vision of what AI can do for mathematics and how mathematicians can engage with AI. This essay advances a more expansive and optimistic point of view.

</details>


### [505] [Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23256)
*Yinhao Tang,Youqing Fang,Yanan Sun,Jiangning Liu,Ziyi Wang,Xun Zhao,Weiming Zhang,Bin Liu,Kuikun Liu,Wenwei Zhang,Kai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究了"next-chunk reasoning RL"（一种利用无CoT数据进行隐式推理训练的方法），并提出了一个简单但被忽视的基线方法"Mixed SFT"（混合监督微调），即将无CoT数据与长CoT数据联合进行单阶段监督微调。实验表明，Mixed SFT在RLVR后的性能上限显著高于next-chunk reasoning RL，且计算开销减少超过60倍，在领域内和领域外推理任务上均表现一致。此外，研究还发现pre-RLVR的高准确率并不必然带来post-RLVR的高准确率，强调应在完整后训练流程中评估无CoT训练策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究提出了next-chunk reasoning RL方法来利用无CoT数据，但已有评估主要与常规SFT基线对比，无法区分性能提升究竟来自RL框架本身，还是来自更有效地暴露模型于无CoT数据。作者希望厘清这一混淆因素，并探索更简单有效的方法。

Method: 作者设计了受控实验，对比next-chunk reasoning RL与Mixed SFT（将无CoT数据和长CoT数据混合进行单阶段监督微调）。在此基础上对两种方法进行RLVR（强化学习与验证器推理）后训练，比较各自的性能上限，并分析pre-RLVR与post-RLVR准确率之间的关系。

Result: Mixed SFT在RLVR后的性能上限明显高于next-chunk reasoning RL，同时计算开销降低超过60倍。该优势在领域内数学推理和领域外推理任务上保持一致。此外发现pre-RLVR准确率与post-RLVR准确率并不呈正相关关系。

Conclusion: 简单的Mixed SFT方法能够更有效地利用无CoT数据，并且优于复杂的next-chunk reasoning RL方法。研究结果强调了在完整的后训练管线（包括RLVR）背景下评估无CoT训练策略的重要性，避免仅以预RLVR阶段的表现作为判断依据。

Abstract: Recent work proposes next-chunk reasoning RL for leveraging no-CoT data---corpora such as worked solutions and textbook derivations that contain reasoning-rich content but lack explicit chain-of-thought annotations. The method trains a model to generate implicit reasoning traces and rewards them by their ability to predict the next chunk of text. While promising, existing evaluations primarily compare against conventional SFT baselines, leaving open whether the gains come from the RL formulation itself or from more effectively exposing the model to no-CoT data. We address this question with a controlled study of next-chunk reasoning RL and a simple but previously overlooked alternative: Mixed SFT, a single supervised fine-tuning stage that jointly trains on no-CoT and long-CoT data. Despite its simplicity, Mixed SFT achieves a clearly higher post-RLVR performance ceiling than next-chunk reasoning RL while requiring over 60 times less training compute. The advantage is consistent across in-domain mathematical reasoning and out-of-domain reasoning tasks. Moreover, we show that higher pre-RLVR accuracy does not necessarily translate into higher post-RLVR accuracy, highlighting the need to evaluate no-CoT training strategies in the context of the full post-training pipeline.

</details>


### [506] [Automated Construction of FAIR Digital Object Knowledge Graphs from Flat Cultural Heritage Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23263)
*Zeyd Boukhers,Lingxiao Kong,Xenophon Zabulis,Georgios Toubekis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个将扁平化的Europeana记录转换为符合FAIR Digital Object (FDO)规范的CIDOC-CRM知识图谱的流水线。核心创新在于使用大语言模型自动分类每个元数据值，区分应成为PID引用（可解析实体）的值和可保留为字面量（终端叶节点）的值，并将其路由到受控词表（Getty AAT、Wikidata、VIAF、PeriodO）。在637条来自五个Europeana提供者的考古记录上，该流水线链接了86%的元数据槽位，解析了Europeana未丰富值中的58.5%，并成功合并了跨语言表面形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Europeana数据模型早于FDO规范设计，将大多数元数据值存储为纯文本，虽然适合人类浏览，但自动化代理无法跨记录或集合进行追踪。FDO框架要求元数据值尽可能表达为持久标识符（PID），以构建完全机器可操作的图。因此需要一种方法将现有Europeana记录转换为FDO合规的知识图谱。

Method: 构建一个流水线，将扁平Europeana记录转换为FDO合规的CIDOC-CRM知识图谱。每个遗产实体建模为独立FDO，包含自己的PID、类型、配置文件和元数据层。核心方法使用大语言模型对每个元数据值进行分类，决定其应成为PID引用（可解析实体）还是保留为字面量（终端叶节点），并路由到相应受控词表（Getty AAT、Wikidata、VIAF、PeriodO），链接到共享实体FDO。

Result: 在637条来自五个Europeana提供者的考古记录上评估：流水线链接了86%的元数据槽位，解决了Europeana未丰富值中的58.5%。合并了字节相同匹配无法处理的跨语言表面形式，33个合并中17个经人工审查正确。与字符串匹配相比，图连通性并无显著差异，但FDO图的独特之处在于每个节点都被类型化且可解析。

Conclusion: 该流水线成功地将传统Europeana记录转换为FDO合规的知识图谱，使元数据值从纯文本升级为可解析的PID引用。虽然图连通性与简单字符串匹配相当，但FDO图的价值在于所有节点均被类型化且可解析，为自动化代理提供了完整的机器可操作性。LLM在区分字面量与实体引用方面表现有效。

Abstract: The FAIR Digital Object (FDO) framework mandates that metadata attribute values be expressed as persistent identifiers (PIDs) wherever possible, to produce a fully machine-actionable graph in which every reference is resolvable. The Europeana Data Model was designed long before the FDO specification, and it stores most metadata values as plain text. This serves human browsing well enough, but gives an automated agent nothing to follow across records or collections. We present a pipeline that transforms flat Europeana records into an FDO-compliant knowledge graph structured with CIDOC-CRM. Following the FDO specification, we model every heritage entity as a discrete FDO with its own PID, type, profile, and metadata layer. The core technical challenge is automating the FDO-prescribed distinction between values that must become PID references (resolvable entities) and those that may remain literals (terminal leaves such as notes, measurements, and dates). We address this with a large language model that classifies each metadata value, routes it to a controlled vocabulary (Getty AAT, Wikidata, VIAF, PeriodO), and links it to a shared entity FDO. We evaluate using 637 archaeological records from five Europeana providers, processing each with the LLM. The pipeline links 86% of metadata slots, resolving 58.5% of values Europeana had not already enriched. It also merges cross-lingual surface forms that byte-identical matching keeps apart, where 17 of 33 such merges are correct on manual review. Graph connectivity does not separate this from string matching; what distinguishes the FDO graph is that every node is typed and resolvable.

</details>


### [507] [Hidden in the Request: Explaining Unethical LLM Compliance through Token Relevance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23264)
*Or Biton,Tomer Krichli,Itai Allouche,Joseph Keshet*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM在对齐过程中由于"有用性"与"无害性"目标冲突导致的伦理失败问题，通过三种结构模态（客观分类、主观第一人称陈述、直接请求协助）探测LLM的不道德行为表现，发现模型在"请求协助"形式下表现最差。利用层相关性传播（LRP）追踪到归因偏差：模型过度关注良性的任务框架词（如"你能帮我..."），而忽略指示不道德行为的关键词（cue-tokens，如"不被抓住"）。作者提出两种LRP引导的解码方法，引导生成朝向与cue-tokens更相关的轨迹，实证表明这些干预能促进更安全的响应，验证了cue-token归因在合规失败中的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被对齐以同时优化有用性和无害性，但这两个目标可能冲突，导致对齐失败。现有工作缺乏对LLM伦理失败背后机制的系统理解，需要深入探究模型为何会在某些情境下表现出不道德行为。

Method: 1）提出一种探测方法，将不道德场景以三种结构模态呈现（客观分类任务、主观第一人称陈述、直接请求协助）；2）使用层相关性传播（LRP）追踪模型内部归因机制，识别归因偏差；3）提出两种LRP引导的解码方法，引导生成朝向与cue-tokens更相关的方向。

Result: 模型在"请求协助"形态下伦理表现显著下降；LRP分析发现模型对任务框架词（如"Can you help me..."）的关注度高于对不道德行为信号词（cue-tokens）的关注；两种LRP引导解码方法能有效促进更安全的响应生成。

Conclusion: LLM的伦理失败部分源于对cue-tokens的归因不足，即模型更关注表面的任务框架而忽略了语义中隐含的不道德信号。LRP引导的解码干预能够修正这一偏差，从而提升模型的安全性，为理解和对齐LLM伦理行为提供了新的机制性视角和实用方法。

Abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to optimize for both helpfulness and harmlessness, these dual objectives may conflict, inevitably leading to alignment failures. This work systematically investigates instances where LLMs fail to exhibit ethical behavior. To understand the underlying mechanics of these vulnerabilities, we introduce a probing methodology that presents unethical scenarios to LLMs in three distinct structural modalities: objective classification tasks, subjective first-person statements, and direct requests for assistance. We find that model performance degrades in the request-for-assistance-based form. Using Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP), we trace this discrepancy to an attribution bias: the model places greater emphasis on benign task-framing tokens (e.g., "Can you help me...") than on tokens signaling the underlying unethical behavior (e.g., "without getting caught"), which we term cue-tokens. We hypothesize that this under-attribution contributes to harmful compliance. To test this, we introduce two LRP-guided decoding methods that steer generation toward trajectories more relevant to cue tokens. Empirical evaluations show that these interventions promote safer responses, supporting cue-token attribution's role in compliance failures.

</details>


### [508] [Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23283)
*Apodex Team,B. An,B. Li,B. Wang,B. Zhang,B. L. Wang,C. Feng,C. Wei,C. Xue,C. Zhang,D. Ng,D. Ye,E. Min,F. Chen,F. Liu,F. Yang,F. Ye,H. Xu,H. Yang,H. Ye,H. Zhang,H. Zhao,J. Li,J. Lin,J. Xia,K. Jin,K. Wang,K. Yang,L. Bing,L. Lei,L. Su,Le. Wang,Lu. Wang,N. Wang,Q. Ren,Q. Yang,R. Li,S. Bai,S. Du,S. Li,S. Lin,S. Nie,S. Wang,S. Zhang,S. Z. Wang,Ta. Q. Fang,Ti. Q. Fang,W. Fang,W. Li,W. Zhang,X. Chen,X. Li,X. Tang,X. Wang,X. Xu,X. Zhang,X. Q. Wang,X. Y. Wang,Y. Deng,Y. Gao,Y. Hu,Y. Li,Y. Sui,Y. Wang,Y. Xiao,Y. Zhang,Z. Chen,Z. Cheng,Z. Feng,Z. Liang,Z. Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Apodex 1.1是一个专注于"工作能力"（working capability）的通用语言模型，通过环境扩展和智能体协调扩展两个维度，实现与文件、信息源和可执行代码的持续交互，支持长时程任务分解、并行委托、异步结果整合和重规划。该模型在复杂专业工作、金融、科研、数学、编码和搜索等多个领域达到领先性能，其35B参数的Mini版本也保持了强大的本地可部署工作能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用语言模型虽然能推理和综合知识，但复杂工作还需要与文件、信息源和可执行代码的持续交互，以及状态维护、故障恢复和可验证交付。现有模型缺乏这种"工作能力"——即对现实世界目标持续、可验证的进展能力。

Method: 通过两个互补维度发展工作能力：(1) 环境扩展（Environment Scaling）：扩展可执行文件、搜索和代码环境的多样性和可验证性；(2) 智能体协调扩展（Agentic Coordination Scaling）：训练智能体分解长时程任务、委托并行工作、整合异步结果并重新规划。共享执行框架AgentOS维护跨工具和智能体的任务状态与来源，训练将环境轨迹和协调痕迹转化为可靠行为。

Result: 在复杂专业工作、金融、科学研究、数学、编码和搜索等领域达到领先性能等级，尽管使用的模型规模远小于许多前沿系统。35B参数的Apodex 1.1 Mini在本地可部署形式下保留了强大的工作能力。

Conclusion: 这些结果将智能体智能扎根于随时间完成的有用、可验证的工作，推进了构建面向雄心勃勃长时程任务的"重型求解器"（Heavy-Duty Solver）的目标。

Abstract: General-purpose language models can reason and synthesize knowledge, but complex work also requires sustained interaction with files, information sources, and executable code, together with state maintenance, failure recovery, and verifiable delivery. We call this \emph{working capability}: sustained, verifiable progress toward a real-world objective. Apodex 1.1 develops this capability along two complementary dimensions. \emph{Environment Scaling} expands the diversity and verifiability of executable file, search, and code environments, while \emph{Agentic Coordination Scaling} trains agents to decompose long-horizon tasks, delegate parallel work, integrate asynchronous results, and replan. A shared execution harness and AgentOS maintain task state and provenance across tools and agents, and training turns environment trajectories and coordination traces into reliable behavior. Across complex professional work, finance, scientific research, mathematics, coding, and search, Apodex 1.1 reaches the leading performance band despite using a substantially smaller model than many frontier systems. The 35B-parameter Apodex 1.1 Mini further retains strong working capability in a locally deployable form. These results ground agentic intelligence in useful, verifiable work completed over time and advance our goal of building a \emph{Heavy-Duty Solver} for ambitious, long-running tasks.

</details>


### [509] [EviSafe: Evidence-Grounded Safety Evaluation for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23313)
*Xuetong Li,Gaofeng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EviSafe框架，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）安全性的证据基础，超越仅看最终响应是否拒绝的浅层评估。通过EviSafeBench基准（1,181个黄金图文场景、2,452个反事实变体），对11个VLM进行三种探测协议评估，发现模型在自然严重性准确率（27.6%-52.8%）、诊断一致性（6.1%-29.3%）和反事实转换成功率（30.4%-58.4%）上均表现不佳，表明现有VLM并非基于正确的多模态推理来保证安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM安全基准仅评估最终响应（拒绝、警告或遵从），无法判断模型是否因正确的多模态理由而安全。表面上看安全的行为可能源于关键词触发的拒绝、遗漏视觉危险或对良性敏感输入的过度拒绝，缺乏对模型安全推理证据基础的深入评估。

Method: 提出EviSafe框架，联合评估三个维度：自然的用户面向行为、对文本和视觉证据的显式锚定、以及对安全关键证据反事实变化的行为敏感性。EviSafeBench包含1,181个黄金图文场景和2,452个反事实变体，覆盖8个安全域和8种风险源类型。采用三探测协议（自然响应、证据报告、反事实响应提示），并使用证据感知评判器进行评分。

Result: 对11个VLM的评估显示：自然严重性准确率范围为27.6%-52.8%，宽松诊断一致性为6.1%-29.3%，不安全到安全反事实转换成功率为30.4%-58.4%。各指标均显示模型安全性能存在显著差距。

Conclusion: 评估的VLM并未可靠地基于正确的多模态理由保证安全。现有安全评估应超越简单的拒绝计数，需要更细粒度的证据引导评估框架来衡量模型安全推理的质量。

Abstract: Vision-language model safety benchmarks typically evaluate only final responses: whether a model refuses, warns, or complies. This outcome-level view cannot tell whether a model is safe for the right multimodal reason. Safelooking behavior may reflect keyword-triggered refusal, missed visual hazards, or over-refusal of benign-sensitive inputs. We introduce EviSafe, an evidence-grounded framework for VLM safety that jointly evaluates natural user-facing behavior, explicit grounding in textual and visual evidence, and behavioral sensitivity to counterfactual changes in safety-critical evidence. EviSafeBench instantiates the framework as a controlled benchmark with 1,181 gold image-text scenarios and 2,452 targeted counterfactual variants across eight safety domains and eight risk-source types. Each scenario includes a gold safety decision, evidence annotations, a safe-response policy, and counterfactual interventions. The three-probe protocol queries models with natural-response, evidencereporting, and counterfactual-response prompts, then scores them using an evidence-aware judge. Across eleven evaluated VLMs, natural severity accuracy ranges from 27.6% to 52.8%, relaxed diagnostic consistency from 6.1% to 29.3%, and unsafe-to-safe counterfactual transition success from 30.4% to 58.4%. These gaps show that the evaluated VLMs are not reliably safe for the right multimodal reason and motivate evaluation beyond refusal counts.

</details>


### [510] [Agent-G$^2$: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23318)
*Zixuan Wang,Yanrui Miao,Zhengxi Lu,Teng Pan,Yiwen Qiu,Hongxing Li,Peng Qiu,Ruiqing Zhang,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Agent-G²框架，将提示深度建模为高斯分布而非确定性标量，在线估计均值和方差，零额外探测成本下在ALFWorld和WebShop上超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示深度方法要么对所有样本共享一个固定值，忽略任务异质性；要么对每个样本单独探测，代价高昂。作者发现有用指导深度实际占据一个带状区域，其信息量轮廓呈高斯分布而非集中于单点。

Method: 将每个任务的提示深度从高斯分布中采样，其中心结合全局基线与每簇难度，方差跟踪簇内方差。中心与方差均在线从策略优化已收集的rollout中估计，无需额外探测rollout或学习深度预测器。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上基于Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct评估，Agent-G²在ALFWorld上分别超越最强hint-based、hint-free和Aux-RL基线2.3/3.9/7.4个点，且rollout成本不足per-sample probing的三分之一。

Conclusion: 提示深度不应视为确定性标量，而应建模为随任务自适应的分布，Gaussian guidance框架在性能和效率上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Hint-based reinforcement learning addresses reward sparsity in long-horizon agentic tasks by retaining a prefix of an expert trajectory before each rollout, letting the policy explore from a state closer to success. Its effectiveness hinges on the guidance depth: how much of the trajectory to keep. Existing methods treat this depth as a deterministic scalar. Scheduled approaches share one value across samples and ignore per-task heterogeneity; per-sample probing estimates it separately at the cost of extra rollouts. We find that useful guidance occupies a band of depths whose informativeness profile is approximately Gaussian around the band center, rather than concentrating at a single optimal point. We propose Agent-G$^2$, a Gaussian guidance framework that draws the depth per task from a Gaussian whose center and spread are estimated online from rollouts already collected for policy optimization, requiring no probe rollouts or learned depth predictor. The center combines a global baseline with per-cluster difficulty, and the spread tracks within-cluster variance. We evaluate Agent-G$^2$ on ALFWorld and WebShop on Qwen2.5-1.5B / 7B-Instruct. Agent-G$^2$ outperforms the strongest hint-based, hint-free, and Aux-RL baselines on ALFWorld by 2.3 / 3.9 / 7.4 points at under one-third the rollout cost of per-sample probing.

</details>


### [511] [Walking on the DARKSIDE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23370)
*Aldo Gangemi,Emanuele Bottazzi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DARKSIDE，一种基于POLANYI++的连贯性审计方法，通过显式追踪话语中的排除轨迹并用权证轴（Warrant axis）对命名指称进行分类（Warranted/Unattested/Misattributed/Fabricated），配合升级规则将委托风险评估推至UNSAFE，以检测并抵御LLM将复杂无意义输入实体化到知识图谱中的漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型虽能识别模式，但无法原生追踪连贯话语所需的排除路径。当输入建立在虚假权威、误用机制或隐秘类比之上时，未受引导的LLM会将其视为有根据的内容，并将错误实体化到结构化输出中。POLANYI++的XKG生成同样继承了这一脆弱性，自动推理器难以检测这些被共同生成且包含错误假设的知识图谱。

Method: DARKSIDE在POLANYI++之上构建，将排除轨迹形式化为显式的随时间累积的数据结构，并辅以权证轴对每个命名指称分类为Warranted、Unattested、Misattributed或Fabricated，通过升级规则在捏造率为正或未支持率超阈值时将DelegationRiskAssessment推至UNSAFE。

Result: 在BSBench（涵盖软件工程、金融、医疗、物理和法律的100项对抗性精致废话语料库）上，以Gemini 3作为被引导层、Claude Sonnet 4.6作为独立评判进行评估，经验证据支持该架构声明：当LLM前向传播被包裹在本体介导的负轨迹装置中时，结构性的模式-路径鸿沟可被部分搭建。XKG作为缺失的记忆，权证轴作为认识论防火墙。

Conclusion: DARKSIDE通过在LLM生成过程中引入显式的排除轨迹和权证分级机制，部分弥合了模式识别与路径追踪之间的结构性差距，为抵御复杂无意义输入的实体化提供了新的防御手段。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) recognise patterns but do not natively track the path of exclusions that a coherent discourse demands. When an input rests on a fabricated authority, a misapplied mechanism, or a surreptitious analogy, an unsteered LLM tends to engage with it as if it were grounded, and to reify the misstep into any structured output it generates. Logic-Augmented Generation (LAG) with POLANYI++, an LLM-steering method that uses heuristics, ontologies and problem solving methods for tacit knowledge extraction, produces an Extended Knowledge Graph (XKG) in OWL2, but inherits the same vulnerability: a sophisticated nonsensical input is reified into the graph alongside the legitimate triples, and is hardly detectable by automated reasoners since the XKG is generated jointly with the wrong assumptions. We introduce DARKSIDE, a coherence auditing method on top of POLANYI++. It formalises the trail as an explicit data structure of accumulated exclusions over discourse time, complemented by a warrant axis that classifies each named referent as Warranted, Unattested, Misattributed or Fabricated, with an escalation rule that pushes the DelegationRiskAssessment to UNSAFE when the fabricated rate is positive or the unsupported rate exceeds a threshold. We evaluate DARKSIDE as a steering layer over a Gemini 3 on BSBench, a 100-item adversarial corpus of sophisticated-sounding nonsense across software engineering, finance, healthcare, physics and law, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 as an independent judge. The empirical evidence supports an architectural claim: when an LLM forward pass is wrapped in an ontology-mediated negative-trail apparatus, the structural pattern-vs-path gap can be partially scaffolded. The XKG functions as the missing memory, and the warrant axis as an epistemic firewall.

</details>


### [512] [Modalities Should Talk to Each Other: Dual-Stream Multimodal Learning for Long-Horizon Influenza Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23373)
*Seyed Mohammad Hossein Hashemi,Mohsen Hooshmand,Parvin Razzaghi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Dual-Stream Attention (DSA)，一种用于流感样病例(ILI)长期预测的多模态深度学习框架。该框架通过双向跨模态注意力机制，将数值流行病学信号与文本新闻标题融合，实现12周前瞻预测，在Time-MMD数据集上显著优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共卫生准备需要长期流感预测，但公开监测数据中数值信号与文本信息存在噪声大、结构松散、与近期趋势间接相关且滞后等问题，简单融合效果不佳，需要精心设计的跨模态融合机制。

Method: DSA框架包含三个核心组件：(1)基于Transformer的数值编码器与领域自适应的标题编码器分别编码两种模态；(2)双向跨模态注意力(CMA)机制让文本与数值信号互相条件化；(3)因果时序模型负责最终预测。整体利用36周多模态历史预测12周后的ILI活动。

Result: 在10个随机种子下，DSA的中位测试MSE为0.416，相比iTransformer、TaTS和GPT4MTS分别降低54.95%、37.29%和67.23%的均方误差；在100%的bootstrap抽样中排名第一；最差窗口误差显著更低；外部地理数据集上在9个基线中排名第一；消融实验证实双向注意力优于单向，且不依赖特定文本编码器。

Conclusion: DSA证明了数值-文本双向条件化对于长期ILI预测的有效性，其优势稳健且具有跨地理泛化能力。扰动分析显示学到的跨模态注意力在文本→数值方向上具有更强的功能信息。

Abstract: Forecasting long-range influenza-like illness (ILI) matters for public health readiness. Publicly available surveillance datasets typically pair numeric epidemiological signals with textual information that is noisy, loosely structured, only indirectly related to near-term trends, and often lagged relative to the numeric signal. Fusing the two therefore requires careful design. We propose Dual-Stream Attention (DSA), a multimodal deep learning framework that forecasts 12-week-ahead ILI activity from a 36-week multimodal history by letting the numerical and textual streams condition each other. Using the Time-MMD health-domain dataset, DSA separately encodes the two modalities with a Transformer-based numerical encoder and a domain-adapted headline encoder, then couples them through a bidirectional Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) mechanism: the text (news headlines) conditions the interpretation of the numeric signal and vice versa. The CMA output then passes to a causal temporal model for forecasting. Evaluated across ten random seeds, DSA achieves a median test MSE of 0.416, versus 0.668, 0.607, and 0.851 for iTransformer, TaTS, and GPT4MTS, corresponding to mean-error reductions of 54.95%, 37.29%, and 67.23%, with paired Cohen's d of 0.555, 0.337, and 0.345, respectively, and ranks first in 100% of bootstrap draws. It also has substantially lower worst-window error than all baselines. On an external-geography dataset, DSA again ranks first among nine evaluated baselines. Ablations show the advantage does not depend on text-encoder choice or language-model fine-tuning, and that bidirectional attention outperforms either direction alone. Finally, perturbation-based faithfulness analysis shows the learned CMA is functionally informative under targeted masking, with a stronger effect in the text-to-numerical direction.

</details>


### [513] [MediSkill-Evo: Process-Constrained Self-Evolution for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23397)
*Ruoyu Wu,Shenfu Xie,Yinqian Sun,Haibo Tong,Feifei Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MediSkill-Evo是一个无需微调骨干网络的临床智能体，通过四类经验库（临床技能、过程规则、符号模式、测量程序）和过程约束偏好框架来进化管理知识，在多个压力维度下显著提升诊断准确率和治疗意向覆盖率，同时减少关键失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式临床智能体必须在部分可观测条件下收集决定性证据并将其转化为有依据的行动。然而仅靠正确的最终诊断无法证明智能体遵守了证据采集和护理过程约束，需要引入过程级治理机制。

Method: MediSkill-Evo将经验分为四个类型化的存储库（临床技能、过程规则、符号模式、测量程序），通过来源追溯、支持度、回放和控制器定义的安全检查来管控发布到冻结测试时快照。提出过程约束偏好框架，将证据绑定到其来源，拒绝控制器无效候选，并使用安全优先的临床过程评论器对行动排序。

Result: 在300个Qwen场景中，诊断准确率从61.33%提升到69.00%，治疗意向覆盖率从33.62%提升到66.44%，关键失败从31.00%降至16.33%。在180个硬隔离条件下，目标恢复率达93.61%（患者行为压力）、100.00%（时间证据）、92.22%（分诊红旗）。

Conclusion: MediSkill-Evo在固定评估套件上提供了完整的端到端系统描述性证据，但作者明确指出这并非针对单个经验库的因果证据，也不构成对自动评判器的临床验证。

Abstract: Interactive clinical agents must gather decisive evidence and convert it into grounded actions under partial observability. A correct final diagnosis alone does not show that an agent respected evidence and care-process constraints. We introduce MediSkill-Evo, a clinical agent that evolves governed process knowledge without backbone fine-tuning. It separates experience into four typed banks for clinical skills, process rules, symbolic schemas, and measurement procedures. Provenance, support, replay, and controller-defined safety checks govern publication to a frozen test-time snapshot. A Process-Constrained Preference Harness binds evidence to its source, rejects controller-invalid candidates, and ranks actions with a safety-prioritized Clinical Process Critic. We evaluate complete agent systems across two backbone endpoints and six controlled stress dimensions under the same Doctor-turn limit. On 300 held-out Qwen encounters, MediSkill-Evo improves diagnosis accuracy from 61.33 percent to 69.00 percent and treatment-intent coverage from 33.62 percent to 66.44 percent, while reducing automatically scored critical failures from 31.00 percent to 16.33 percent relative to AgentClinic. On 180 hard-isolation conditions derived from 30 cases, target recovery reaches 93.61 percent under patient-behavior pressure, 100.00 percent for temporal evidence, and 92.22 percent for triage red flags. An exploratory 100-case MedSAM comparison evaluates request-gated tool-interface feasibility. These results provide descriptive end-to-end evidence for the complete system on fixed evaluation suites, not causal evidence for an individual bank or clinical validation of the automatic judge.

</details>


### [514] [SkillAlchemy: Open-World Agent Skill Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23417)
*Hengjun Wang,Shuyue Wei,Boyi Liu,Jun Yang,Yongxin Tong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillAlchemy框架，研究开放世界技能创建问题：给定不完整的技能简要说明和源访问规范，从开放世界材料中自动创建可靠的智能体技能。实验表明该方法在87个任务上比无技能执行提升19.9个百分点，比最强自动化基线提升8.6个百分点，性能接近人工策划技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的技能创建方法依赖人类编写、模型先验或执行轨迹，但这些来源对于不熟悉的任务往往不可用，因此需要探索如何从开放世界材料中创建技能。核心挑战是技能简要说明往往不完整，需要发现行为相关的隐含需求，并判断每个源推导过程的适用广度。

Method: SkillAlchemy是一个以准入（admission）为中心的框架，包含三个关键步骤：1) 通过对比证据识别隐含需求；2) 基于证据支持的适用范围准入候选过程；3) 将准入内容编译成语法引导的技能包。该框架解决了技能创建中的需求发现和过程合理性判断两大核心问题。

Result: 在SkillsBench v1.1的87个任务上进行广泛实验，SkillAlchemy相比无技能执行提升19.9个百分点的通过率，相比最强自动化基线提升8.6个百分点，性能与人工策划的技能相当。

Conclusion: SkillAlchemy验证了从开放世界材料中自动创建高质量技能的可行性，为语言智能体技能自动化构建提供了一种有效的替代路径，在缺乏人类作者、模型先验或执行轨迹的场景下也能生成可靠的技能。

Abstract: Agent skills are reusable procedural artifacts that extend language agents with specialized workflows, tool conventions, and domain behaviors at inference time. However, creating reliable skills still depends largely on human authorship, model priors, or execution traces. These sources are often unavailable for unfamiliar tasks, suggesting the need to create skills from open-world materials. In this paper, we study open-world skill creation: given an underspecified skill brief and a source-access specification, a creator must discover behavior-relevant requirements omitted by the brief and determine how broadly each source-derived procedure is justified. We propose SkillAlchemy, an admission-centered framework for source-grounded skill creation. SkillAlchemy identifies implicit requirements through contrastive evidence, admits candidate procedures based on evidence-supported scope, and compiles the admitted content into a grammar-guided skill package. Extensive experiments across 87 SkillsBench v1.1 tasks demonstrate that SkillAlchemy improves pass rate over no-skill execution by 19.9 percentage points and the strongest automated baseline by 8.6 percentage points, while achieving performance comparable to human-curated skills.

</details>


### [515] [Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23446)
*Contet Clément,Umberto Grandi,Jérôme Mengin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究如何从形式上解释为何某候选人在锦标赛规则下未被选中，即识别出候选人在任何补全方式下都会失败的最小子锦标赛（破坏性最小支持集）。针对六种常见锦标赛解决方案（maximin、未覆盖集及其加权变体、top-cycle、Copeland和Borda），提供了必要失败者和可能获胜者的特征刻画，确定了最小破坏性支持集的大小，并给出了多项式时间算法（Borda规则除外，其被怀疑为NP完全问题）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在锦标赛选举场景中，理解"为什么某候选人会输"对于公正性和透明度至关重要。作者希望利用形式化可解释人工智能（XAI）中的溯因解释框架，为锦标赛规则提供可验证的失败原因解释。

Method: 将"候选人失败"问题形式化为识别最小子锦标赛（破坏性最小支持集），使得无论其余锦标赛如何补全，该候选人都无法获胜。利用溯因解释的概念，对六种锦标赛解决方案分别建立必要失败者与可能获胜者的判定条件，并分析最小支持集的计算复杂度。

Result: 为六种锦标赛解决方案提供了必要失败者/可能获胜者的完整特征刻画，确定了最小破坏性支持集的大小界限。除Borda规则（怀疑NP完全）外，其余规则均可通过多项式时间算法计算最小破坏性支持集。

Conclusion: 该工作为锦标赛规则提供了形式化的失败解释框架，在计算复杂度上证明了大多数规则的高效性，同时对Borda规则的困难性给出了理论预期，为后续研究指明了方向。

Abstract: We study the problem of formally explaining why a candidate was not selected by a given tournament rule, by identifying sub-tournaments in which the candidate loses independently of how the rest of the tournament is completed. We define destructive minimal supports as any minimal sub-tournaments satisfying this property, which in formal explainable artificial intelligence correspond to abductive explanations for the question "Why does the loser lose the tournament?". For six common tournament solutions (maximin, uncovered set and its weighted variant, top-cycle, Copeland, and Borda) we provide characterizations of when a candidate is either a necessary loser or a possible winner, we determine the size of the smallest destructive minimal supports, complemented by polynomial-time algorithms for their computation except for the case of the Borda rule which is suspected to be NP-complete.

</details>


### [516] [StrategyBench: Evaluating Explicit Strategy Induction in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23475)
*Jinghan Tan,Yuanzheng Wang,Lu Chen,Zijun Chen,Yuqian Wang,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 StrategyBench 基准，用于评估 LLM 在少样本情境下从示例中归纳任务策略（显式规则）的能力。通过从 BIG-Bench 选取策略可归纳任务、构建参考策略，并从策略质量与下游效用两个维度进行评测，分析任务类别、模型配置与适应设置对策略归纳的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接少样本 ICL 对示例构造敏感，缺乏对任务规则的显式抽象；而人类学习者倾向于先从示例中总结任务规则再应用于新实例。为评估 LLM 是否具备这种"策略归纳"能力，作者提出相应基准。

Method: 1) 从 BIG-Bench 中筛选出策略可归纳的任务；2) 构建参考策略；3) 设计评估指标，沿策略质量与下游效用两个维度度量；4) 从任务变化、模型配置、适应设置三方面分析（类别差异、生成器-执行器选择、示例设计、SFT 适应）。

Result: 实验表明：显式策略的效用在不同任务类别间差异显著，且同时取决于策略生成条件与执行条件。

Conclusion: 策略归纳能力是评估和增强 LLM 任务适应性的重要维度，StrategyBench 提供了一套系统化的评测框架，揭示出当前模型在显式策略利用上的能力边界与影响因素。

Abstract: As large language models are increasingly used in data-scarce and evolving task scenarios, few-shot in-context learning (ICL) has become a key paradigm for task adaptation. However, direct ICL often uses a small set of examples without explicitly abstracting task rules, making it sensitive to example construction. In contrast, human learners often reduce such sensitivity by first summarizing task rules from examples and then applying them to new instances. To evaluate this ability, we propose StrategyBench, which selects strategy-inducible tasks from BIG-Bench, constructs reference strategies, and defines evaluation metrics along two dimensions: strategy quality and downstream utility. We further analyze strategy induction from three perspectives: task variation, model configuration, and adaptation setting, covering category-wise differences, generator-executor choices, demonstration design, and SFT-based adaptation. Experiments show that explicit strategy utility differs substantially across task categories and depends on both strategy generation and execution conditions. The benchmark is released at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StrategyBench-D53C.

</details>


### [517] [Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23484)
*Naman Garg,Sarika Jain,George Fazekas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了团队在ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData挑战赛中的解决方案，构建了一个多模态个性化对话式音乐推荐系统。系统采用三阶段流水线：多模态检索（七种稠密嵌入空间的加权质心+BM25+艺术家子串匹配，通过加权RRF融合）、轻量级重排序、以及基于GPT-4o-mini的个性化回复生成。在500会话开发集上通过差分进化优化RRF权重，MRR提升19.5%；提交系统在Blind B上达到0.3213的复合分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式音乐推荐需要同时处理多模态信息（文本、音频、视觉）和个性化需求，现有方法难以有效融合这些异构信号并在对话场景中提供精准推荐。作者旨在通过多模态检索融合和个性化生成，解决对话式音乐推荐中的跨模态匹配和用户偏好建模难题。

Method: 三阶段流水线：(1) 多模态检索阶段，在七种稠密嵌入空间（track/user级CF-BPR、Qwen3元数据/歌词/属性、CLAP音频、SigLIP视觉）构建衰减加权质心，辅以BM25词法检索和艺术家子串匹配，通过优化权重的加权RRF融合；(2) 轻量级重排序（历史过滤、流行度平滑、目录多样性惩罚）；(3) 基于GPT-4o-mini的个性化回复生成。此外探索了LLM引导艺术家注入、专辑延续信号、XGBoost LambdaMART和GPT-4.1提示词等未部署组件。

Result: 差分进化优化RRF权重在500会话开发集上提升MRR 19.5%。Blind A观察显示：无约束LLM注入导致nDCG灾难性回归-18.9%，而保守注入（仅9个会话）取得最佳Blind A nDCG。提交系统在Blind B上获得0.3213复合分数。

Conclusion: 多模态检索融合结合轻量级重排序和LLM生成是对话式音乐推荐的有效方案。RRF权重优化带来显著提升，但LLM引导注入需谨慎控制，无约束注入会造成性能灾难性退化。未来的工作应进一步验证保守LLM注入策略的有效性，并探索如何在不增加过多成本的前提下部署更优的提示词配置。

Abstract: We present Team Semiintelligencn's solution for the ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge, addressing conversational music recommendation through a multi-modal and personalized conversational recommender system. Our submitted system employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) multi-modal retrieval constructing decay-weighted centroids across seven dense embedding spaces - track- and user-level CF-BPR, Qwen3 (metadata, lyrics, attributes), CLAP audio, and SigLIP visual - supplemented by BM25 lexical retrieval and an artist substring-match signal, all fused via weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with optimized signal weights; (2) lightweight reranking (history filtering, popularity smoothing, and catalog diversity penalization); and (3) persona-diversified response generation using GPT-4o-mini. Beyond this submitted configuration, we report development-time experiments with additional components - constrained LLM-guided artist injection, album continuation signals, XGBoost LambdaMART, and a superior GPT-4.1 response prompt - that were not deployed to Blind B due to cost and complexity constraints. We optimize RRF weights on a 500-session development split via differential evolution, improving MRR by +19.5%. On Blind A, we observe that unconstrained LLM-guided injection across 54 sessions causes catastrophic nDCG regression (-18.9%), while conservative injection on only 9 sessions yields the best observed Blind A nDCG - a finding we present as a Blind A observation warranting further validation. The submitted system achieves a Blind B composite score of 0.3213.

</details>


### [518] [SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23493)
*Jialong Liu,Yuling Shi,Ning Yang,Xiaodong Gu,Zuchao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SRPO框架，让LLM自我反思自己的完整轨迹，将稀疏的终端反馈转化为密集的token级训练信号，无需外部批评者或奖励模型，在数学推理和智能体任务上实现SOTA性能，且数据效率极高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我反思是人类学习中强大的信用分配机制，能将稀疏的结果反馈转化为可操作的指导，但这一能力在LLM训练后的潜力尚未被充分探索。

Method: SRPO使LLM分析自身完成的轨迹，将错误综合为简洁的"反思补丁"，并利用反思条件下的教师评分对学生策略采样（on-policy rollouts）提供密集的token级训练信号，从而将稀疏的终端监督转化为密集的学习信号，无需外部批评者、独立奖励模型或更大的教师模型。

Result: 在数学推理和长时程智能体基准上达到SOTA性能。基于Qwen3-8B，AIME'24达到73.3%，仅用0.08x的SFT训练FLOPs；WebShop成功率达64.7%，ALFWorld达76.8%，SWE-Bench-Lite达31.2%。

Conclusion: SRPO证明了自我反思机制可以内部化到LLM训练中，实现高数据效率和强性能，为无需外部模型的强化学习训练提供了新范式。

Abstract: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% (0.08x) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available at https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO

</details>


### [519] [Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23497)
*Yipeng Zhao,Qishun Yang,Shenzhe Zhu,Shu Yang,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了推理诱导的错位（RIM）问题，即在不含有害内容的推理数据（如数学、代码、思维链）上微调会导致LLM产生有害行为。作者通过表征空间分析发现推理能力与安全行为两个激活方向存在耦合，并据此提出安全方向惩罚（SDP）方法，在微调时惩罚沿安全方向的移动，从而在保持推理性能的同时恢复安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已有研究指出RIM现象的存在，但此前工作将其归因于神经元层面的纠缠，却未揭示表征空间的几何结构，也未提出训练时的修复方案。RIM对LLM推理安全性构成严重挑战，亟需从表征空间角度深入理解并设计有效的训练时防御策略。

Method: 1) 从激活空间中提取两个方向：一个编码推理能力，一个编码安全行为，并发现两者存在耦合——提升推理的微调会改变安全表征。2) 利用CKA距离比率和探针定位安全决策层。3) 基于这些发现设计安全方向惩罚（SDP）：在推理微调期间惩罚沿安全方向的位移，初始范围设定在安全决策层，若超出惩罚层出现补偿性位移，则通过诊断迭代扩展范围。在Qwen2.5-3B和7B上进行验证。

Result: 跨架构、跨规模、跨数据集的检查表明RIM并非总是出现。在Qwen2.5-3B和7B上，SDP方法能在恢复安全性的同时保持基准推理性能。

Conclusion: 该工作首次从表征空间几何角度阐释了RIM的机制（推理与安全方向的耦合），并提供了有效的训练时修复方法SDP，为LLM推理安全性提供了可操作的理论基础与实用方案。

Abstract: Reasoning-Induced Misalignment, where fine-tuning on reasoning data containing no harmful content, including mathematics, code, and problem-solving with chain-of-thought traces can induce harmful behaviors of LLM, posing a serious challenge to the safety of LLM reasoning. Cross-architecture, cross-scale, and cross-dataset checks show that RIM does not always emerge. Previous work attributed RIM to neuron-level entanglement, but did not identify the geometry of the representation space underlying this entanglement or propose a training-time fix. We provide both: a representation-space analysis of RIM and the Safety-Direction Penalty (SDP), which penalizes movement along a learned safety direction during reasoning fine-tuning. The analysis extracts two activation-space directions, one encoding reasoning ability and the other safety behavior. These directions are coupled: fine-tuning that improves reasoning shifts safety representations, and prompts with larger shifts show larger safety degradation. CKA distance ratios and probes locate the safety-decision layers where this shift is most relevant. These findings guide the design of SDP: the coupling motivates penalizing displacement along the safety direction, and the layer localization sets the initial scope. When the initial scope leaves compensatory shifts beyond the penalized layers, the same diagnostics guide iterative expansion. On Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, SDP restores safety while preserving benchmark reasoning performance.

</details>


### [520] [EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23525)
*Zhiqing Cui,Xinxiang Yin,Yihong Tang,Xinglang Zhang,Yuanzhe Hu,Siru Zhong,Weidong Tang,Yuxuan Liang,Weijia Li,Ming Jin,Shirui Pan,Yuhao Kang,Dingyi Zhuang,Jinhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了EarthVerse，一个用于评估科学智能体在动态地球系统分析中端到端可靠性的基准测试。它包含405个可复现任务，基于199个记录事件和19类灾害，通过细粒度答案单元和评分标准评估智能体的证据选择、计算透明性和溯源能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球系统分析依赖于来源、尺度、时间和模态各异的观测数据，而自然危害场景下证据不完整会严重影响严重性、暴露度和机制的估计。现有智能体缺乏衡量其完成科学分析全链路（从证据收集到物理解释）可靠性的统一基准。

Method: 构建EarthVerse基准：1）整理199个文档化事件和19类灾害家族；2）设计405个可复现任务，采用包级（package-scoped）调查模式；3）提供可执行的ground truth，将每个任务分解为细粒度答案单元及任务专用评分标准；4）在受控工具使用协议下评估25个模型和智能体系统，并通过受控研究定位失败原因。

Result: 最佳系统平均答案单元准确率为84.65%，但最高Strict@95仅有34.81%。两者差距表明当前智能体往往能完成单步任务，却无法在证据、尺度、单位、计算和物理解释之间维持一致的科学推理链。

Conclusion: EarthVerse为动态地球系统中的端到端科学可靠性提供了可复现的度量基础，揭示了现有智能体在科学执行一致性方面的系统性缺陷，为后续改进智能体的证据访问、工具选择、记忆、推理和交互能力提供了评测支撑。

Abstract: Earth-system analysis reconstructs changing physical processes from observations that differ in source, scale, timing, and modality. Natural hazards make this work consequential because incomplete evidence can change estimates of severity, exposure, and mechanism. We introduce EarthVerse, a benchmark that evaluates scientific agents through package-scoped investigations. Its 405 reproducible tasks are grounded in 199 documented events and 19 hazard families. Agents inspect heterogeneous event packages, choose compatible evidence, execute transparent calculations, reconcile source differences, and preserve provenance in the final answer. We provide executable ground truth that decomposes each task into fine-grained answer units, together with task-specific rubrics that assess the supporting research process while allowing multiple valid paths. We evaluate 25 model and agent systems under a controlled tool-using protocol, then use controlled studies to locate failures in evidence access, tool selection, memory, reasoning, interaction, and scientific execution. Across systems, the best mean answer-unit accuracy is 84.65%, while the highest Strict@95 is only 34.81%. The gap shows that current agents often complete individual steps without maintaining a consistent chain across evidence, scales, units, calculations, and physical interpretation. EarthVerse provides a reproducible basis for measuring end-to-end scientific reliability in dynamic Earth systems.

</details>


### [521] [Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23526)
*Richard Bao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现世界模型（DreamerV3）虽能从视频像素中学习到近似守恒的物理不变量（如能量），但在自主想象（rollout）过程中会违反这一约束，导致预测漂移。通过将潜在状态投影回初始水平集可降低误差，揭示了世界模型"学到约束却违反约束"的具体失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型虽能预测视频，但其学习到的动力学并不一定被可靠地保留。作者希望检验冻结的世界模型是否学到了真正动力学意义上的物理不变量，还是仅仅学到了可解码的相关量，从而区分真实动力学理解与表面拟合。

Method: 使用冻结的DreamerV3仅在摆锤视频上训练；通过无标签搜索在其潜在转换中找到近似守恒的标量；在独立训练的保守模型与阻尼模型中对比验证；测量自主rollout中该量的漂移；通过将潜在状态投影回初始水平集来修正误差，并与随机约束对照。

Result: 无标签搜索在保守模型中发现了一致的类能量不变量，而阻尼模型中没有；该不变量在自主rollout中发生漂移；将潜在状态投影回初始水平集在三个保守模型中均降低了rollout误差，而随机约束通常增加误差。

Conclusion: 世界模型可以学习到具有物理意义的动态不变量（而非仅可解码的关联量），但会在想象未来时违反这一约束。这揭示了一个具体而深刻的失效模式：模型能"看懂"物理规律却无法在预测中"遵守"它。

Abstract: World models can predict video without learning dynamics that they reliably preserve. We test whether a frozen DreamerV3 trained only on pendulum video learns a scalar that its own latent transition treats as approximately conserved. A label-free search recovers the same energy-like invariant across independently trained conservative models, while the same procedure finds no comparable invariant in matched damped models. During autonomous rollouts, this quantity drifts. Projecting the latent state back toward its initial level set reduces rollout error in all three conservative models, whereas matched random constraints usually increase it. These results distinguish a dynamically meaningful invariant from a merely decodable correlate and reveal a concrete failure mode: a world model can learn a physical constraint from pixels yet violate that constraint when it imagines forward.

</details>


### [522] [How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23543)
*Shang Wu,Catarina G Belem,Shuyuan Fu,Mark Steyvers,Padhraic Smyth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过受控逻辑谜题实验研究AI辅助对长期技能发展的影响。实验让参与者在AI可用前、中、后三个阶段完成任务，通过改变AI请求成本来控制使用频率。研究发现低成本会促使更频繁使用AI，但使用AI的参与者在AI移除后表现更差，且其无辅助表现会被高估。研究者用贝叶斯潜在能力模型区分初始能力、AI后能力和技能变化，发现独立推理努力与潜在能力提升正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助虽能短期提升任务表现，但可能损害长期技能发展。现有研究多关注AI辅助的即时收益，缺乏对技能退化机制的深入理解，尤其是独立推理被替代的负面影响。

Method: 采用受控逻辑谜题实验，分三个阶段（AI前、AI期间、AI后）完成任务。实验操纵AI请求成本（高/低成本条件），并用贝叶斯潜在能力模型分离初始能力、AI后能力及个体技能变化，分析独立推理与技能发展的关系。

Result: 低成本条件下AI使用更频繁；使用AI的参与者在AI移除后表现更差；从AI辅助期间表现预测的后续无辅助表现存在高估；独立解决问题努力越多，潜在能力提升越大。

Conclusion: AI辅助对技能的长期影响取决于它是否替代了独立推理。当AI替代独立推理时，技能发展被削弱；反之则有利于能力增长。这提示我们在设计AI辅助系统时应鼓励学习者的主动思考而非简单依赖。

Abstract: While AI assistance can improve human task performance in the short term, it may also undermine the development of skills in the longer term. We examine this tension in a controlled logic-puzzle experiment involving on-demand AI assistance, where participants complete tasks before, during, and after AI is available. By experimentally varying AI request costs, we find that lower-cost assistance induces more frequent AI use. We also find that participants who request AI assistance during the AI-access phase perform worse at the task after assistance is removed, and their subsequent unassisted performance is overestimated when predicted from earlier AI-assisted performance. We use a Bayesian latent ability model to separate initial ability, post-AI ability, and participant-specific skill change, while estimating how independent reasoning during the AI-access phase relates to skill development. The results show that greater independent problem-solving effort is associated with larger gains in latent ability, consistent with the interpretation that skill development is weaker when AI assistance substitutes for independent reasoning.

</details>


### [523] [Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23552)
*Seth Karten,Alex L. Zhang,Kevin Thomas,Sebastian Müller,Elie Bakouch,Daniel Auras,Mika Senghaas,Fares Obeid,Konstantin Dunas,Johannes Hagemann,Sami Jaghouar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Prime Agent 是一个开源的长时程智能体评估与编码工作流框架（harness），通过持久化 IPython REPL（遵循递归语言模型抽象）和持续型 Harness 设计，支持跨轨迹保存历史、记忆、技能、提示词和子智能体配置。递归子智能体通过直接的智能体间通信进行协调，并具备"智能体视图"供人类监控和管理后台会话。该框架标准化了执行、恢复、验证和资源核算，将策略构建留给模型本身，从而防止框架故障演变为模型故障，推动评测向模型真实最大潜能靠拢。在 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 上从 30% 提升至 95.5%，并在长上下文编码、GPU内核生成、模拟器构建和自主 nanoGPT 速通上达到或超越原生及其他主流框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型本质上是序列处理器，但长时程（long-horizon）智能体任务需要超越模型权重和活动上下文的额外信息与计算能力。现有框架在跨轨迹的记忆保持、子智能体协作、以及人类监控方面存在不足，导致框架自身的故障常常被误判为模型能力的不足。

Method: 1) 持久化 IPython REPL：遵循递归语言模型（Recursive Language Model）抽象，实现程序化上下文处理与测试时计算。2) Continual Harness：跨轨迹保留历史、记忆、技能、提示词和子智能体规范。3) 递归子智能体：通过直接的智能体到智能体通信进行协调。4) Agents View：允许人类检查和监管后台守护进程会话。5) 标准化执行、恢复、验证和资源核算，但将策略构建自主权留给模型。

Result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 上将成绩从 30% 提升至 95.5%；在长上下文编码、GPU内核生成、模拟器构建和自主 nanoGPT 速通等任务上达到或超越原生及其他主流框架；在 Factorio 实验中发现细化机制支持持续技术推进，专用子智能体支持并行工作。

Conclusion: Prime Agent 通过低摩擦、高表达力的"膜"（membrane）设计，有效隔离了框架层面的故障与模型能力问题，使得评测结果更能反映模型真实的最大潜能，为长时程智能体评估和部署提供了一种开源、标准化且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.

</details>


### [524] [ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23565)
*Zhifei Chen,Luozhou Wang,Guibao Shen,Dongyu Yan,Shuai Yang,Tianshuo Xu,Yihua Du,Wei Wang,Tianyi Gui,Lianghua Huang,Yingcong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReWorld是一个交互式世界模型，通过分离控制和记忆的训练目标并在推理时约束二者的预算，实现了实时流式生成、长时记忆保持与高保真视频质量的统一。它采用混合逐头注意力窗口、随机头部路由和随机块丢弃，配合有界KV缓存与姿态索引地标库，在固定预算下完成长程回放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型面临结构性张力：控制需要短时间视野以保证实时响应，而记忆需要无界历史以保证长程一致性。现有模型无法同时兼顾两者——滑动窗口会过早丢失证据，全KV注意力则内存耗尽。

Method: 1) 训练阶段分离控制与记忆：混合逐头注意力窗口（多数头限定近期、少数全局头覆盖全历史）+ 随机头部路由防止能力绑定到特定头 + 随机块丢弃使稀疏历史处于分布内。2) 推理阶段：有界KV缓存 + 姿态索引地标库，检索当前姿态最近的地标。3) 数据引擎：将八种数据源（Unreal渲染、游戏漫游、真实视频）对齐到同一物理动作尺度，回文轨迹提供记忆训练所需的回访证据。4) 蒸馏：通过LoRA适配器将采样压缩到4步，一个骨干同时支持多步高保真模式和实时交互模式。

Result: 在动作跟随、长时记忆召回和视频质量三维协议下，对比六个近期交互式世界模型，ReWorld取得最佳控制保真度（11.95°旋转误差、最佳相机运动一致性）和最佳生成质量。在64秒/384潜变量的长往返轨迹上，固定12块缓存仍能重建起点视图，而滑动窗口早已驱逐证据、全KV注意力内存耗尽。

Conclusion: ReWorld证明了通过在训练和推理阶段分别对控制与记忆进行解耦和预算约束，交互式世界模型可以同时实现实时流式生成与无限长时记忆，且不牺牲生成质量，为长时交互世界建模提供了可行的架构范式。

Abstract: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.

</details>


<div id='math.OC'></div>

# math.OC [[Back]](#toc)

### [525] [Output Feedback Guaranteed Cost Equilibrium in Networked Multi-Agent Linear-Quadratic Difference Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21568)
*Aniruddha Roy,Puduru Viswanadha Reddy*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了无限时域确定性线性二次差分博弈中的输出反馈信息结构问题。作者提出了一种输出反馈保证成本均衡（OF-GCE）概念，以替代难以计算的输出反馈纳什均衡（OF-NE），并给出了该均衡存在的充要条件（耦合双线性矩阵不等式的可解性），以及基于线性矩阵不等式的迭代综合算法。数值实验验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算输出反馈纳什均衡（OF-NE）即使在低维差分博弈中也极具挑战性，因此需要一种更易处理且能保证成本上界的均衡概念来替代。

Method: 提出输出反馈保证成本均衡（OF-GCE）概念，将其存在性转化为一组耦合双线性矩阵不等式（BMI）的可解性问题，并设计基于线性矩阵不等式（LMI）的迭代算法来综合OF-GCE策略。同时证明状态反馈GCE（SF-GCE）是OF-GCE在完全状态信息下的特例。

Result: 推导出OF-GCE存在的必要与充分条件，提供了LMI迭代综合算法，并通过数值算例展示了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: OF-GCE为输出反馈差分博弈提供了一种计算上可行的均衡概念，在保证每个玩家成本不超过预设界的同时满足均衡条件，克服了OF-NE难以直接计算的问题。

Abstract: In this paper, we study infinite-horizon deterministic linear-quadratic difference games with an output feedback information structure. We consider linear time-invariant dynamics and quadratic cost functionals defined over an infinite horizon. We first demonstrate that computing an output feedback Nash equilibrium (OF-NE) in difference games is challenging, even for low-dimensional games. To address this difficulty, we introduce an output feedback guaranteed cost equilibrium (OF-GCE) for difference games. In an OF-GCE, each player seeks a feedback strategy that guarantees its cost remains below a prescribed bound while satisfying an equilibrium condition. We derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of an OF-GCE in terms of the solvability of a set of coupled bilinear matrix inequalities. We provide a linear matrix inequality-based iterative algorithm for synthesizing OF-GCE strategies. We further show that the state feedback GCE (SF-GCE) is a special case of the OF-GCE when players have complete state information. Numerical examples illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [526] [The complexity landscape of robust (integer) linear programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21574)
*Michael Poss,Jannis Kurtz,Marc Goerigk,Dorothee Henke*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了静态鲁棒优化、两阶段（可调）鲁棒优化和K-适应性三类经典鲁棒优化问题决策版本的计算复杂性，在多种约束条件（多面体或整数规划表示）、不确定性类型（决策独立或决策依赖）以及可行域有界性组合下，给出了完整的复杂性分类（从P、NP、coNP到多项式层级Σ₂ᵖ和Σ₃ᵖ，乃至存在实数理论层级和不可判定问题）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管这些鲁棒优化问题在文献中已被广泛研究，但缺乏一个系统的复杂性分类。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过统一的框架对所有组合情形进行分类，同时特别关注成员资格证明，为指数编码长度的向量建立多项式大小的证书。

Method: 采用复杂性理论归约与成员资格证明相结合的方法：对所有问题情形进行系统性归约归类，并为属于NP或更高层级的问题构造多项式大小的证书；利用双层线性规划与决策依赖鲁棒优化的联系，给出其属于NP的替代证明；对于K-适应性，建立其与静态和两阶段问题之间的归约关系。

Result: 给出了所有组合情形的完整复杂性分类，包括P、NP、coNP、Σ₂ᵖ、Σ₃ᵖ、∃ℝ、Σ₂ℝ、Σ₃ℝ以及不可判定问题；证明K-适应性的难度随K单调增长，且对完全离散的决策依赖实例可归约回静态问题；以及双层线性优化属于NP的替代证明。

Conclusion: 该研究为鲁棒优化问题的计算复杂性提供了完整的系统图谱，揭示了决策依赖不确定性引入二次约束后复杂性急剧跃升（从多项式层级到实数存在理论层级甚至不可判定）的关键现象，并为后续算法设计与复杂性边界研究奠定了理论基础。

Abstract: We study the computational complexity of the decision versions of three classic robust optimization problems: static robust optimization, two-stage (adjustable) robust optimization, and $K$-adaptability. We consider that the feasibility, uncertainty, and recourse sets are polyhedra or integer-programming-representable sets, the uncertainty is decision-independent or decision-dependent, and the feasible regions are bounded or unbounded. While these problems are well-established in the current literature, we give a systematic classification that places the resulting problems in $\mathsf{P}$, $\mathsf{NP}$, $\mathsf{coNP}$, and higher levels of the polynomial hierarchy ($Σ_2^p$ and $Σ_3^p$), and, once decision-dependent uncertainty introduces quadratic constraints, in the existential theory of the reals and its hierarchy ($\exists\mathbb{R}$, $Σ_2\mathbb{R}$, and $Σ_3\mathbb{R}$) or among the undecidable problems. Beyond hardness reductions, we pay particular attention to membership proofs, establishing polynomial-size certificates even though the sets considered generally contain vectors of exponential encoding length. As a by-product, we give an alternative proof that bilevel linear optimization lies in $\mathsf{NP}$, exploiting its connection to decision-dependent robust optimization. For $K$-adaptability, we relate the problem to its static and two-stage counterparts, showing that hardness grows monotonically with $K$ and that, for fully discrete decision-dependent instances, $K$-adaptability reduces back to the static problem.

</details>


### [527] [Open-Loop Riemannian Frank--Wolfe: Fast Rates under Error Bounds and Scaling Inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21598)
*Kangming Chen*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了Riemannian Frank-Wolfe方法在光滑测地凸优化问题上的快速收敛性，主要针对Hadamard流形和紧致可行集。在局部Hölder误差界和方向缩放条件下，证明了开放循环步长η_k=a/(k+a)可达到O(k^{-1/(1-θ)})的渐近收敛率；在强测地凸目标下可达到O(k^{-2})；在精确Riemannian缩放不等式下可达到O(k^{-a})。文章还在单位球面的测地球上建立了缩放不等式，并分析了基于间隙反馈的短步长的收敛性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Frank-Wolfe方法在欧几里得空间已有成熟的收敛性分析，但其在Riemannian流形（尤其是Hadamard流形）上的快速收敛性研究尚不充分。作者旨在建立非欧几里得环境下Frank-Wolfe方法的快速收敛保证，特别是针对仅依赖迭代指数的开放循环步长策略，以简化实际应用中的步长选择。

Method: 作者在Hadamard流形上分析Riemannian Frank-Wolfe方法，考虑开放循环步长η_k=a/(k+a)。关键假设包括：局部Hölderian误差界、局部长度归一化方向缩放、内球条件、精确Riemannian缩放不等式等。通过在单位球面上建立α_R=½cot R的缩放不等式，推导出不同的收敛率结果，并对比了迭代索引步长与间隙反馈步长的性能。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 在局部Hölderian误差界和方向缩放下，任意a>2达到O(k^{-1/(1-θ)})（θ∈(0,1/2]）；(2) 内球条件+强测地凸目标下达到O(k^{-2})；(3) 精确缩放不等式+梯度范数下界下，a≥2达到O(k^{-a})，最近一半迭代的Frank-Wolfe间隙同样如此；(4) 单位球半径R<π/2的测地球上建立缩放不等式α_R=½cot R，得到O(k^{-a})率；(5) 间隙反馈短步长在误差界条件下获得O(k^{-1/(1-2θ)})及θ=1/2时的线性收敛率。

Conclusion: 本文系统建立了Riemannian Frank-Wolfe方法在Hadamard流形上的快速收敛理论，证明了仅依赖迭代索引的开放循环步长即可获得大幅改进的收敛率，并在单位球面上给出了具体的缩放不等式常数。数值实验验证了理论预测，为Riemannian优化中Frank-Wolfe方法的应用提供了坚实的理论支撑。

Abstract: We explore fast convergence of the Riemannian Frank--Wolfe method for smooth geodesically convex optimization over compact feasible sets. Hadamard manifolds are the main setting. On general complete manifolds, the analysis accounts for all feasible minimizing geodesics. We consider the open loop step-size $η_k=a/(k+a)$, which only uses the iteration index. Under a local Hölderian error bound and local length-normalized directional scaling, every $a>2$ gives the eventual rate $O(k^{-1/(1-θ)})$ for $θ\in(0,1/2]$. An interior-ball condition yields $O(k^{-2})$ for strongly geodesically convex objectives. Under an exact Riemannian scaling inequality and a uniform positive lower bound on the gradient norm, every $a\geq2$ gives $O(k^{-a})$ after an explicit threshold index. The same rate holds for the smallest Frank--Wolfe gap over the most recent half of the iterates. For geodesic balls of radius \(R<π/2\) in the unit sphere, we establish the scaling inequality with $α_R=\tfrac12\cot R$, yielding $O(k^{-a})$ primal error and recent-window gap rates. We also analyze the standard gap-feedback short step under the local error-bound conditions, obtaining $O(k^{-1/(1-2θ)})$ for $θ<1/2$ and a linear rate for $θ=1/2$. Numerical experiments illustrate the predicted rates and compare iteration-only and feedback-based step selection.

</details>


### [528] [Revenue and Social Welfare Maximization in Service Systems: Independent vs Grouped Customers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21608)
*Apostolos Burnetas,Antonis Economou*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了服务系统中带有战略客户（strategy customers）的收入最大化问题。与标准理性队列（Rational Queueing）文献中客户独立决策的博弈假设不同，本文考虑客户由领导者统一控制的情形，将问题建模为客户领导者与服务提供者之间的博弈，分析在不可观测的单服务器马尔可夫队列中，客户合作对于加入或放弃（join-or-balk）决策的影响，以及这种合作对社会福利和服务提供者收入的冲击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准理性队列文献通常假设客户独立决策并相互博弈，但现实场景中客户常被群体组织并受统一领导控制（如团体客户、集体进场）。因此需要一个新框架来研究客户合作化决策对队列系统带来的影响。

Method: 将客户群体视为由单一领导者统一指挥的博弈方，构建客户领导者与服务提供者之间的二人博弈模型，针对不可观测的单服务器马尔可夫排队系统分析join-or-balk决策。

Result: 揭示了客户合作（由领导者统一决策）对社会福利和服务提供者收入的量化影响。

Conclusion: 客户由独立决策转为有组织的合作决策时，将显著改变join-or-balk策略的均衡，进而影响社会福利与服务提供者收入，需要在设计中统筹考虑客户合作因素。

Abstract: The revenue maximization problem in service systems with strategic customers is a central problem in the thread of Rational Queueing literature. The standard modeling assumption is that customers act independently and, therefore, the situation is modeled as a game among the customers and the service provider. In the present work, we focus on the case where the customers are grouped and controlled by their leader and the situation becomes a game between the customers' leader and the service provider. We examine the effect of customers' cooperation for the join-or-balk dilemma at the unobservable single-server Markovian queue and present the impact on the social welfare and service provider's revenue.

</details>


### [529] [A counterexample to global convergence of classical DFP under the standard strong Wolfe conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21708)
*Benqi Liu,Zichen Wang,Zaiwen Wen,Liwei Zhang,Yaxiang Yuan*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明经典的DFP拟牛顿方法即使在标准强Wolfe条件下，在一致凸目标函数上也不能保证全局收敛。作者构造了一个二维C²函数，其Hessian条件数至多为3，DFP迭代良定义且所有接受步满足标准强Wolfe条件，但梯度范数收敛到正常数而非零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拟牛顿优化中一个长期悬而未决的问题：经典DFP方法在一致凸目标函数上，当所有接受步满足标准弱Wolfe条件时是否全局收敛。这是拟牛顿方法理论分析中的核心未解问题，此前一直缺乏反例或证明。

Method: 作者通过构造性方法给出反例：在二维空间中设计一个满足1/2I≼∇²f≼3/2I的C²函数，利用交替两步DFP序列在一维不变中心流形附近的行为，使得逆Hessian近似的小特征值趋于零，特征向量总旋转无界，梯度范数收敛到正常数。通过均匀分离界插值预设函数值和梯度，用不相交支撑的平滑函数加入二次型并保持全局Hessian界，最后通过仿射变换和正交直和将构造推广到任意维度n≥2。

Result: 成功构造出反例：DFP迭代良定义，所有接受步满足标准强Wolfe条件，但|∇f(x_k)|收敛到正常数而非零，全局Hessian条件数至多为3。累积点形成圆周，且结果可推广到任意维度n≥2。

Conclusion: 经典DFP方法在满足标准强（甚至弱）Wolfe条件下的全局收敛性问题是回答是否定的。即使目标函数一致凸且Hessian条件数有界，DFP方法仍可能不收敛到最优点。

Abstract: A long-standing open question in quasi-Newton optimization asks whether the classical Davidon--Fletcher--Powell (DFP) method converges globally on uniformly convex objectives when all accepted steps satisfy the standard weak Wolfe conditions. We show that the answer is no, even under the standard strong Wolfe conditions. Fix $0<c_1<2/3$ and $2/3\le c_2<1$. We construct a function $f\in C^2(\mathbb{R}^2)$ such that $\frac{1}{2}I\preceq\nabla^2 f(x)\preceq\frac{3}{2}I$ for all $x\in\mathbb{R}^2$. We also choose a fixed positive definite initial inverse Hessian approximation and a sequence of positive step lengths. The classical DFP iteration is well defined, and all accepted steps satisfy the standard strong Wolfe conditions, but $|\nabla f(x_k)|$ converges to a positive constant. The global Hessian condition number is at most three. The construction uses an alternating two-step DFP sequence near a one-dimensional invariant center manifold. Along this sequence, the smaller eigenvalue of the inverse Hessian approximation tends to zero. The changes in the gradient norm between cycle starts are summable, but the total rotation of the associated eigenvectors is unbounded. The accumulation points of the DFP sequence form a circle. A uniform separation bound allows us to interpolate the prescribed function values and gradients. We add smooth functions with pairwise disjoint supports to a quadratic and keep the global Hessian bounds. An affine change of variables gives an identity-initialized example with problem-dependent Hessian bounds. An orthogonal direct sum extends the result to every dimension $n\ge 2$.

</details>


### [530] [Optimal Selling of Defaultable Assets using the Distribution Builder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21716)
*Sixian Jin,Stephan Sturm*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文在"分布构建者"框架下研究考虑潜在破产风险时出售风险资产的最佳时机问题。该问题与Skorokhod嵌入问题密切相关，文章在一般一维扩散过程框架下推广了现有结果，纳入了破产的可能性。作者首先完整刻画了破产前可达到的分布集合，然后提出两个优化问题：寻找与不可达到分布最接近的可达到分布，以及在随机占优约束下选择最优可达到分布，并在扩展f-散度框架下证明了这些约束凸优化问题解的存在性与唯一性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布构建者方法要求投资者预先指定目标分布，但在考虑破产风险时，原先指定的分布可能不可达到或不是最优的，需要解决这些问题，因此需要将框架推广到包含破产可能性的情形。

Method: 运用Skorokhod嵌入问题理论，在一维扩散过程框架下，首先刻画破产前可达到分布的完整集合特征；然后构建两个凸优化问题：一是在扩展f-散度度量下寻找最接近的可行分布，二是在一阶随机占优约束下搜索最优可达到分布。

Result: 证明了在扩展f-散度框架下，两个约束凸优化问题的解存在且唯一，给出了解的解析刻画，并提供了数值示例。

Conclusion: 该研究为考虑破产风险的最佳资产出售时机问题提供了完整的数学理论框架，既处理了目标分布不可达到的情况，也处理了目标分布可达到但非最优的情况。

Abstract: We consider the problem of when it is best to sell a risky asset in the framework of the \textit{distribution builder} approach under the consideration of potential ruin. This approach allows investors to express their preferences directly as a desired target distribution without first specifying a risk aversion or utility function. Mathematically, the problem is closely related to the Skorokhod embedding problem, where the goal is to attain a given distribution by stopping a diffusion process. We work in a general framework of one-dimensional diffusion processes and extend existing results to include the possibility of ruin. We first provide a full characterization of the set of distributions that can be attained before ruin occurs. Then, we formulate two optimization problems that tackle the issue of what to do if the originally specified distribution is either not attainable or not optimal: finding the attainable distribution closest to an unattainable distribution and selecting an optimal attainable distribution under first-order stochastic dominance constraints if the originally specified distribution is attainable, but not optimal. We show existence and uniqueness of solutions to these constrained convex optimization problems in an extended $f$-divergence framework, provide an analytic characterization of solutions and give numerical examples.

</details>


### [531] [Centered Weak Discrete Riemannian Gradients: A Unified Framework for Riemannian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21862)
*Derun Zhou*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了中心弱离散黎曼梯度（c-wDRG）框架，用于统一分析黎曼流形上的优化方法，涵盖黎曼最速下降、近端点、近端梯度、隐式中点、测地平均向量场、Gonzalez和Itoh-Abe等方法，并建立了曲率感知的收敛性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黎曼流形上的优化方法众多，但缺乏统一的分析框架来比较和理解这些方法的收敛性质。现有的分析往往针对特定方法单独进行，难以从统一的视角揭示其内在联系和曲率依赖特性。

Method: 提出c-wDRG框架，利用中心点将相关的对数差分表示在公共切空间中；为各方案推导c-wDRG证书；利用显式度量失真界建立曲率感知的收敛性分析；进一步开发加速的c-wDRG方案。

Result: 在测地凸和强凸设置下，非加速方法分别获得次线性和线性收敛；加速c-wDRG方案在凸情形获得加速次线性收敛，在强凸情形获得加速线性收敛；提供了显式的曲率依赖步长条件和收敛率。

Conclusion: c-wDRG框架为黎曼一阶方法和离散梯度方法提供了统一的收敛性分析工具，给出了曲率相关的步长条件和收敛率，填补了该领域缺乏统一分析框架的空白。

Abstract: We introduce the centered weak discrete Riemannian gradient (c-wDRG) framework for the unified analysis of optimization methods on Riemannian manifolds. The framework uses a center point to represent the relevant logarithmic differences in a common tangent space and covers Riemannian steepest descent, proximal point, proximal gradient, implicit midpoint, geodesic average-vector-field, Gonzalez, and Itoh--Abe methods. We derive c-wDRG certificates for these schemes and establish curvature-aware convergence results using explicit metric distortion bounds. The framework yields sublinear and linear convergence for nonaccelerated methods in the geodesically convex and strongly convex settings, respectively. We further develop accelerated c-wDRG schemes, obtaining accelerated sublinear convergence in the convex case and accelerated linear convergence in the strongly convex case. Our results provide explicit curvature-dependent stepsize conditions and convergence rates within a common framework for Riemannian first-order and discrete-gradient methods.

</details>


### [532] [Hautus criteria for exact controllability and stabilizability of discrete-time backward-structured stochastic linear systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21933)
*Xurun Zuo*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了离散时间后向结构随机线性系统的精确可控性和L2可镇定性，分别建立了基于可控性格拉姆矩阵、Kalman型秩条件和可达子空间的等价刻画，以及有限维秩条件和Hautus型谱判据，并证明了精确零可控蕴含L2可镇定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后向结构随机线性系统在金融数学、随机最优控制等领域具有重要应用，但其可控性和可镇定性的代数与谱特征尚未被充分刻画，需要系统的理论分析。

Method: 针对给定有限时域，利用可控性格拉姆矩阵、Kalman型秩条件和可达子空间给出精确可控性的等价刻画；针对无预定有限时域的精确零可控性，建立有限维秩条件并利用正算子的半正定特征矩阵推导Hautus型判据；对于L2可镇定性，建立可镇定分解并给出相应的Hautus型谱判据。

Result: 建立了离散时间后向结构随机线性系统可控性与可镇定性的完整代数与谱判据，并证明了精确零可控性蕴含L2可镇定性这一重要关系。

Conclusion: 所得结果提供了所考虑系统可控性与可镇定性的代数检验和谱检验方法，为后续理论分析与实际应用奠定了基础。

Abstract: This paper studies exact controllability and L2-stabilizability of discrete-time backward-structured stochastic linear systems. For each prescribed finite horizon, equivalent characterizations of exact controllability are established in terms of the controllability Gramian, a Kalman-type rank condition, and the reachable subspace. Exact null controllability without a prescribed horizon is then characterized by a finite-dimensional rank condition, and a Hautus-type criterion is derived using positive semidefinite eigenmatrices of a positive operator. For L2-stabilizability, we establish a stabilizability decomposition and obtain a corresponding Hautus-type spectral criterion. As a byproduct, we show that exact null controllability implies L2-stabilizability. These results provide algebraic and spectral tests for the controllability and stabilizability of the considered systems.

</details>


### [533] [Virtual element approximations for distributed or Neumann boundary optimal control problems governed by poroelasticity equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22107)
*Thirupathi Gudi,David Mora,Nitesh Verma*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究线性孔隙弹性方程最优控制问题的协调虚拟元方法，采用优化后再离散的方法，同时考虑了分布式控制和Neumann边界控制，建立了三场形式离散状态和伴随问题的适定性，并通过新的孔隙弹性投影推导出关于物理参数一致的最优先验误差估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孔隙弹性方程在生物力学、地质力学等众多领域有广泛应用，其最优控制问题具有重要的实际意义。然而，该类问题涉及复杂的多物理场耦合和物理参数多尺度性，需要发展高效的数值方法（如虚拟元方法）来处理复杂网格上的最优控制问题，并保证误差估计对物理参数具有一致性。

Method: 采用优化后再离散（optimize-then-discretize）方法，首先推导一阶最优性条件，然后使用协调虚拟元方法（VEM）进行离散。建立三场公式（位移-压力-速度）下离散状态与伴随问题的适定性，并引入新颖的孔隙弹性投影技术来推导最优先验误差估计。

Result: 建立了分布式控制和Neumann边界控制两类问题的最优先验误差估计，这些估计关于模型问题中的相关物理参数具有一致性（即误差界不依赖于物理参数的大小）。数值实验采用原始-对偶主动集策略实现，结果验证了理论分析的成立。

Conclusion: 该工作为孔隙弹性方程最优控制问题提供了统一的虚拟元方法分析框架，所提出的孔隙弹性投影技术确保了误差估计对物理参数的鲁棒性，数值实验证实了理论结果的有效性。

Abstract: This paper investigate the conforming virtual element method for the optimal control problem governed by the linear poroelasticity equation. Both distributed control and Neumann boundary controls are considered with the optimize-then-discretize approach. We establish the well-posedness of the discrete state and adjoint problems in three-field formulation by deriving the first-order optimality condition. The optimal a priori error estimates are developed through a novel poroelastic projection for both control problems, and these estimates are uniform with respect to the relevant physical parameters of the model problem. Moreover, the numerical experiments are carried out using the primal dual active set strategy, and demonstrate the support for the derived theoretical results.

</details>


### [534] [Antagonistic Control: Foundations, Scalability and Nonlinearity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22204)
*Sribalaji C. Anand,André M. H. Teixeira*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了受约束控制输入的最坏情况影响问题：输入在保持其他输出有界的同时，最大化某些输出的平均代价（L2或L1范数）。该问题框架涵盖H∞范数和输出到输出增益等经典指标，适用于对抗控制、安全评估和鲁棒控制场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际控制系统中，输入往往受到多种约束限制，需要评估在约束下输入能造成的最坏影响。传统指标（如H∞范数）无法完全刻画这种受约束的恶意输入场景，特别是在安全评估和对抗控制中，需要更一般的分析框架。

Method: 对于线性时不变系统：(1) 单约束情形给出精确的SDP；(2) 多约束情形给出计算上界的SDP；(3) 基于系统零点和相对阶导出无界性的充分条件，并给出闭环修改策略消除无界性；(4) 对正系统，二次代价给出可扩展SDP（复杂度随状态维度线性增长），线性代价给出精确LP；(5) 通过平方和规划扩展到非线性多项式系统。

Result: 提供了统一的问题模板与多种求解算法：精确SDP（单约束）、上界SDP（多约束）、无界性判别条件及闭环修正方法、正系统的可扩展LP/SDP、非线性系统的SOS规划，并附数值示例验证。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了多种系统安全性指标，从安全角度揭示了无界值反映系统在检测特定攻击输入方面的结构性缺陷，为对抗控制和安全评估提供了理论工具。

Abstract: This paper studies the worst-case impact of constrained control inputs: an input seeks to maximize the average cost of some outputs, measured in the $L_2$ or $L_1$ norm, while remaining bounded in terms of other outputs. This problem template subsumes classical metrics such as the $H_\infty$ norm and the output-to-output gain, and arises in adversarial control, security assessment, and robust control. For linear time-invariant systems, we provide an exact semi-definite program (SDP) when there is a single constraint, and SDPs computing upper bounds when there are multiple constraints. We derive sufficient conditions, in terms of system zeros and relative degrees, under which the worst-case cost is unbounded, together with a constructive closed-loop modification that removes the unboundedness. From a security standpoint, unbounded values reveal structural limitations in detecting certain attack inputs. For positive systems, we provide scalable formulations whose complexity grows linearly in the state dimension: a scalable SDP for quadratic costs, and an exact linear program for linear costs. The results extend to nonlinear polynomial systems via a sum-of-squares program. We illustrate the results with numerical examples.

</details>


### [535] [Distributed model predictive control via finite-step control Lyapunov functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22382)
*Navid Noroozi,Maryam Sharifi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种分布式模型预测控制（DMPC）框架，用于受约束的非线性离散时间互联系统。每个子系统利用"有限步类Lyapunov函数"形式的局部阶段函数、时间对齐的邻居预测、优化的状态约束收紧半径和有限步小增益终端不等式，在每个时刻求解一个局部优化问题。针对邻居预测与实际优化轨迹不一致的问题，提出了移位兼容约束裕度、局部一步终端可行性检验和预测-再优化失配的解析界，保证了递推可行性、约束满足和实用的M步Lyapunov估计。在约束线性网络下条件可简化为矩阵、QP和SOCP检验，并在两DGU直流微电网原型上进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的逆Lyapunov定理是非构造性的，而有限步逆结果是构造性的：对于足够大的有限步M，任何缩放范数都可以作为逆有限步Lyapunov函数。类似地，对于互联离散时间系统，可以得到"非保守"的小增益条件。作者希望基于这一视角构建分布式模型预测控制框架，为受约束的非线性互联系统提供可验证的稳定性和递推可行性保证。

Method: 每个子系统在每个时刻求解局部优化问题，使用：(1)局部控制有限步类Lyapunov函数作为阶段函数；(2)时间对齐的邻居预测；(3)优化的状态约束收紧半径；(4)有限步小增益终端不等式。由于接收的邻居预测与未来滚动时域优化产生的轨迹不必一致，作者开发了移位兼容约束裕度、针对控制仿射网络的一步终端可行性检验、以及预测与再优化失配的解析界。

Result: 分析给出了递推可行性、约束满足和实用的M步Lyapunov估计；当预测与再优化失配界趋近于零时，实现渐近收敛。对于约束线性网络，条件简化为有限维矩阵、QP和SOCP检验。在带DC/DC功率变换器运行约束的两DGU直流微电网中，通过小型实验室原型验证了电流共享和终端母线电压安全性。

Conclusion: 该框架成功将有限步逆Lyapunov方法和小增益条件引入分布式MPC设计，通过处理邻居预测与再优化的失配问题，在不依赖传统保守假设的情况下保证了递推可行性和稳定性，并通过硬件实验验证了其实用性。

Abstract: As opposed to classical converse Lyapunov theorems, finite-step converse results are constructive and offer a different starting point: for sufficiently large finite step ahead, say $M$, in an explicit sense, any scaled norm can serve as a converse finite-step Lyapunov function. As for interconnected discrete-time systems, similar lines of argument lead to ``non-conservative'' small-gain conditions. Motivated by this viewpoint, this paper develops a distributed model predictive control framework for constrained interconnected nonlinear discrete-time systems. Each subsystem solves one local optimization problem at each system time step instant by setting the local stage function in form of a local control finite-step like Lyapunov function, using time-aligned neighbor predictions, optimized state-constraint tightening radii, and a finite-step small-gain terminal inequality. Since received neighbor predictions need not equal the trajectories generated by future receding-horizon optimizations, the nominal converse certificates do not alone ensure recursive feasibility or stability. We therefore develop shift-compatible constraint margins, a local one-step terminal feasibility test for networks that are affine in control, and an analytical bound for the prediction and reoptimization mismatch. The resulting analysis gives recursive feasibility, constraint satisfaction, and a practical $M$-step Lyapunov estimate, with asymptotic convergence when the prediction and reoptimization mismatch bound tends to zero. For constrained linear networks, the conditions reduce to finite-dimensional matrix, QP, and SOCP tests. The framework is specialized to current sharing and terminal bus voltage safety under DC/DC power converters' operational constraints in a two-DGU DC microgrid evaluated on a small laboratory-scale prototype.

</details>


### [536] [Adaptive Barzilai-Borwein Proximal Gradient Method for Nonconvex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22430)
*Yinuo Li,Na Huang,Ruizhi Zhou*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaBBNC方法，将Barzilai-Borwein步长策略扩展到复合非凸优化问题，在无需全局Lipschitz常数先验知识的情况下达到O(ε⁻²)的最优迭代复杂度，并在病态问题上表现出更强的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BB方法在无约束优化中高效且能低成本捕获Hessian曲率信息，但尚未被系统地扩展到复合非凸优化问题中。现有自适应近端梯度方法在病态问题上表现不够理想，需要更灵活、鲁棒的策略。

Method: 将基于BB的曲率估计嵌入近端梯度框架，提出适应性BB近端梯度方法（AdaBBNC），通过灵活的BB曲率估计增强在非凸场景中的适应性，且无需预先知道全局Lipschitz常数。

Result: 在温和假设下证明了AdaBBNC达到O(ε⁻²)的最优迭代复杂度；数值实验表明该方法相比近期参数自由且无线搜索的自适应近端梯度方法，在病态优化问题中表现出更具侵略性但稳定的行为。

Conclusion: AdaBBNC成功将BB步长策略扩展到复合非凸优化领域，兼顾理论最优复杂度与实际计算鲁棒性，为病态非凸优化问题提供了有效的求解方案。

Abstract: The Barzilai-Borwein (BB) method is an efficient gradient-based approach for unconstrained optimization that approximates spectral information of the Hessian matrix to capture curvature at low computational cost. In this paper, we extend the BB stepsize strategy to composite nonconvex optimization problems consisting of a smooth nonconvex term and a proper closed convex term, and propose an adaptive Barzilai-Borwein proximal gradient method for nonconvex optimization (AdaBBNC). The proposed method incorporates a flexible BB-based curvature estimate into the proximal gradient framework to enhance adaptability in nonconvex settings. Under mild assumptions, we establish that AdaBBNC achieves the optimal iteration complexity of $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-2})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary point, without requiring any prior knowledge of the global Lipschitz constant. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method. Compared with recent parameter-free and line-search-free adaptive proximal gradient methods, AdaBBNC exhibits more aggressive yet stable behavior in ill-conditioned optimization problems.

</details>


### [537] [Upper Hölderian with Explicit Exponent of Solution Mapping with Applications to Ball Constrained Least Squares Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22436)
*Yu Wang,Shenglong Hu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文将Robinson隐函数定理从上半Lipschitz情形推广到上半Hölder情形，确定了广义方程与其线性化之间显式的指数依赖关系，并将其应用于球约束最小二乘问题（包括线性及可分离非线性最小二乘），建立了球约束线性最小二乘解映射在上Hölder连续性下具有指数1/3的重要结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的Robinson隐函数定理适用于上半Lipschitz情形，但许多实际优化问题（如球约束最小二乘）的广义方程并不满足上半Lipschitz性质，仅具有更弱的上半Hölder连续性。因此需要将隐函数定理推广到上半Hölder情形，以处理更广泛的问题类别。

Method: 将Robinson隐函数定理从上半Lipschitz情形推广到上半Hölder情形，推导广义方程与其线性化之间解映射的显式Hölder指数依赖关系；利用该推广定理分析球约束线性最小二乘和可分离非线性最小二乘问题，建立其解映射的局部上半Hölder连续性。

Result: 建立了广义方程解映射在Hölder意义下的隐函数定理推广，并确定了显式的指数依赖关系。特别地，证明了球约束线性最小二乘在线性扰动下的解映射是局部上半Hölder连续的，指数为1/3；利用该推广定理进一步证明了参数化球约束线性最小二乘解映射的局部上半Hölder连续性。

Conclusion: 该工作拓展了广义方程隐函数定理的适用范围，为上半Hölder型解映射分析提供了理论基础，并对球约束最小二乘问题的参数扰动分析给出了具有独立意义的新结果（指数1/3）。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose an extension of the well-known Robinson implicit function theorem for generalized equations from the upper Lipschitzian case to the upper Hölderian case.
