### [562] [Self-Reported AI Usage for Learning in Computer Science Education: Relationships with Goal Orientation and Academic Help-Seeking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21373)
*Piret Luik,Karin Naruskov,Karmen Kalk,Merle Taimalu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过236名计算机科学专业大学生的自我报告调查，考察了目标导向和学业求助行为与AI使用的关联。分层回归分析发现，求助倾向（尤其是感知求助威胁）与AI使用的频率和范围一致相关，而目标导向的影响较为有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI在高等教育中日益普及，但影响学生使用AI进行学习的因素仍缺乏充分理解，尤其是个体心理因素（如目标导向和学业求助行为）如何塑造AI使用尚不清楚。

Method: 对236名修读数据库课程的大学生进行自我报告问卷调查；AI使用通过两个指标操作化（自我报告使用频率和AI支持的学习活动数量）；采用分层回归分析控制个体、行为和环境特征。

Result: 感知求助威胁与更频繁的AI使用及更多样化的AI支持活动一致相关；目标导向的影响在模型中较为有限且不一致。

Conclusion: 在设计AI支持的学习环境时，应重视学生的学业求助行为，将帮助寻求行为纳入考量是计算机科学教育中AI融入的重要方向。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming an increasingly integral part of higher education, yet the factors shaping students' use of AI for learning remain insufficiently understood. This study examines how students' goal orientation and academic help-seeking behavior are associated with AI use in a computer science context, while also accounting for individual, behavioral, and contextual characteristics. Data were collected from 236 university students enrolled in a database course using a self-report survey. AI use was operationalized through two measures: self-reported frequency of use and the number of AI-supported learning activities. Hierarchical regression analyses were conducted to examine the relationships among the variables. The results indicate that help-seeking tendencies, particularly perceived help-seeking threat, were consistently associated with both more frequent reporting of AI use and self-reported engagement in a wider range of AI-supported activities. In contrast, the effects of goal orientation were more limited and less consistent across models. The results highlight the importance of considering help-seeking behavior when designing AI-supported learning environments in computer science education.

</details>


### [563] [PersonaMem-v3: Toward Omni-Platform Personal Intelligence for Holistic User Understanding, Recommendation, and Agentic Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21381)
*Bowen Jiang,Yuan Yuan,Zhuoqun Hao,Yuchen Liu,Maohao Shen,Sihao Chen,Gregory Wornell,Chris Callison-Burch,Lyle Ungar,Dan Roth,Qi Guo,Xiangjun Fan,Camillo J. Taylor,Hanchao Yu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出PersonaMem-v3，一个基于超过一百万条真实匿名用户互动历史构建的全平台个人智能基准测试与评估框架，涵盖社交媒体、聊天机器人、日历和AI伴侣等场景，评估AI代理在跨情境用户理解、个性化推荐、主动性、代理工具使用和地理时间推理等方面的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个人智能已成为面向用户的AI代理的核心前沿，但当前系统只能在单个应用或任务内进行个性化，缺乏对跨情境用户理解、可操控推荐系统、跨平台主动行动以及避免过度个性化等整体能力的系统化评估。

Method: 从一百多万条匿名的真实用户参与历史（大部分为隐式信号）构建带时间索引的用户数字世界，涵盖社交媒体、聊天机器人、日历和AI伴侣，并融入偏好随时间演化的特性。基准框架以心理学、社会语言学和用户行为理论为基础，统一评估多个维度的能力。

Result: PersonaMem-v3将个性化、LLM驱动的推荐、主动性、代理工具使用和地理时间推理整合到一个框架中，能够评估AI代理是否可以从跨平台证据推断整体用户理解、个性化响应、重排序社交媒体推荐、遵循自然语言用户指令，并在个性化不恰当、重复、过时或不必要时加以克制。

Conclusion: PersonaMem-v3指向了LLM驱动的个人智能代理的发展方向：与现有可扩展推荐基础设施协同工作，同时使个性化更具交互性、代理性和与真实用户体验的一致性。

Abstract: Personal intelligence is becoming a central frontier for user-facing AI agents. To be helpful in everyday life, agents must understand users across the digital contexts where their preferences, intents, habits, social relationships, and needs unfold over time. Today's systems can personalize within individual apps or tasks, but personal intelligence as a whole remains under-measured: how agents build cross-context user understanding, support steerable recommendation systems, act proactively across platforms, and avoid over-personalization. We introduce PersonaMem-v3, a real-world-grounded benchmark and evaluation harness for omni-platform personal intelligence. PersonaMem-v3 is seeded from more than one million anonymized real-world engagement histories, most of which are implicit signals, and uses them to construct time-indexed user digital worlds across social media, chatbot, calendar, and AI-companion with preference evolvement over time. The benchmark brings personalization, LLM-powered recommendation, proactiveness, agentic tool use, and geo-temporal reasoning into one framework, anchored in psychology, social-linguistics, and user-behavior theories. It evaluates whether AI agents can infer holistic user understanding from cross-platform evidence, personalize responses, rerank recommendations on social media, follow user steering through natural language, and hold back when personalization would be inappropriate, repetitive, outdated, or unnecessary. PersonaMem-v3 points toward LLM-powered personal intelligent agents that work with existing scalable recommendation infrastructure while making personalization more interactive, agentic, and aligned with how real users experience their digital lives.

</details>


### [564] [Determinants of Starting Salaries for Filipino Graduates: An Explainable Machine Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21383)
*Alexander Gabriel A. Aranes,John Michael C. Magpantay,Reginald Neil C. Recario,Jamlech Iram N. Gojo Cruz,Rodolfo C. Camaclang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文使用众包调查数据，通过机器学习分析菲律宾毕业生起薪的决定因素，发现职业角色和行业是主导因素，其重要性远超院校声望，并通过SHAP归因、集成模型对职业文本的依赖以及NLI重述三条独立证据加以验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 菲律宾毕业生的教育准备与劳动力市场结果之间存在持续脱节，但现有研究主要以描述性追踪研究为主，只记录就业率而未能解释薪酬的决定因素，存在明显的研究空白。

Method: 采用众包调查数据集（含噪声、自我报告性质），应用机器学习方法分析起薪预测问题，并通过三条独立证据线（SHAP归因、最佳集成模型对职业文本的依赖、Natural Language Inference重述）交叉验证发现。

Result: 发现职业角色和行业是起薪的主导决定因素，其影响显著大于院校声望的影响，且该发现得到三条独立证据的一致支持。

Conclusion: 职业指导和政策制定应优先关注行业特定技能，而非院校品牌效应。

Abstract: Filipino graduates face a persistent disconnect between educational preparation and labor market outcomes, where starting salary is a key signal of entry-level valuation. Current Philippine research is dominated by descriptive tracer studies that document employment rates but do not explain the determinants of pay. We address this gap using a crowd-sourced survey dataset of graduate responses whose noisy, self-reported nature makes it a challenging prediction target. Applying machine learning to this problem, we identify job role and industry as the dominant determinants of starting salary, significantly outweighing institutional prestige. The strength of this finding is its central contribution: it is corroborated by three independent lines of evidence, namely SHAP attributions, the heavy reliance of the best ensemble on occupational text, and a Natural Language Inference reformulation. These results suggest that career guidance and policy should prioritize sector-specific skills over institutional brand.

</details>


### [565] [Interrupting the Chain: Human Perception of AI-Generated Disinformation Through a Kill Chain Lens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21389)
*Alexander Loth,Martin Kappes,Marc-Oliver Pahl*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过人类被试实验（n=504，2,438个判断），让用户区分新闻片段的来源（人类/机器）与真实性（真实/虚假），并利用改编的网络安全杀伤链作为认知攻击生命周期的分类框架。研究发现三个关键问题：怀疑度提升不改善检测（感知-准确度差距）、现代LLM常生成人难分辨的文本、虚假新闻检测在持续暴露下下降10.2个百分点而AI来源检测保持稳定，从而确定主动防御的干预点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI能以规模化方式制造定制化的虚假信息，但现有防御手段多为被动反应式。论文旨在通过实证研究理解用户感知与检测能力，从而为主动防御AI驱动的虚假信息提供干预依据。

Method: 采用人类被试研究设计，招募504名参与者完成2,438次判断任务，要求其对新闻片段进行双重分类（来源：人类vs机器；真伪：真实vs虚假），并采用改编的网络安全杀伤链作为分类法，将感知数据映射到认知攻击生命周期各阶段。

Result: 发现三个关键结果：(1)感知-准确度差距——用户怀疑度升高并不能提高检测准确率；(2)现代LLM生成文本经常与人类文本不可区分；(3)认知疲劳不对称——持续暴露下虚假新闻检测准确率下降10.2个百分点，但AI来源检测保持稳定。

Conclusion: 这些发现识别了针对AI驱动虚假信息进行主动防御的候选干预点，为在认知攻击生命周期各阶段设计防御策略提供了实证基础。

Abstract: Generative AI enables customized misinformation at scale, yet defenses remain largely reactive. We present empirical findings from a human-subject study (n=504 participants, n=2,438 judgments) in which users classified news fragments by origin (human vs. machine) and veracity (real vs. fake). We organize results using an adapted cybersecurity kill chain as a taxonomy for intervention, mapping perception data onto stages of a cognitive attack lifecycle. Three key findings emerge: (1) a perception-accuracy gap where heightened suspicion does not improve detection; (2) modern LLMs frequently produce human-indistinguishable text; and (3) an asymmetric cognitive fatigue effect where fake-news detection degrades by 10.2 percentage points under sustained exposure while AI-origin detection remains stable. These findings identify candidate intervention points for proactive defense against AI-driven disinformation.

</details>


### [566] [A Survey Instrument to Assess Students' AI and Generative AI Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21391)
*Aditya Johri,Cory Brozina,Akriti Bagale*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了一个综合性的AI知识评估工具，该工具结合多个量表衡量学生在技术概念、实际应用和伦理关切方面的AI知识，并在高等教育环境中测试其可行性和诊断能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着人工智能（包括生成式AI）的普及，对学生的AI教育需求日益增长。虽然已有多种AI素养框架和评估方法被提出，但缺乏能够同时评估多种知识形式（技术概念、实际应用、伦理关切）的综合评估工具。

Method: 作者开发了一个综合评估工具，将多个量表的测量项目结合起来，以捕捉广泛的素养特征和实际知识。该工具在高等教育环境中实施，以评估其可行性和实用性。

Result: 该工具展示了有用的诊断能力，能够识别学生中的常见误解。尽管学生整体表现良好，但对AI（尤其是生成式AI系统）工作原理存在显著误解，并缺乏更高层次的知识。

Conclusion: 该工具可公开使用，超越了仅了解学生态度和感知的范畴，能够测试学生知识和概念理解的多个方面，有助于开发有针对性的教学。

Abstract: In this research-to-practice paper we present a survey that can be used to assess students' AI knowledge. As the use of artificial intelligence (AI), including generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), has proliferated, so has the need to educate students about the topic. A range of AI literacy frameworks have been proposed, outlining the essential knowledge that students should have. Alongside, different ways of assessing AI knowledge have been developed. As yet, there is a lack of assessment instruments capable of evaluating multiple forms of student knowledge, including technical concepts, practical applications, and ethical concerns about AI use. In this article, we present a study implementing a comprehensive instrument to assess AI knowledge. The instrument combines measures from multiple scales to capture a range of literacy features and actual knowledge. We implemented the instrument in a higher education setting to assess its viability and usefulness and found that the instrument exhibited useful diagnostic capabilities and was able to identify common misconceptions among students. Although students performed well overall, there was a significant misunderstanding of how AI, especially GenAI systems, work. It also identified a lack of higher-level knowledge. The instrument is publicly available for use by others. We foresee its usefulness as a diagnostic that goes beyond understanding students' attitudes and perceptions of AI and GenAI use and tests multiple aspects of students' knowledge and conceptual understanding. This can enable the development of targeted instruction.

</details>


### [567] [Generative Gap Filling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21401)
*Yonathan A. Arbel,David A. Hoffman*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文挑战了合同解释文献中长期存在的假设——即合同文本很快耗尽，无法为争议条款提供足够证据。通过实验，研究者发现大型语言模型（LLM）仅凭合同其余部分，就能以近90%的准确率恢复被掩蔽的协商条款，远超人类读者（约50%）和随机猜测（约25%）。作者提出合同如同一张来自远方的无线电信号，即使不完整，缺失部分仍可通过正确的接收器重建，真正的合同空白比学界假设的更为稀少，并建议法院可将模型预测作为可争辩的普通证据，各方可通过"Choice of Model"条款来规范这一实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为合同文本在争议点上提供的信息稀疏，法官填补合同空白时必须依赖商业默认规则或个人政策偏好等外部因素，这种无序方法长期缺乏替代方案。作者旨在检验这一核心假设是否成立，探索是否存在更可靠的方法从合同文本中恢复缺失条款。

Method: 研究者选取真实合同，掩蔽当事人已协商的特定条款，让不同群体（普通读者、法学院学生、律师、大型语言模型）仅基于合同其余部分预测被移除的内容，并将预测准确率与随机基线（25%）进行对比。

Result: 普通读者约一半时间能恢复隐藏条款，是随机猜测的两倍；法学院学生和律师表现略好；而大型语言模型在仅获得合同其余部分的情况下，恢复准确率接近90%。

Conclusion: 合同文本所承载的协议信息远比文献认为的丰富，包括当事人从未写下的条款。真正的合同空白比假设的更罕见。法院可将模型预测作为普通且可争辩的证据加以考量，当事人可通过"Choice of Model"条款来规范这一做法的使用。

Abstract: Most contract litigation turns on contracts that imperfectly record parties' bargains. When the parties' dispute can't be solved by interpreting the text, courts fill the gap. Scholars have long assumed that the remaining text runs out quickly, and provides thin evidence of the actual deal on the disputed point. On that view, a judge who supplies the missing term must be drawing on something else, from commercial defaults to her own policy preferences. Despite generations of work, courts have no real alternative to such unruly methods. We tested that assumption. Taking real contracts, we masked a term the parties had negotiated and asked readers to predict what we removed. Lay respondents recovered the hidden term about half the time, twice what chance predicts. Law students and lawyers did marginally better. But large language models, given nothing but the rest of the contract, recovered it nearly nine times in ten. The deal, in short, testifies to far more of the agreement than the literature assumes, including terms the parties never wrote. A contract, we argue, is like a radio signal from far away. Even when incomplete, enough of the message is carried elsewhere that the missing part can be reconstructed with the right receiver. True gaps are rarer than supposed. Courts can weigh model predictions as ordinary, contestable evidence, and parties can discipline the practice with "Choice of Model" clauses.

</details>


### [568] [Sycophants in the Courtroom: Are LLMs Fragile to Juridical Authority and Evolving Legal Standards?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21409)
*Lorenzo Molfetta,Alessio Cocchieri,Luca Ragazzi,Ilaria Bartolini,Marco Patella,Gianluca Moro*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个比较诊断框架，将法律推理与医学基线在四个维度（知识召回、接地、置信度和鲁棒性）上进行评估，发现法律LLM在判断外部权威引文的有效性和误导性方面存在明显短板，且模型规模增大会加剧对权威但错误信息的过度信任。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在医学执照考试上的成功引发了对其法律领域能力的类似预期，但法律与医学存在本质区别：法律中的"真理"是偶然的，取决于管辖权、时间有效性和权威来源的层级，而不仅仅是推理。现有研究忽略了这一关键领域差异，缺乏比较性的诊断框架来揭示法律推理的特有挑战。

Method: 提出一个比较诊断框架，沿四个轴（知识召回、接地、置信度和鲁棒性）评估法律推理与医学基线；构建了一个编码时间有效性和规范关系的新基准；通过扰动上下文和引入权威引文来测试模型对检索信息的判断能力。

Result: 发现医学LLM能可靠地从已验证来源受益，而法律LLM难以判断检索到的引文是有用还是误导；法律LLM在扰动情境中表现出过度自信，对表面格式线索敏感；模型规模增大会放大这种趋势，更强的指令遵循能力与更弱的权威扰动抵抗力并存；LLM将法律视为非结构化文本而非具有约束力的先例。

Conclusion: 研究表明LLM存在过度信任权威但错误信息的倾向，尤其是在外部引用与模型内部知识冲突时。法律领域需要不同于医学的评估和训练策略，以增强模型对权威来源有效性和时效性的判断能力，而非仅仅依赖规模扩展。

Abstract: In medicine, claims remain valid when supported by empirical evidence grounded in stable biological reality. In law, by contrast, truth is contingent, defined by jurisdiction, temporal validity, and the hierarchy of authoritative sources. The recent success of large language models (LLMs) on medical licensing examinations has encouraged an expectation of comparable legal competence. This analogy, however, obscures a critical distinction between domains. Unlike in medicine, legal performance often depends less on inference than on determining when external authority is applicable, valid, and non-contradictory. We introduce a comparative diagnostic framework evaluating legal reasoning against medical baselines along four axes (knowledge recall, grounding, confidence, and robustness), uncovering a sharp domain asymmetry when applied to a new benchmark that encodes temporal validity and normative relationships. While medical LLMs reliably benefit from verified sources, legal LLMs struggle to assess when retrieved citations are useful or misleading, exhibiting overconfidence in perturbed contexts and sensitivity to superficial formatting cues. Increased model scale amplifies this tendency, revealing that stronger instruction following can coincide with weaker resistance to authoritative perturbations. These findings show that LLMs treat law as unstructured text rather than binding precedent, while revealing a tendency to over-trust authoritative but false information when external references conflict with a model's internal knowledge.

</details>


### [569] [Counterfactual, Per-Decision Bias Auditing for Automated Hiring: Localizing and Explaining Disparate Impact in Applicant Tracking Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21537)
*Jay Barach*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 提出AI偏见防火墙(AIBF)，一种逐决策审计申请追踪系统(ATS)的方法，通过中和受保护属性代理、重新评分并测量反事实偏移，生成带符号的逐决策偏差分数、决策翻转标志和可读解释。在Adult和COMPAS真实数据集上验证，能忠实聚合到群体层面统计差异，识别受保护属性翻转决策的AUC达0.963，审查5%决策即可发现55%的受害者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有审计工具存在两极分化：群体公平性指标(如不同影响比率)只能总结整体人群，无法定位不公平的个体决策；而局部解释器(如SHAP)虽能解释单个预测，却未与招聘偏见判定的法律标准相连接。缺乏一个既能逐决策审计又符合法律标准的工具。

Method: AIBF逐决策审计ATS：1) 中和候选人的受保护属性代理变量；2) 重新评分决策；3) 测量反事实偏移，产生带符号的逐决策偏差(以分数点为单位)、受保护属性改变决策的标志，以及指明责任因素的自然语言解释。

Result: 在Adult数据上：特权群体平均偏移+7.5分，弱势群体-8.0分，与统计均等差异一致；识别受保护属性翻转决策的AUC为0.963(基线0.672)；审查仅5%决策可发现55%受害者(基线的6%)。在COMPAS上也验证。局限性：纠正被标记决策可显著提高不同影响比率但未达法律对等水平，因标记为"才能"的特征仍残留代理相关性。

Conclusion: AIBF弥合了群体公平性度量与局部可解释性之间的鸿沟，提供忠实、精确且可操作的逐决策审计，识别具体受害决策及原因。代码以Apache 2.0许可证开源发布。

Abstract: Automated applicant tracking systems increasingly decide who advances in hiring, and litigation and regulation now demand that those decisions be auditable. Existing tools sit at two extremes. Group fairness metrics such as the disparate impact ratio summarize a whole population but cannot say which individual decisions were unfair or why, while local explainers such as SHAP attribute a single prediction but are not connected to the legal standard by which hiring bias is judged. We present the AI Bias Firewall (AIBF), a method that audits an applicant tracking system one decision at a time. AIBF neutralizes a candidate's protected-attribute proxies, re-scores the decision, and measures the resulting counterfactual shift, which yields a signed per-decision bias in score points, a flag for decisions the protected attributes changed, and a plain-language explanation naming the responsible factors. We evaluate on two real public datasets, Adult and COMPAS, rather than on synthetic data. The per-decision counterfactual shift is faithful, aggregating to reproduce the known group level disparity, for example a mean shift of +7.5 points for the privileged group and -8.0 for the disadvantaged group on Adult, consistent with the measured statistical parity difference. AIBF identifies the decisions that protected attributes flipped with an area under the ROC curve of 0.963 on Adult, against 0.672 for a baseline that flags by group membership, and it identifies the harmed candidates so precisely that reviewing only five percent of decisions surfaces fifty-five percent of them, against six percent under group based review. We also report a limitation: correcting flagged decisions raises the disparate impact ratio substantially but not to legal parity, because features labeled as merit carry residual proxy correlation. AIBF is released under the Apache 2.0 license with code and experiments.

</details>


### [570] [Consistently Good vs. Occasionally Great: A Rubric for Open-Ended Feedback Quality from Humans and Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21850)
*Binglin Chen,Rajarshi Haldar,Max Fowler,Matthew West,Craig Zilles*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文聚焦于编程导论课程中开放式简答题的自动反馈生成，提出了一个基于教育文献的五标准评估准则，并比较了前沿LLM（OpenAI o1）与九名助教在90份学生回答上的反馈质量。结果表明LLM平均反馈质量优于助教，但揭示了LLM自我评估时的显著自偏好偏差，对LLM评估方法提出方法论警示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模提供高质量学生反馈对学习至关重要，但人工反馈成本高昂、难以规模化。同时，现有研究缺乏对LLM生成反馈质量的系统评估，尤其是缺乏基于教育理论的评估框架以及关于LLM评估偏差的深入分析。

Method: 提出五标准评估准则（肯定正确部分、识别缺陷、提供可操作改进建议、适当隐藏答案、保持合适对话语气）；用该准则对比OpenAI o1与9名TA在90份学生回答上的反馈；由3名研究者和1个LLM独立评分，并进行交叉验证比较。

Result: 单个TA偶尔产出最佳反馈，但LLM在人类评估下平均表现持续优于TA；同时发现显著的自我偏好偏差——LLM给自己的输出打分系统性地高于人类专家评分，该偏差即使在跨模型评估中也可能存在。

Conclusion: LLM可用于生成教育反馈且平均质量优于人类助教，但依赖LLM评估反馈质量存在方法论风险。研究提供LLM与TA表现的详细特征分析、TA反馈质量变异性来源分析，并对教育场景中部署LLM反馈提出实践启示。

Abstract: Providing high-quality feedback on student work is essential for learning, yet delivering such feedback at scale remains challenging. In this paper, we focus on feedback for open-ended short answer questions in introductory programming, with the goal of nudging students toward success on reattempts without revealing the correct answer. We develop a five-criteria rubric grounded in educational literature for evaluating feedback quality: (1) acknowledging correct portions of the student answer, (2) identifying at least one flaw (if present), (3) providing actionable guidance for improvement, (4) maintaining appropriate concealment of the answer, and (5) using an appropriate conversational tone. Using this rubric, we compare feedback generated by a frontier LLM (OpenAI o1) to feedback from nine teaching assistants across 90 student responses, with three researchers and an LLM independently scoring all feedback. Our results show that while one TA often produced the best feedback, the LLM demonstrated consistently higher average performance than TAs, as evaluated by humans. However, we also uncover significant self-preference bias when using LLMs to evaluate feedback quality: the LLM systematically rated its own outputs higher than human experts did. This bias, which research suggests persists even in cross-model evaluation, raises important methodological concerns for researchers employing LLM-based evaluation. We provide detailed characterization of both TA and LLM performance, analyze sources of variance in TA feedback quality, and discuss implications for deploying LLM-generated feedback in educational settings.

</details>


### [571] [Unfolding the Interdisciplinary Complexities of Climate Science: Fuxi-Climate Foundational Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22242)
*Zhengyu Shi,Shaojie Shi,Rui Xu,Bohao Lv,Zhichao Chen,Jiaran Hao,Zijian Chen,Weiqi Tang,Yuan Qi,Yinghui Xu,Libo Wu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Fuxi-Climate Foundation Model (CFM)，一个气候领域专用的LLM，能够在跨学科（物理过程、社会经济、政策响应）中保持一致的推理能力。CFM在跨学科复杂度增加时保持稳定的分析行为，优于其他模型；在气候转型任务中实现了45%的权衡覆盖率和47.27%的不确定性感知推理，支持更现实的气候风险与转型路径分析，并为基础智能体系统探索复杂政策决策场景提供了基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候研究和决策需要整合物理过程、社会经济动态和政策响应等多学科证据。虽然LLM已被用于获取和综合气候知识，但它们支持结构化跨学科推理的能力仍然有限，需要开发专门的气候大模型来弥补这一差距。

Method: 构建了Fuxi-Climate Foundation Model (CFM)，一个气候领域专用的大语言模型，旨在跨领域保持一致的推理能力。通过专家设计的气候转型任务进行评估，考察模型在应对跨学科复杂度增加时的稳定性和分析质量。

Result: CFM在跨学科复杂度增加时保持更稳定的分析行为，而其他模型表现变得更加多变。在气候转型任务中，CFM实现了45%的权衡覆盖率和47.27%的不确定性感知推理，显著优于其他模型，能更明确地处理权衡和不确定性。

Conclusion: CFM能够支持更现实的气候风险和转型路径分析，为基于智能体的系统探索复杂政策和决策场景提供基础。模型已开放获取，可供研究和应用使用。

Abstract: Climate research and decision-making require integrating evidence across physical processes, socio-economic dynamics and policy responses. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored for accessing and synthesizing climate knowledge, but their ability to support structured interdisciplinary reasoning is still limited. Here we present the Fuxi-Climate Foundation Model (CFM), a climate-specialized LLM designed to support consistent reasoning across domains. CFM maintains more stable analytical behavior as interdisciplinary complexity increases, whereas performance in other models becomes more variable. On expert-designed climate transition tasks, CFM produces more structured analyses that explicitly address trade-offs and uncertainty, achieving 45% trade-off coverage and 47.27% uncertainty-aware reasoning. These results indicate that CFM can support more realistic analysis of climate risks and transition pathways, and provide a basis for agent-based systems to explore complex policy and decision scenarios. The model is openly available at https://huggingface.co/SII-yuning/cfm.

</details>


### [572] [Evaluation in the Age of AI: Output as Evidence of Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22660)
*Md Zarzees Uddin Shah Chowdhury,Samin Rahman Khan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了AI时代高等教育评价的伦理挑战，指出核心问题不仅是学术不端，更是评价实践与学习目标之间的深层错位。作者主张需要转向强调过程而非成果的替代性评价模型，以保留学生的主体性和责任感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型的快速发展使传统评价任务（写论文、解题、写代码）可以被AI轻易生成，导致评价失去对真实理解能力衡量效度，引发根本性伦理问题：当传统能力指标可被轻易外包时，学习应如何被评价？

Method: 从大学层面分析机构应对措施，并通过实证调查数据呈现现状，进而提出强调过程而非成果的替代性评价模型建议。

Result: 通过分析机构回应和实证调查数据，指出依赖人为约束的评价制度可能衡量的是合规性、可及性或掩饰行为，而非真正的理解、推理和判断能力。

Conclusion: 需要建立伦理知情的评价策略，在自动化时代保留学生的主体性和责任感，核心是转向过程导向的评价范式以弥合评价与学习目标之间的错位。

Abstract: The rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), has fundamentally disrupted how learning is demonstrated and evaluated in higher education. Tasks that once served as proxies for understanding-such as writing essays, solving problem sets, or producing computer code-can now be generated superficially by AI systems with minimal human effort. This paradigm shift raises a critical ethical question: how should learning be evaluated when traditional indicators of competence are easily outsourced? This paper examines the ethical challenges of educational evaluation in the age of AI from a university-level perspective. We argue that the core problem extends beyond academic dishonesty to a deeper misalignment between assessment practices and the learning outcomes they are intended to measure. Evaluation regimes that rely on artificial constraints risk measuring compliance, access, or concealment rather than genuine understanding, reasoning, or judgment. By analyzing institutional responses and presenting empirical survey data, we highlight the need for alternative assessment models that emphasize process over product. The goal is to establish ethically informed assessment strategies that preserve student agency and accountability in an automated age.

</details>


### [573] [Large language models simulate intersectional synthetic identities with a budget of one to two dimensions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23005)
*Virgile Rennard,Christos Xypolopoulos*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究系统地测试了LLM作为合成调查受访者的可靠性，发现标准的人口统计学persona方法在模拟交叉身份群体时存在严重缺陷。真实受访者的交叉群体观点近似于各单一身份成分的加和，且随身份交叉而变得更独特；但模拟受访者却完全缺乏这种组合性——一个单一特征往往比两特征的加和更能解释回答，第三个特征几乎无贡献。该现象在所有提示策略下均存在，且模型保留的特征几乎是盲目选择的（系统性地丢弃了种族和宗教这两个最强的真实观点驱动因素）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被越来越多地用作合成调查受访者，承诺以低成本获取罕见的交叉人口群体数据。然而，标准人口统计persona方法能否真实捕捉交叉身份（如种族+宗教+性别）对观点的影响，是一个未经验证的关键问题。本研究旨在系统检验这一假设。

Method: 使用8个LLM模型，基于Pew美国趋势小组15波调查的全部真实交叉人口亚组，生成2100万个模拟回答分布。将模拟受访者的观点与真实受访者进行比较，测试标准人口统计persona方法，检验身份特征的加和性是否在模拟中成立，并尝试多种提示策略。

Result: 真实受访者中，亚组观点近似于单一身份成分的加和，且交叉身份使其独特性增长2.5倍。但模拟受访者不存在这种组合性：在75-82%的亚组中，单一特征比加和组合更好地解释双特征persona的回答，第三个特征几乎不增加信息。此崩溃在所有提示策略下均存在，且模型选择性丢弃了种族和宗教这两个最强的真实观点驱动因素。

Conclusion: 合成样本虽然声称提供交叉身份persona，但实际上每次只代表了单一身份。LLM无法忠实地模拟真实交叉人口群体的观点结构，这对其作为调查数据的替代品提出了严重质疑。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents, promising cheap access to rare intersectional populations. We test standard demographic-persona methods against every real intersectional subgroup across 15 waves of Pew's American Trends Panel -- 21 million simulated response distributions from eight models. In real respondents, subgroup opinion is approximately the additive sum of its single-identity components, yet grows 2.5x more distinctive as identities intersect. Simulated respondents show no such composition: a single feature explains a two-feature persona's responses better than the additive combination in 75-82% of subgroups, and a third feature adds almost nothing. This collapse survives every prompting strategy we test. Additionally, the feature models retain is chosen nearly blindly -- except that they systematically discard race and religion, the strongest real drivers of opinion. Synthetic samples offer intersectional personas but represent one identity at a time.

</details>


### [574] [Expectations and Practices around AI Disclosure in CS Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23271)
*Arati Mohapatra,Danish Pruthi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文调查了顶级计算机科学会议中AI披露政策与实践的现状，发现政策普遍缺乏明确规范；通过对109名研究者的调查，揭示了不同研究任务和人类参与程度下披露的必要性差异；并通过分析EMNLP 2025和ICLR 2026的13867条披露声明，发现研究者的期望与实际披露实践之间存在巨大落差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI在研究工作中的使用日益普遍，相关政策制定者已在多个出版平台推行AI披露政策，但尚不清楚现有披露政策和实践是否真正反映了其设立目的。

Method: 研究采用三部分方法：(1) 调查顶级计算机科学学术场所的AI披露政策；(2) 对109名计算机科学研究者进行问卷调查，探讨不同研究任务和人类参与程度下披露的必要性；(3) 分析EMNLP 2025和ICLR 2026的13867条披露声明，比较实践与期望的差距。

Result: 研究发现：现有AI披露政策虽普遍存在但高度缺乏细节规范；研究者认为在研究设计相关任务及人类参与程度较低时最需要披露；实际披露实践与研究者期望存在明显脱节，例如写作辅助被认为不太必要却频繁被披露。

Conclusion: 作者为作者和政策制定者提供建议，旨在使AI披露政策和实践与研究者期望保持一致，推动更有效、更有针对性的AI使用披露框架。

Abstract: As generative AI tools find increasing use in research workflows, ongoing debates on their impact, appropriateness and responsible use have led policymakers to enact policies to disclose AI use at multiple publishing venues. However, are current AI disclosure policies and practices reflective of their purpose? In this work, we first investigate disclosure policies of top computer science venues and find that despite their prevalence, they remain highly under-specified. Secondly, through a survey of computer science researchers (N=$109$), we characterize the necessity of disclosures across different research tasks and levels of human involvement. We learn that researchers find disclosures most necessary for tasks involving research design, and for tasks when the human involvement is low. We also compile expectations that researchers have about the information to be conveyed in AI disclosure statements. Lastly, through an analysis of $13867$ disclosure statements from EMNLP $2025$ and ICLR $2026$, we reveal a large disconnect between these expectations and AI disclosures in practice---a prime example being writing assistance which is deemed less necessary but frequently disclosed. We conclude with recommendations for authors and policymakers that seek to align AI disclosure policies and practices with expectations.

</details>


### [575] [Enabling Organisational Change Through Ground-Up Initiatives: A Case Study from the STFC Scientific Computing Department](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23374)
*Jessica Huntley,David McDonagh*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过英国科学与技术设施理事会科学计算部门的案例研究，展示了如何将高层级的净零战略转化为具体的数字研究基础设施（DRI）可持续性行动，涵盖排放监测、用户教育、最佳实践、标准制定和长期支持等主题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已有高层级的战略和建议，但数字研究基础设施组织往往不清楚如何将净零目标转化为具体可执行的结果，缺乏实际操作层面的指导。

Method: 采用案例研究方法，基于科学计算部门（SCD）的实践经验，该部门拥有200多名员工、服务数万名研究人员，覆盖云和高性能计算基础设施以及多元软件生态系统，在多主题框架下制定并实施可持续发展战略。

Result: 展示了SCD部门在排放监测、用户教育、最佳实践、可持续性标准设定和长期支持等五个主题上的战略制定过程，并报告了实施中的成功经验与遇到的困难。

Conclusion: 该案例可为其他数字研究基础设施部门或机构提供可借鉴的模板，帮助其将高层级的净零目标转化为具体的可持续性行动。

Abstract: Transforming digital research infrastructure (DRI) to align with UK Net Zero targets requires significant action from organisations in this space. Although high level strategies and recommendations exist, it is not always obvious how to translate these into concrete results. Here we present a case study from the Science and Technology Facilities Council's Scientific Computing Department (SCD). This department consists of over 200 staff supporting tens of thousands of researchers, and is spread over significant cloud and high performance computing infrastructure, as well as a diverse ecosystem of software across computational biology, materials science, engineering, and mathematics. We show how we developed the sustainability strategy for SCD across themes of emissions monitoring, user education, best practice, setting sustainability standards, and providing long-term support to sustainability work. We discuss the successes and difficulties in establishing this strategy, and how this could serve as a template for other departments and facilities.

</details>


### [576] [Whose readiness counts? Disagreement within and between sectors in perceived AI and robotics preparedness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23406)
*Peng Wang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过982名受访者针对17项AI与机器人挑战的15,200次评估，检验聚合式就绪度评分所丢失的信息量。交叉分解显示仅7.3%的变异来自挑战本身差异，约60%为响应级变异，挑战族均值仅占约2%。制造业就绪度均值最高，但各应用间差异显著。结论建议就绪度报告应保留应用层面分歧、披露评分者构成，而非笼统给出单一分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI与工业4.0就绪度评估常用单一分数概括组织、应用领域或行业的准备程度，但这种聚合会掩盖对同一技术的分歧意见以及同一行业标签下不同应用之间的差异，导致信息丢失。

Method: 采用卡片式调查法，982名受访者对17项具名的AI与机器人挑战提供了15,200次就绪度评估，并使用交叉分解（crossed decomposition）分析变异来源，比较不同受访者群体（计算机科学/AI/ML背景、工程背景、非技术背景）及不同挑战族（制造业、应用类等）的就绪度判断差异。

Result: 卡片级就绪度标准差为1.03-1.26（五分制），受访者常对相同挑战持不同意见。变异分解中，32.7%归因于受访者稳定差异，7.3%归因于挑战间差异，60.0%为响应级变异（含测量误差）。挑战族均值仅解释约2%变异。制造业就绪度均值最高，但车间机器人、流程优化AI与一般决策支持应用被判断得各不相同。计算机科学及AI/ML背景受访者报告的就绪度高于非技术受访者，但工程受访者并未报告更高的制造业就绪度。

Conclusion: 行业排名更适合作为组合概览而非行业统一就绪水平的证据。就绪度报告应保留应用层面的分歧、披露构成平均值的评分者身份，并考虑伦理、网络安全、素养与能力需求，而不应将它们压缩为一个单一分数。

Abstract: AI and Industry 4.0 readiness assessments often summarise preparedness using a single score for an organisation, application domain or sector. Those summaries can conceal disagreement about the same technology and variation among applications grouped under one sector label. We test how much information is lost through this aggregation using a card-based survey in which 982 respondents provided 15,200 readiness evaluations across 17 named AI and robotics challenges. Readiness is perceived community preparedness and available resources, not personal willingness or audited organisational capability. Respondents frequently disagreed about identical challenges, with card-level readiness standard deviations of $1.03$-$1.26$ on a five-point scale. A crossed decomposition attributes 32.7% of observed variation to stable respondent differences, 7.3% to differences among challenges, and 60.0% to response-level variation that also contains measurement error. Differences among challenge-family means account for only about 2% of variation, with substantially more variation among people, applications and person-family judgements. Manufacturing has the highest mean readiness, yet shop-floor robotics, process-optimisation AI and general decision-support applications are judged differently. Computer-science and AI/ML respondents report higher readiness than non-technical respondents across challenge families, whereas engineering respondents do not report higher Manufacturing readiness. Sector rankings are therefore best used as portfolio summaries rather than evidence that an industry is uniformly ready or behind. Readiness reporting should retain application-level disagreement, disclose whose judgements form the average, and consider ethics, cyber security, literacy and capability needs without collapsing them into a single score.

</details>


### [577] [Energy and CO2 Footprint of Climate Model Intercomparison Projects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23509)
*Sergi Palomas,Pablo Aparici,Gladys Utrera,Mario Acosta*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了地球系统模型（ESMs）在高性能计算（HPC）环境下的计算与碳排放问题，追踪了气候模型碳核算从CMIP6的自愿事后估算到CMIP7新成立的能源消耗任务组标准化核算的演变过程，并通过Destination Earth高分辨率模拟实证评估了不同核算边界（运行、仅主动和隐含碳）对能源、碳排放和财务成本报告的影响，最后提出了MIP标准化能源与碳核算的关键方法论考量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着ESM不断演进，其计算需求因更高空间分辨率、更复杂的生物地球化学过程整合以及更大的气候集合而持续增长。历史上峰值计算性能增速超过能效提升，导致HPC总功耗上升。尽管MIP在气候研究中占据核心地位，但量化其计算和环境成本从未受到系统性关注，这成为研究的动机所在。

Method: 论文采用实证研究方法，利用MareNostrum 5上的高分辨率Destination Earth模拟，对不同核算边界（运行碳、仅主动碳和隐含碳）下的能源消耗、碳排放和财务成本进行比较评估；同时追踪CMIP6到CMIP7能源消耗任务组的核算标准化进程。

Result: 研究揭示了不同核算边界选择会显著影响报告的能源、碳排放和财务成本结果，并形成了从CMIP6自愿事后估算向CMIP7标准化核算的转变路径。

Conclusion: 论文为MIP框架下标准化能源和碳核算提出了关键方法论建议，强调需要统一核算边界和标准以确保气候模型计算成本的可比性和透明度。

Abstract: Earth System Models (ESMs) rely heavily on High-Performance Computing (HPC) resources to simulate global climate. As these models evolve, their computational demands continue to grow, driven by three factors: (1) finer spatial grid resolutions, (2) the integration of complex biogeochemical processes (e.g., atmospheric chemistry, interactive vegetation, land use, and ice sheets), and (3) larger climate ensembles to manage uncertainty. Historically, growth in peak computing performance (FLOP/s) has outpaced improvements in energy efficiency (FLOP/Watt), increasing total HPC power consumption. Despite the central role of Model Intercomparison Projects (MIPs) in climate research, quantifying their computational and environmental costs has received limited systematic attention. This paper examines the evolution of climate model carbon accounting from voluntary post-hoc estimation in the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project phase 6 (CMIP6) to standardized accounting under the newly established CMIP7 Task Team on Energy Consumption. Using high-resolution Destination Earth simulations on MareNostrum 5, we empirically evaluate how different accounting boundaries (operational, active-only, and embodied carbon) impact reported energy, carbon emissions, and financial costs. Finally, we outline key methodological considerations for standardizing energy and carbon accounting for Model Intercomparison Projects (MIPs).

</details>
